### San Cristobal Canvas

Charming   \*  Spacious   \*  Historic   \*    Tranquil   \*  Potential

Welcome to your charming oasis in the heart of San Cristobal! This picturesque property boasts a delightful blend of historical charm and ample potential for modern living. Situated on a peaceful street, this home offers a serene retreat while still being close to all the amenities of the city.

As you step inside, you’ll be captivated by the original pasta tile floors and the warmth of the original wooden doors, which add character and authenticity to the space. The layout features 7.5 meters wide and 57.5 meters long, providing a generous footprint for comfortable living.

One of the highlights of this property is the ample space it offers for expansion and customization. With enough room to add a casita at the back of the property, complete with 2 bedrooms, you have the flexibility to accommodate guests or generate rental income. Additionally, there is plenty of space to add a refreshing pool, perfect for enjoying the sunny days in Merida and creating your own private oasis.

Whether you’re seeking a peaceful retreat or an opportunity to put your personal touch on a historic property, this home offers endless possibilities. Don’t miss your chance to own a piece of San Cristobal’s rich heritage in this idyllic setting. Schedule your showing today and let your imagination run wild with the potential that this property has to offer!

### Centro Colonial For Renovation!

Merida,

Yucatan

This old Colonial is just waiting for someone with a vision to restore it to its original majestic beauty.

Located on a quiet street, this 221.49 m2 (2384 square feet) lot with construction has been approved by the municipal for up to a 4 stories high addition. This could be an AirB&B, a small boutique hotel or your Colonial dream home!

There is a large new pool, a new septic tank and a 3,000 liter water holding system. The back garden has a bodega that could be turned into a pool bath house.

This Colonial needs a total renovation, however, priced at only $117,689.00 USD, it remains one of the best buys in Centro.

NOTE: The price of this property is linked to a MXN peso price of $2,120,000.00. Please check the current daily exchange rate for the most current USD price.

To view this property, contact Dr. Leroy Osmon – 999-125.6195 or email: leroy.osmon@gmail.com

### Live the Mérida Lifestyle in the Ermita House of Lions

Set in one of Mérida’s most charming neighborhoods, this beautifully renovated two-bedroom, two-bath home offers the perfect mix of character, comfort, and convenience.  From the moment you step through the vibrant pink façade, you’ll find thoughtful design at every turn.

*   Private front courtyard with space for bicycles or additional storage
    
*   Airy open-concept living and dining area
    
*   Interiors curated by a New York fashion professional, blending modern design with handcrafted local artisan pieces
    
*   Sleek, well-appointed kitchen featuring a gas stove, oven, and custom-paneled refrigerator
    
*   Inviting rear patio with built-in seating and a sparkling pool accented by hand-carved lion-head fountains
    
*   Serene primary suite with king-size bed, memory foam mattress, and spa-inspired bathroom
    
*   Second bedroom with twin beds overlooking a peaceful gravel patio—ideal as a guest room, office, or creative space
    
*   Two beautifully finished bathrooms with enclosed showers, vanities, and LED-lit mirrors
    
*   Fully updated systems including new appliances, electrical wiring, plumbing, windows, washer, dryer, and water softener
    
*   Ceiling fans and new air-conditioning units for year-round comfort
    
*   Corner lot location providing abundant natural light, airflow, and cooling breezes
    

Whether you’re searching for a turnkey residence, a stylish pied-à-terre, or a rental-ready investment, this property is designed for easy living in the heart of Mérida.

**The sale price is set at $159,900 US dollars which is its equivalent in Mexican pesos at time of closing.**

### Casa Arco Escondido — Solar Colonial & Hidden Paradise in Centro

\* Solar \* Arched \* Verdant \* Turnkey \* Timeless

Welcome to Casa Arco Escondido, a masterfully restored 3-bed, 3-bath hacienda-style home tucked in the heart of Mérida’s historic Centro. With its bold pink façade, soaring antique ceilings, artisan tilework, and peaceful garden retreat, this home offers the rare blend of 19th-century charm and fully turn-key modern comfort.

See the full video tour here: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=O4zCtEpZdfw&t=801s&ab\_channel=DestinationRetirement

Historic Beauty Meets Modern Ease  
Built in the 1800s and lovingly renovated, Casa Arco Escondido is fully turn key and showcases:

– Handcrafted colonial doors, shutters, and beams  
– Restored and original pasta tile floors  
– Fossil stone columns & custom iron lighting  
– Fully updated plumbing and electrical systems  
– 7 solar panels & whole-house reverse osmosis water system  
– Mesh Wi-Fi, new appliances & smart TVs  
– Automated garden lighting & irrigation system

A Kitchen with Soul

\* The old-world kitchen is a true centerpiece: vibrant Talavera tile, hand-painted cabinetry, a copper farmhouse sink, commercial-grade 52” range, antique pot rack, and a custom-designed island. Whether entertaining or unwinding, it’s built to impress.

Outdoor Living at Its Best

\* Tall arches open to a tropical courtyard with lush gardens, stone planters, and a serene filtered pool crowned by a floating column and fountain. A covered terrace and full outdoor kitchen (with concrete counters, sink, and grill) make al fresco living effortless.

A detached master suite casita provides privacy and quiet, while a separate laundry room adds convenience.

Proven Rental Potential

\* Casa Arco Escondido has a strong short-term rental history—income figures available upon request.

Unbeatable Location

\* Situated in a tranquil pocket near the Ermita and San Sebastián neighborhoods, you’re minutes from:

Plaza Grande & Mérida Cathedral – 5 min  
La Plancha Park – 10 min  
Paseo de Montejo – 10 min  
Mérida International Airport – 15 min  
La Isla & Harbor Malls – 25–30 min

### Beachfront. Dzilam de Bravo. AMAZING PRICE!!!

Dzilam de Bravo,

Yucatan

Beachfront in Dzilam de Bravo at an amazing price of only $149,000.00 USD!

This beachfront property has 2 bedrooms and 1 bathroom, a large living area with kitchen and an area that can be used as an office.

One of the bedrooms has a beautiful view of the Gulf of Mexico and the second bedroom has a view of the patio and large pool. There is a rooftop patio (terrace) that offers an even more beautiful view of the water.

Dzilam de Bravo is a quiet fishing village East of Telchac and Chabihau and offers total tranquility. It is a perfect retirement area or beachfront rental property.

This 270 m2 property offers peace and quiet from the modern worlds noise and chaos at an amazing price of only $149,000.00 USD.

### Casa 59 Charming Home Near La Plancha

Conveniently located in **downtown**, this cute **fixer upper** has a solid structure and original **colonial features**. The house has only one room on second floor (located in the front) and the ground floor includes: living room, dining room, hallway and guest bathroom, kitchen, a small courtyard and one bedroom with a full bathroom. The layout could be easily reconfigured and the house has great potential for additions.

##### _Original features_

*   **Fully tiled** floors with traditional **pasta** tiles
*   Beautiful **hard wood** doors
*   **Stone walls** (mamposteria)

##### _Great central location_

*   **3 blocks** from **Mejorada square**
*   **6 blocks** from the beautiful **La Plancha** park
*   **Within walking distance** from the **main square** (9 blocks), **Santa Lucía** (10 blocks) and all the main attractions of downtown

### Xmatkuil Ranch — Large Tranquil Country Property

### Expansive Estate with Pool, Tennis Court & 65,000 m² of Land in Xmatkuil

This impressive property offers a rare combination of vast land, recreational facilities, and comfortable living spaces, set on three adjoining lots totaling over 65,000 m² (more than 16 acres). Once a working sheep ranch, it is now a private residential retreat with excellent potential for a country estate, boutique project, or agricultural use. Located in Xmatkuil with easy access to main roads, it combines seclusion with convenience.

### Property Highlights

The residence features approximately 420 m² of construction, blending classic Yucatecan style with modern touches. While some areas could benefit from updating, the home is fully functional and currently occupied by the owners.

*   3 bedrooms and 3 bathrooms, including a spacious primary suite
*   Office, dining room, and functional kitchen
*   Large covered patio with signature arches, perfect for gatherings
*   New swimming pool set in a sunny courtyard
*   Tennis court for recreation
*   Laundry room, storage area, and ample parking

### Outdoor Space & Land

With over 6.5 hectares, the property offers endless opportunities from expanding residential areas to creating a sustainable farm, orchard, or equestrian facilities. Mature trees, open fields, and wide internal paths make the land easy to access and use.

### Location

Just minutes from Xmatkuil’s town center, the property is close to essential services yet enjoys a quiet, private setting. Mérida’s south side, including shopping, schools, and cultural attractions, is within a short drive.

### Key Details

*   Lot size: 65,000 m² (over 16 acres)
*   Construction: 420 m²
*   Use: Former ranch, now private residence
*   Amenities: Pool, tennis court, parking, storage, laundry

### 65-hectar Ranch!

Quintana Roo,

Yucatan

160.618 acre ranch (65-hectars) with ranch house and several “ranch hand” houses. Some of the workers houses have been renovated with the idea of using the ranch as a tourist attraction or nature-eco type hotel.

The ranch has a huge pool and party area. Stables, water wells, fencing, interior roads and an old hacienda in ruins. The property is filled with nature and wildlife. One hundred years ago, this was a beautiful working hacienda.

This beautiful property is locate close to the city of Quintana Roo, Yucatan close to the state of Quintana Roo. It is between the cities of Tunkas and Dzitas and about 40 kilometers from Izamal.

An extra “bonus” is that, due to the location, foreigner buyers do not need a Fideicomiso (bank-trust)!

This property price is linked to a price of $15,000,000.00 MXN Pesos and the USD price will change daily with the current exchange rate. Please check the current exchange rate for the USD price.

To see this beautiful ranch, contact Dr. Leroy Osmon 999-125-6196 or email: leroy.osmon@gmail.com

### Calle 66 Fixer – Great Santa Lucia – Santiago Location

Fixer Upper Colonial Home for Sale in Mérida Centro – Santa Lucía / Santiago Location with Pool Potential

This colonial fixer-upper in Mérida Centro presents a strong opportunity to acquire a **well-located property with renovation upside** in one of the city’s most desirable neighborhoods.

Situated in the Santa Lucía / Santiago area, the home is positioned within walking distance of restaurants, parks, and cultural attractions, making it ideal for buyers seeking both **lifestyle appeal and long-term investment value**.

With original architectural elements and a deep lot, the property offers a **flexible canvas for renovation, expansion, or redesign**.

### New Construction 3/2 In Chuburna Puerto

Chuburna Puerto,

Yucatan

New construction beach home with pool and rooftop terraces for sale in Chuburná Puerto, offering ocean and lagoon views in a quiet coastal community.

**New construction 3-bedroom beach home for sale in Chuburná Puerto, Yucatán with pool, rooftop terraces, and ocean and lagoon views in a quiet coastal setting.**

This newly built home in Chuburná Puerto offers a combination of **modern construction, coastal lifestyle, and strong rental potential** in one of the growing beach communities along the Yucatán Gulf Coast.

Located in a quiet area between Chelem and Chuburná, the property provides convenient access to restaurants, local shops, and pristine beaches, while maintaining a more relaxed and low-density environment compared to busier coastal areas.

The home features a functional layout with **two bedrooms on the main level and a private primary suite upstairs**, allowing for separation of living space and flexibility for guests or rental use. Multiple rooftop terraces offer elevated outdoor living areas with views of the Gulf of Mexico to the north and the ria (lagoon ecosystem) to the south, creating a unique dual-water perspective.

Interior finishes include custom cabinetry, granite countertops, refurbished antique cedar doors, air conditioning in each bedroom, and non-slip flooring designed for coastal conditions. The home is equipped with a pressurized water system and is offered with appliances included, making it ready for immediate use.

Outdoor space is designed for both relaxation and entertaining, featuring a **large, deep swimming pool** suitable for cooling off in the Yucatán climate or for recreational use. The fully walled property with aluminum entry gate provides privacy and security, along with off-street parking.

From an investment perspective, this property benefits from its **new construction condition, rooftop views, and location within an expanding coastal corridor**. Homes in this price range that offer both modern systems and outdoor lifestyle features are increasingly attractive to buyers seeking a second home or vacation rental property near Mérida.

This property may appeal to buyers looking for a **turnkey beach home, a rental-friendly coastal investment, or a full-time residence with access to nature and water views**. Its combination of layout, location, and outdoor living spaces positions it as a practical and versatile option within the Yucatán beach real estate market.

### Calle 57 Centro Charmer — A Compact Home With Big Potential

Set along a quiet stretch of Calle 57, this cozy one-bedroom home offers classic Centro character and a great opportunity for anyone looking to personalize and modernize a small property in a desirable location.

Inside, the home features a simple, traditional layout with a comfortable living room, an eat-in kitchen, and a bedroom with an adjoining bathroom. The spaces are functional as-is, but ready for updates—perfect for buyers who enjoy improving a property without taking on a full-scale renovation.

A private rear patio offers room for outdoor seating, tropical plants, or even a petite plunge pool, adding lifestyle value without increasing maintenance.

With its walkable location and manageable size, this home is ideal as a starter property, renovation project, long-term rental, or an affordable base in the heart of Mérida.

### **Highlights**

*   Great Centro location with excellent walkability
*   Traditional layout with space ready for modernization
*   Living room, kitchen/dining area, bedroom, and bathroom
*   Private patio with potential for upgrades
*   Small footprint = low maintenance and affordable improvements
*   Ideal for personal use, rental investment, or renovation project

### Oceanfront Estate for Sale in Telchac Puerto Mexico | Luxury Beachfront Home

**Oceanfront Estate for Sale in Telchac Puerto Mexico | Luxury Beachfront Home**

Positioned directly on the pristine shoreline of the Gulf of Mexico, this exceptional **oceanfront estate for sale in Telchac Puerto, Yucatán Mexico** offers a rare combination of privacy, scale, and uninterrupted sea views—located less than one hour from Mérida and its international airport.

Designed to capture natural light, refreshing coastal breezes, and panoramic water vistas, the residence blends refined architecture with relaxed beachfront elegance. Offered as a turnkey opportunity, this luxury home is ideal for buyers seeking a private retreat, second home, or high-value investment on the Yucatán coast.

Property Features
-----------------

*   True **beachfront frontage** with direct private access to the sand
*   Expansive indoor-outdoor living spaces with oversized terraces
*   Resort-style **infinity pool** overlooking the Gulf of Mexico
*   Open-concept great room with seamless flow between living, dining, and kitchen areas
*   Spacious bedroom suites designed for comfort and privacy
*   High-quality construction and premium finishes throughout
*   Fully walled and secure property for peace of mind
*   Custom doors, cabinetry, and closets
*   **8 bathrooms total:** 4 full baths, 3 half baths, plus 1 outdoor poolside shower
*   Dumbwaiter-ready system for easy transport of food and supplies from kitchen to rooftop deck

Designed for Coastal Living
---------------------------

Every major living space is oriented toward the water, creating a constant connection to the sea. Whether entertaining guests, enjoying a peaceful morning coffee, or watching spectacular sunsets over the Gulf, this home delivers the elevated lifestyle buyers imagine when searching for a luxury beachfront property in Mexico.

Investment Opportunity in Telchac Puerto
----------------------------------------

Beachfront homes in **Telchac Puerto** continue to attract growing interest from both domestic and international buyers looking for:

*   A second home in Mexico with long-term appreciation potential
*   A luxury vacation rental with strong seasonal demand
*   A private coastal residence near a vibrant international city
*   Diversification through ownership in an emerging luxury market

With convenient access to Mérida—known for world-class dining, culture, healthcare, and international connectivity—this property offers an ideal balance of seclusion and convenience.

A Rare Beachfront Offering
--------------------------

Luxury oceanfront estates of this caliber, with true beachfront frontage, privacy, and substantial scale, are increasingly limited along the Yucatán coastline. This is a rare opportunity to secure one of the region’s premier **beachfront homes for sale in Telchac Puerto Mexico**.

### Hacienda-Style Estate on 1 Hectare Near Mérida

Verdant – Hacienda – Secluded – Potential – Grand

### Timeless Tranquility at Hacienda San José Chakan

Escape to this lush estate nestled within the peaceful enclave of Hacienda San José Chakan—where colonial charm meets country living. Set on over 10,000 m² of land and surrounded by mature palms, native flora, and open skies, this private retreat offers expansive living both indoors and out.

### Main Residence

The main house unfolds across 673 m² of construction, centered around an open-concept layout with vaulted ceilings and large windows that bathe the interiors in natural light. A generous living and dining area flows seamlessly to the garden and pool, creating a perfect setting for entertaining or relaxation. The fully equipped kitchen offers ample storage and workspace for home chefs.

You’ll find four bedrooms, each with its own bathroom. The primary suite includes two full bathrooms and dual walk-in closets, providing comfort and privacy at an elevated level. An additional home office, guest half bath, laundry room, and 60 m² storage bodega complete the practical layout.

### Guest & Outdoor Living

Beyond the main home, a guest house with two bedrooms and private baths offers autonomy for visiting family or the potential for rental income. There’s also a children’s room with bathroom, ideal for young guests or as an additional studio space.

Step outside into a landscape that evokes hacienda grandeur—winding garden paths, towering palms, and bursts of bougainvillea surround a large swimming pool with sun-drenched terraces. A three-car carport, service bathroom with shower, and wide open areas for further cultivation or equestrian use complete the outdoor features.

Progreso,

La Bocania is a one-of-a-kind beachfront property combining a boutique hotel and a private owner’s residence in the heart of Progreso’s Malecón. With sweeping views of the Gulf of Mexico, this property merges lifestyle and investment, offering luxury accommodations, commercial potential, and all the comforts of a seaside home just 30 minutes from Mérida.

### Boutique Hotel Experience

Guests are welcomed into a stylish reception area and boutique shop, setting the tone for a personalized stay. The hotel is designed with comfort and relaxation in mind: a shimmering pool, a jacuzzi, and landscaped gardens create an inviting atmosphere. Shaded terraces, lounge spaces, and even an ice bath elevate the guest experience.

Each guest suite is thoughtfully appointed with its own ensuite bathroom and tasteful finishes. The layout ensures privacy for guests while also creating a sense of community around the common areas.

### Owner’s Private Residence

The private residence offers a sanctuary within the property. With its own spacious living areas, a fully equipped kitchen, and a grand terrace overlooking the Gulf, it is perfectly suited for full-time living. The residence features a luxurious guest suite with a double shower and steambath, while additional bedrooms all include ensuite bathrooms for convenience.

The rooftop is a true highlight: a second pool, sun terraces, and open-air dining space combine panoramic views with effortless entertaining. Whether for private use or guest enjoyment, this area embodies coastal luxury.

### Features & Infrastructure

This property stands out not only for its design but also for its robust infrastructure and thoughtful amenities:

*   8 bedrooms and 8 ensuite bathrooms (hotel + owner’s residence)
*   3 additional separate bathrooms
*   2 fully equipped kitchens
*   2 pools, 1 jacuzzi, and an ice bath
*   Private water well
*   6 tinacos (6,000 liter capacity) for backup water supply
*   3 water heaters and a water pressure system
*   Water softener for consistent water quality
*   Freight elevator for moving heavy furniture
*   Potential kitesurf container/restaurant setup
*   2 separate laundry rooms with washer/dryer

### Location & Lifestyle

Located directly on Progreso’s vibrant Malecón, La Bocania is within walking distance of the pier, cafés, restaurants, and water sports. Guests enjoy easy access to Mérida’s cultural attractions, cenotes, and archaeological sites, while owners benefit from a thriving tourist hub that ensures consistent demand.

### Beachfront. Beautiful. Tranquil!!!

Santa Clara,

Yucatan

This beautiful 1-bedroom and 1-bathroom beachfront home is a great buy. It is located in the very tranquil fishing village of Santa Clara, East of Progreso and Telchac.

If you are looking for the perfect retreat from the noise and crazy pace of today’s life, you’ve found it! This is life at a very different pace.

The front porch offers a full view of the beach. The bedroom also has a beautiful view of the Gulf of Mexico. There is a nice size living room, a large bathroom and a colorful Mexican-style kitchen. The covered parking area has a very beautiful palapa and could be used for outdoor cooking.

In addition to the front and back patios, there is a wonderful rooftop patio with a million-dollar view that could be turned into a second bedroom with bath.

The lot is an ample size at 387.40 m2 (4169.94 square feet).

With the beautiful coconut trees in the front yard, a hammock on the front porch, with the sound of the waves–and drinking your favorite beverage–this is heaven! All this accompanied by seabirds and songbirds, clear skies and mild temperatures.

This beauty may be a bit off-the-beaten-path, but if you want peace in your life surrounded by beauty (and fresh fish straight from the boat every day), this is your dream home. THIS IS YOUR PERFECT RETIREMENT HOME.

As an extra bonus, it is furnished AND located 1 block from a very good-quality restaurant!

The house has been very well-maintained (touch-up work will be addressed before the sale of the property).

### Hacienda Santo Domingo – Acanceh, Yucatán

Hacienda Santo Domingo is a rare legacy estate that blends Yucatán’s colonial soul with modern potential. Set on more than 1.3 hectares of landscaped grounds, with ten private suites, fountains, gardens, and a striking events pavilion, it’s a property designed for visionaries — whether as a boutique hotel, cultural venue, or a personal sanctuary.

### Property Highlights

*   Lot size: 13,134 m² (approx. 1.3 hectares)
*   Construction: 644 m²
*   Bedrooms: 10 ensuite suites, including a principal suite in the original hacienda structure
*   Expansive swimming pool framed by terraces and shaded lounging areas
*   Two-story event pavilion with panoramic views over an artificial lake
*   Rustic stone walkways linking guest rooms and outdoor spaces
*   Mature gardens with fountains, koi ponds, irrigation canals, and a historic windmill
*   Gated access with parking for 10+ cars

### The Estate

Arrive through a stone entry that opens onto sweeping lawns, where the restored façade of Hacienda Santo Domingo stands with timeless dignity. Inside the main house, high ceilings, arched corridors, and thick stone walls reflect centuries of craftsmanship. Guest suites are distributed across the property, creating a sense of privacy while keeping everything connected by tree-shaded paths.

An open-air kitchen with garden views anchors the social heart of the hacienda, while the pool and surrounding terraces provide relaxed gathering spots. Beyond, a two-story event structure rises dramatically beside the lake, setting the stage for weddings, cultural events, or retreats.

### Lifestyle & Potential

Every corner of the hacienda tells a story — from the fountains and koi ponds to the traditional windmill that marks the horizon. Mature tropical trees and lush gardens create a sense of peace and seclusion, yet the property remains close enough to Mérida for convenience.

Hacienda Santo Domingo is ideal for those who see real estate not only as a home or business, but as a living legacy. With legal ease for foreign ownership and infrastructure already in place, it’s ready to be reimagined into something extraordinary.

### Fabulous Solar Quinta Tepakan

Set within the peaceful Mayan pueblo of Tepakán, this beautifully restored colonial Quinta blends historic character with quiet countryside living. Hardwood trunk-beam ceilings, glowing pasta-tile floors, restored doors and windows, and antique furnishings give the home an atmosphere of warmth and authenticity.

The interiors flow with soft natural light and elegant illumination, leading to a thoughtfully updated cook’s kitchen finished with marble counters. The primary suite opens to a private outdoor soaking tub surrounded by greenery — a calm retreat for slow mornings and long, unhurried evenings. A separate guest casita with its own bath offers complete independence for visitors.

Outside, the property unfolds into a lush garden sanctuary with mature trees, shaded paths, and a filtered swimming pool set beside a graceful arched terrace. With solar panels, three freshwater wells, full irrigation, and a pressurized water system, the grounds remain vibrant in every season. Parking is conveniently located on the side, discreet yet accessible.

### Key Features

• Fully renewed infrastructure — electrical, plumbing, A/C units, fans, pumps, switches  
• Primary suite with outdoor soaking tub  
• Independent guest casita with full bath  
• Mature gardens with irrigation  
• Filtered pool  
• Solar power system

Tepakán is known for its gentle pace and authenticity. A handful of expatriates live in the pueblo, but the atmosphere remains predominantly local, traditional, and welcoming. A small market sits just steps away for essentials. To get a better sense of life in Tepakán, be sure to check out this article from Yucatán Magazine: “Life Moves Slowly in Tepakán, an Authentic Yucatán Pueblo.” [Click Here For Article](https://yucatanmagazine.com/life-moves-slowly-in-tepakan-an-authentic-yucatan-pueblo/)

The new Mayan Train station in Izamal is just 18 minutes away, and Mérida’s International Airport is a comfortable 1 hour 20 minutes.

A rare countryside estate restored with care, charm, and privacy — a Quinta designed to be lived in deeply and appreciated every day.

### Studentia – Perfect Student Suites On Presale

Studentia is a fantastic project located near the Anahuac Mayab University, the most prestigious in Merida, and the Yucatan Country Club. The project includes 200 suites divided in two towers and it’s conceived as a self-contained community that can provide all the services and ammenities needed, within a modern and innovative compound.

**Models and prices:**

There are two models of suites: _single_ and _double_. Both have the same space and include the same equipment in the living area.

In bedrooms, the single suite includes: _one double bed, desk and closet_; the double includes: _two single beds,_ _two closets and and two desks_.

### Antiik

Aantik – Where History Meets Modern Living in Mérida

Discover Aantik, a groundbreaking project located in the rapidly growing district of Santa Gertrudis Copó, designed by the renowned SUA Desarrollos and Sordo Madaleno Arquitectos. Aantik blends the rich history of Mérida with cutting-edge architecture, creating an unparalleled living experience that honors the past while embracing the future.

This visionary development offers a variety of residential, commercial, and wellness spaces, catering to those seeking a luxurious yet meaningful lifestyle.

Features and Amenities:

– 24 Elevated Top Residences with 3 bedrooms, ranging from 150m² to 300m²  
– 98 Soul I and Soul II units, including studios, 1 and 2-bedroom apartments, from 52m² to 113m²  
– 45 high-end medical offices, ranging from 41m² to 92m²  
– Wellness Center featuring a spa, fitness studios, a yoga deck, and wellness-oriented shops  
– Commercial area with 57 retail units (100m² to 1,100m²), bringing high-end dining, cafés, and specialty stores to your doorstep  
– Owners Lounge, game room, cinema, library, golf simulator, and coworking spaces for community engagement  
– Multiple pools, including a pool bar and a relaxation-focused spa

Amenities for Wellness and Recreation:

– Paddle court, fitness studios, and yoga deck  
– Dog park, community garden, jogging track, and playground for children  
– Soul I and II Living Spaces feature access to laundry rooms, coworking spaces, and specialized fitness facilities  
– A multi-level commercial hub with a central shopping experience offering a dynamic mix of local and international brands

Location: Nestled in Santa Gertrudis Copó, Aantik places you in one of Mérida’s most sought-after locations with close proximity to:

La Isla Mérida Mall: 30-second drive  
City Center: 5-minute drive  
Altabrisa Shopping Center: 15-minute drive  
El Faro Hospital: 1-minute drive  
Star Médica Hospital: 15-minute drive  
Marista University: 5-minute drive  
Paseo de Montejo: 30-minute drive  
Mérida International Airport: 35-minute drive

A Symbol of Innovation: Aantik sets a new standard for luxury living, blending historical richness with cutting-edge design. Whether you are looking for a peaceful sanctuary, a vibrant community, or a dynamic work-life balance, Aantik provides the perfect space to elevate your lifestyle in the heart of Mérida.

### La Fogata — Stylish North Merida Community Home

Lakeside Minimalism in Altozano – Cluster Fogata  
_Contemporary Design | Double-Height Living | Lake Views_

Welcome to your next chapter in Altozano, one of Mérida’s most sought-after gated communities. This brand new residence in _Cluster Fogata_ blends clean architectural lines with warm materials like tzalam wood and marble-look finishes, all backdropped by a private lake view and lush surroundings.

### Interior Highlights:

*   Dramatic double-height entry with floor-to-ceiling glass and floating marble staircase
*   Refined kitchen with quartz countertops, integrated cooktop island, and custom wood cabinetry
*   4 bedrooms, each with private bath and built-in closets
*   Two upstairs bedrooms with balconies overlooking the lake
*   Ground-floor bedroom/study with full bath—perfect for guests or a home office
*   Porcelain flooring, pedestal sinks, and European aluminum windows throughout
*   Generous walk-in closet in the master suite

### Exterior & Amenities:

*   Sleek brick lattice façade with custom design
*   Covered two-car parking
*   Private terrace and plunge pool with Venetian and chukum finish, plus a cascading water feature
*   Utility room, pantry, storage, and laundry area
*   180m² lot | 237m² construction

### Comfort & Systems:

*   Tzalam hardwood doors
*   AC units included
*   Water heater, stationary gas tank, tinaco, and gas line network with 3 access points
*   Ceiling height: 2.85m

### Altozano Community:

*   Gated residential project with full construction permits and structural certification
*   Located in Cluster Fogata, comprising 290 homes
*   Top-tier amenities: padel/tennis courts, soccer field, swimming pool, full gym, spinning/yoga studios, spa, kids club, restaurant, and event spaces
*   24/7 gated security, concrete roads, full infrastructure (potable water, drainage, street lighting, underground electricity)

HOA Fee: $1,080 MXN/month – includes security, landscaping, common areas, trash removal, fumigation, and lake maintenance

### Casa Itzé — Contemporary Comfort with Style and Security

Located in the tranquil and well-established Fraccionamiento Mirova, Casa Itzé offers a harmonious balance of design, functionality, and modern comfort. Set on a 351 m² lot with 302 m² of construction across two levels, this home combines spacious interiors with smart features and low-maintenance outdoor living.

Inside, the open-concept living and dining area is enhanced by double-height ceilings and abundant natural light. A flexible upstairs landing works perfectly as an office or reading nook, while the interior laundry and studio area add everyday practicality.

Each of the three ensuite bedrooms includes air conditioning, ceiling fans, built-in wooden closets, and private balconies. The kitchen features black granite countertops, a 28 ft³ refrigerator, five-burner gas stovetop, oven, microwave, and stacking washer/dryer—all included. Throughout the home, you’ll find neutral non-slip porcelain floors, designer lighting, and keyless entry with a front gate monitor for security and convenience.

Outdoors, a covered terrace opens to a 10’ × 20’ infinity-edge Chukum pool with an outdoor shower, surrounded by a low-maintenance yard accented with solar lighting—ideal for entertaining. The covered two-car garage features electric security gates, and the entire property is fully walled with electric perimeter fencing. A 6’ × 7’ storage bodega provides additional space for tools or equipment.

Casa Itzé can be sold partially furnished, making it an easy move-in option for those seeking a secure, stylish, and turn-key home in Mérida.

### Large Santiago To Renovate — Great Bones & Lot Size

Colonial   \*  Patio   \*  Garden   \*  Expansion   \*  Charm

Nestled on Calle 82 in the sought-after Santiago neighborhood, this large colonial property boasts timeless architectural charm and endless possibilities. Original beamed ceilings greet you as you step into the spacious living and dining areas, which flow seamlessly into a functional kitchen.

Beyond the kitchen, a charming patio with a fountain provides a tranquil escape, leading to two well-sized bedrooms. One bedroom features an ensuite bathroom, while the second bedroom has access to the main house bathroom.

The property’s true gem lies in its expansive backyard. With ample space to add two casitas and a generously sized swimming pool, the possibilities for creating a dream retreat are virtually limitless.

Located just a short walk from Santiago Park, this home offers a unique combination of historic character and development potential.

Don’t miss your opportunity to create a custom oasis in one of Mérida’s most desirable neighborhoods.

### Vintage Soaring Colonial – Spacious Home & Gardens

**Large colonial estate for sale in Telchac Pueblo, Yucatán with 2,280 m² of land, mature gardens, and development potential just minutes from the beach.**

This spacious colonial-style property in Telchac Pueblo offers a rare opportunity to acquire a **large landholding with existing construction, infrastructure, and agricultural features** in a quiet and well-located town near the Yucatán coast.

Set on approximately 2,280 m² of land with a wide 30-meter frontage, the property provides significantly more space than typical homes in the region. The existing 350 m² construction includes high colonial ceilings, solid hardwood doors and windows, a large kitchen with pantry, and multiple interior spaces that can be reconfigured or expanded depending on the buyer’s vision.

The property is surrounded by a mature tropical garden with established fruit trees including lime, orange, mango, mamey, and dragon fruit, creating a private and natural setting. Additional infrastructure includes two water wells, a windmill, a large water storage system, irrigation, and city water connection, making the property well suited for both residential and agricultural use.

A large carport with space for multiple vehicles adds practicality, while the expansive lot allows for future additions such as a pool, guest casitas, or additional structures. The size and layout of the land make it especially flexible for redevelopment or multi-use design.

The location is a key advantage. The property is located just one block from the town square of Telchac Pueblo, with immediate access to markets, local shops, and daily services. The beach community of Telchac Puerto is approximately 15 minutes away, while the city of Mérida and its international airport are within roughly one hour.

From an investment perspective, this property stands out due to its **land size, infrastructure, and relatively low entry price for this scale of property**. Large parcels with existing construction in this region are increasingly limited and offer multiple potential use cases, including:

*   Private estate with extensive gardens
*   Renovation and expansion project
*   Multi-structure residential compound
*   Agricultural or eco-lifestyle property
*   Long-term land investment near the coast

This property may appeal to buyers seeking a **large home site, renovation project, or lifestyle property with space and flexibility**, as well as investors looking for land-based opportunities near the growing Yucatán beach corridor.

### Casa Mangos Restored Corner Colonial In Merida Centro

**Restored colonial corner home for sale in Mérida Centro with 2 bedrooms, 3 bathrooms, original pasta tile floors, and move-in-ready layout in a growing residential area.**

This restored colonial home in Mérida Centro offers a combination of **historic architectural character, functional living space, and corner-lot positioning** in a developing area just south of the historic core.

Situated on a corner lot, the property benefits from improved natural light, ventilation, and access compared to interior properties. The home includes **2 bedrooms and 3 bathrooms**, along with original design elements such as pasta tile floors, hardwood doors, and traditional construction details that reflect Mérida’s colonial style.

The property has already undergone restoration, allowing for immediate use while still offering opportunities for customization or future upgrades depending on the buyer’s goals. Interior spaces include a kitchen, living and dining areas, and additional flexible space that can be used as an office, studio, or guest area.

Outdoor features include a patio and small pool area, creating usable outdoor living space that can be further enhanced with landscaping or shade structures. The layout supports a balance of indoor and outdoor living, which is a key value driver in Centro Mérida properties.

The location places the home in a residential area just south of the main historic districts, providing access to downtown Mérida while offering a quieter and more local environment. This part of Centro continues to attract buyers seeking **better value relative to Santiago, Santa Ana, and other central neighborhoods**.

From an investment perspective, this property stands out due to its **corner lot, restored condition, and accessible price point within Centro Mérida**. Homes that combine original character with functional upgrades are increasingly desirable for buyers who want to avoid full renovation projects.

This property may appeal to buyers seeking a **move-in-ready colonial home, a second home in Mérida, or a rental-friendly property with potential for future improvements**. Its combination of location, character, and usability positions it as a practical option within the Centro market.

### Chembech Canvas – Spacious Home Ready for Reinvention

 Spacious · Gutted  · Project · Potential  · Location

**Sprawling Property in Chembech – 503 m² Lot, 442 m² Construction**

Located on Calle 38 in the traditional neighborhood of Chembech, this spacious property is ideal for anyone looking to take on a rewarding renovation project with strong long-term potential.

The lot measures 503 m² with 442 m² of construction, offering an impressive footprint for the area. Inside, the layout is extensive and adaptable — featuring multiple living areas, several bedrooms, an oversized bathroom, and a fully equipped kitchen. The back of the home opens to a semi-covered patio and a private outdoor space with ample room for a garden or pool.

The property has great structure, generous dimensions, and plenty of character, providing a solid foundation for a beautiful transformation. Situated in a well-connected neighborhood just minutes from Centro and La Plancha, this is a rare opportunity to create something exceptional without paying Centro prices.

### Casa 44

Turnkey   \*  Oasis   \*  Timeless   \*    Location   \*  Unique

Nestled in the heart of Mejorada, this beautifully renovated 2-bedroom, 2-bathroom home blends historic character with modern comforts. Featuring stunning pasta tile floors and exposed mampostería walls, this single-level property offers timeless appeal with a touch of contemporary elegance.

The home comes fully furnished and move-in ready, with an open-concept living and dining area that flows seamlessly into the well-equipped kitchen, complete with a refrigerator, stove, and ample storage. Air conditioning throughout ensures year-round comfort.

Both bedrooms are spacious and inviting, each with en-suite bathrooms and built-in storage. Step outside to a private swimming pool, perfect for cooling off, while the on-property parking space provides convenience in this sought-after neighborhood.

Located just minutes from Mérida’s top landmarks:

La Plancha Park – 5 min  
Paseo de Montejo – 6 min  
Plaza Principal & Mérida Cathedral – 7 min  
Mérida International Airport – 15 min  
La Isla & Harbor Mall – 20 min

A rare find in Mejorada—historic charm, modern upgrades, and prime location in one perfect package.

Location     \*     Cheerful     \*     Open     \*     Clean     \*     Remodeled

**Fully remodeled colonial home for sale in Mérida Centro near Santiago with heated pool, garage, and turnkey finishes in a quiet, walkable Centro location.**

This bright, fully renovated colonial home in Mérida Centro offers a combination of **modern upgrades, indoor-outdoor living, and a quiet residential setting** within walking distance of some of the city’s most desirable neighborhoods.

Remodeled in 2022, the home has been updated with new systems and finishes while preserving the charm of traditional Yucatán architecture. Located on a quiet street between Santiago and Santa Ana, the property is positioned for both **lifestyle living and long-term value**, with easy access to parks, restaurants, and central Mérida.

Set on a 286.8 m² lot with approximately 218 m² of construction, the home features an open floor plan designed for comfort and usability. Interior highlights include a spacious kitchen with crema Maya countertops, exposed stonework, skylights for natural light, and air conditioning throughout. Updated electrical, plumbing, and pressurized water systems provide modern reliability, while appliances and most furnishings are included for immediate use.

Outdoor spaces are designed for both relaxation and entertaining, with a **heated and filtered swimming pool, landscaped patio, and sunroom** that extends the living area. The inclusion of a garage or carport is a valuable feature in this part of Centro, where off-street parking is limited.

The location is a key advantage. The property is approximately five blocks from Parque Santiago, six blocks from Santa Ana and Paseo de Montejo, and seven blocks from Calle 47’s dining corridor, placing it within walking distance of Mérida’s most active cultural and culinary areas. Major shopping centers and the airport are within a 20-minute drive.

From an investment perspective, this property benefits from its **turnkey condition, walkable location, and desirable mid-market price point**. Fully remodeled homes in this area with a heated pool and parking are relatively limited and tend to attract consistent interest from both international buyers and renters.

This property may appeal to buyers seeking a **full-time residence in Mérida Centro, a second home, or a rental-ready property** with strong usability and resale potential. Its combination of quiet location, modern upgrades, and proximity to key landmarks positions it as a well-balanced option within the Mérida real estate market.

### Casa Colonial 44

Casa Centro 44 is a thoughtfully restored Centro home blending historic character with contemporary functionality. The home opens through a striking columned entry corridor illuminated by soft natural light, leading into a sequence of spaces defined by original floors, high ceilings, and custom woodwork.

With approximately 120m² of construction on a 6.90m x 19.30m lot, the layout is efficient yet flexible — offering two bedrooms with en-suite bathrooms plus a spacious studio that easily functions as a third sleeping area or creative workspace. The kitchen-dining area anchors the center of the home, while the rear terrace and compact plunge pool create a private outdoor retreat.

Positioned on Calle 44 between 65 and 67, the property sits within walking distance of Parque La Plancha and just minutes from Mérida’s historic core, making it an appealing option for full-time living, seasonal use, or rental investment.

### Property Highlights

• Approx. 120 m² construction on a 6.90m x 19.30m lot  
• 2 bedrooms with en-suite bathrooms  
• Large studio / guest room with built-in wood library  
• High ceilings with indirect natural light corridors  
• Kitchen with wood cabinetry and electric burner grill  
• Ceiling fans and air-conditioning throughout  
• Custom wood closets and cabinetry  
• Private terrace with garden area  
• Plunge pool approx. 1.50m x 3.00m  
• Flexible layout ideal for live/work or rental use

### Layout & Spaces

The front portion of the home includes an airy access hall and a generous studio space measuring roughly 4.70m x 4.20m. Toward the center, Bedroom One features original flooring, wood closets, and its own bathroom, while the kitchen-dining area creates a natural social hub.

At the rear, Bedroom Two opens toward the terrace and garden area, offering privacy and direct outdoor access. The plunge pool adds a refreshing focal point without sacrificing usable patio space.

### Nearby Landmarks & Travel Times

• La Plancha Park – approx. 5 blocks  
• Paseo de Montejo – approx. 6 min drive  
• Plaza Principal – approx. 5 min drive  
• Mérida Cathedral – approx. 5 min drive  
• Mérida International Airport – approx. 20 min drive  
• La Isla Mall – approx. 25 min drive  
• Harbor Mall – approx. 20 min drive

### Sophisticated Turn-key Designer’s Home

This is a remarkable property with a unique interior design, full of details in every space. It’s located in a quiet street only a few blocks away from Mejorada park and the new Parque de la Plancha, East of the main square. Every piece of furniture and decoration are meant to create enjoyable spaces in a peaceful environment.

The house includes:  
– Cozy living room with colonial beamed ceiling  
– Elegant dining room  
– Equipped kitchen with beautiful cabinetry  
– Small appliance cabinet  
– Powder room  
– Large family room with garden views  
– Master bedroom on second floor with closet and spacious bathroom  
– Second bedroom also on second floor, with full bathroom  
– Sunny first courtyard with custom made fountain and open terrace  
– Covered terrace with sink  
– Storage  
– Shady second courtyard with plants and trees  
– Large guest apartment with twin beds, closet, full bathroom, kitchenette with dining area, and private garden

Some of the house features are:  
– Great natural light  
– Air conditioning in every room (5 in total)  
– Beautiful chandeliers, lamps and light fixtures  
– Carved stone sinks in bathrooms  
– Hand-picked, great quality funiture, artwork and decorations  
– Interesting mix of old and new construction  
– Plumbing for washing machine

El terreno está ubicado al pie de la carretera Mérida-Progreso, en las cercanías del poblado de Tamanché, lo que ha hecho que su ubicación sea una de las mejores de la zona gracias a su fácil conectividad con las ciudades de Mérida y Progreso, ya que se encuentra a solo pocos minutos del anillo periférico de Mérida y del Puerto de Progreso y, además, tiene acceso a todos los servicios. Está rodeado de desarrollos residenciales premium y comerciales, lo que lo convierte en una opción muy atractiva para inversionistas y promotores inmobiliarios. Se encuentra próximo a escuelas, parques y una iglesia, ofreciendo alta calidad de vida para los posibles futuros residentes.

La carretera Mérida-Progreso conecta la ciudad de Mérida con el puerto más importante de Yucatán, Progreso, en cuya infraestructura portuaria de ha hecho una enorme inversión, de alrededor de 29 mil millones de pesos, con el objetivo de ampliarlo, modernizarlo y convertirlo en unos de los principales puertos del país. Esta inversión beneficia a empresas locales e internacionales impulsando el comercio exterior, generando nuevos empleos, atrayendo más inversionistas e incrementando el desarrollo regional, lo que conlleva beneficios importantes no solo a Progreso y a Mérida, sino a toda la península de Yucatán y otros Estados vecinos, como Tabasco y Chiapas. Este gran desarrollo de la zona, sumado al enorme crecimiento al norte de la ciudad de Mérida, provoca que, naturalmente, la carretera Mérida-Progreso sea el principal foco de atención para inversionistas debido al gran incremento de la plusvalía inmobiliaria, puesto que es la única vía que conecta el Puerto de Progreso con la bella ciudad de Mérida. La inversión en esta zona asegura un lugar importante en la ola de crecimiento que está teniendo lugar actualmente.

### Super Solar Powered Colonial – Santiago

**Solar-powered colonial home for sale in Santiago, Mérida Centro with 2 bedrooms, wide 12-meter frontage, garage, and turnkey living in a prime walkable location.**

This energy-efficient home in Santiago offers a rare combination of **modern infrastructure, colonial character, and reduced operating costs** in one of Mérida Centro’s most desirable and walkable neighborhoods.

Set on a generous lot with approximately 12 meters of frontage, the property provides significantly more width than many traditional Centro homes. This allows for improved natural light, airflow, and a more open and functional layout. The home includes **2 bedrooms and 2.5 bathrooms**, designed for comfortable daily living and easy maintenance.

A key feature of this property is its **solar power system**, which helps reduce electricity costs and supports long-term sustainability—an important advantage in Mérida’s climate for both homeowners and rental investors.

Interior spaces combine traditional colonial elements with modern functionality, creating a home that is both practical and consistent with the architectural style of the area. The layout supports indoor-outdoor living and offers flexibility for enhancing outdoor areas, including patio or pool improvements.

The location in Santiago is a major advantage. The home is within walking distance of Parque Santiago, local markets, restaurants, and Mérida Centro’s main attractions. Paseo de Montejo and the city’s restaurant corridor are also easily accessible, making this a highly desirable location for both residents and visitors.

The inclusion of a garage or off-street parking is a significant benefit, as this feature is relatively uncommon in Centro Mérida and adds both convenience and long-term value.

From an investment perspective, this property stands out due to its **solar efficiency, wide lot dimensions, and prime Centro location**. Homes in Santiago that combine these features are limited and tend to attract consistent demand from international buyers and renters.

This property may appeal to buyers seeking a **full-time residence, a second home, or a rental-ready property with low operating costs in Mérida Centro**. Its combination of location, efficiency, and usability positions it as a strong offering within the market.

### Casa El Turix

CASA EL TURIX

  
Casa El Turix is a compact yet highly intentional architectural intervention in one of Mérida Centro’s most historically layered neighborhoods. Conceived as a work of urban–architectural acupuncture, the project was designed, built, and fully equipped by Adagio Arquitectos, one of Mexico’s most respected architectural studios, known for landmark projects such as the Gran Museo del Mundo Maya and Hacienda Xcanatún.

Located just two blocks from Parque de la Mejorada, the home sits within a zone shaped by centuries of urban evolution. The property preserves the original front bay (_primera crujía_) dating from the 18th–19th century, while introducing contemporary volumes toward the rear to maximize light, flow, and livability within the site’s narrow proportions.

The contrast between restored heritage and modern construction is handled with restraint and precision—celebrating scale, texture, and proportion rather than excess.

### Property Overview

\-Construction: 115 m²  
\-Land: 95.62 m²  
\-Lot depth: 22.50 m  
\-Frontage: 4.25 m  
\-Year built: 2024–2025

### Layout

\-2 bedrooms  
\-2 full bathrooms  
\-1 half bathroom  
\-Open living / sitting area  
\-Kitchen with integrated dining  
\-Terrace

A compact pool finished in imported Sukabumi stone from Bali anchors the outdoor space, adding texture and a cooling focal point without overwhelming the footprint.

### Equipment & Systems

\-Fan & coil Trane air-conditioning system throughout (no mini-splits)  
\-Ceiling fans in bedrooms  
\-2 electric water heaters  
\-Hydraulic system with pressure booster  
\-Fully equipped kitchen: refrigerator, microwave, electric cooktop, extractor hood  
\-Digital lock on main entrance

### Finishes

\-Restored wooden beams, doors, and built-in closets  
\-Custom kitchen cabinetry with doors and drawers  
\-Natural aluminum window frames with clear glass  
\-Tempered safety glass on upper-level windows  
\-Granite countertops with leather finish  
\-Crema Maya stone floors and wall cladding throughout  
\-Handmade pasta tile rug in the living area  
\-Kohler bathroom fixtures and fittings  
\-Vinyl wall and ceiling paint; catalyzed paint on metal elements

Ceiling heights reach 4.70 m in the original historic volume and 2.70 m in the contemporary additions—enhancing airflow and spatial clarity.

### Landscaping

\-Finished gardens with curated planting, textures, and planters

### Future-Ready Preparations

\-Pre-installation for washer or washer–dryer in the kitchen area  
\-Terrace designed to allow a future additional bedroom or studio plus bathroom  
\-Structural and service preparation for a residential elevator  
\-Roof of the original front bay prepared for potential rooftop terrace use

### Colonial Santa Ana

Renovated Colonial Home for Sale in Santa Ana, Mérida – Turnkey 2-Bedroom Property with Pool, Garage, and Rooftop Deck
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

This renovated colonial home in **Santa Ana, Mérida** offers a combination of **historic character, modern upgrades, and walkable location** in one of Centro’s most desirable neighborhoods. The property includes **2 bedrooms, 2.5 bathrooms, a garage, filtered pool, rooftop deck, and a fully furnished turnkey setup**, making it attractive for full-time living, a second home, or rental use.

With **304.34 m² of land** on a **10-meter by 30.2-meter lot**, the home provides more width and usable interior volume than many Centro properties. Features such as **colonial beamed ceilings, decorative pasta tile floors, skylights, built-ins, quality sliders, air conditioning, granite countertops, pressurized water, LED lighting, and included appliances and furniture** help position it as a move-in-ready property with strong lifestyle appeal.

The location is a major selling point. According to the listing, the home is about **5 blocks from Parque Santa Ana and Paseo 60**, **7 blocks from Calle 47 and Paseo de Montejo**, around a **20-minute drive to Costco and north Mérida shopping**, and roughly **22 minutes from Mérida International Airport**. That combination of walkability and access supports both personal use and long-term resale desirability.

From an investment standpoint, this property may appeal to buyers looking for a **turnkey colonial home in Santa Ana**, especially because of its **garage, pool, furnished condition, and established Centro location**. Homes in this category tend to attract second-home buyers, relocators, and buyers who want a manageable historic property without taking on a major renovation project. This last point is an inference based on the home’s listed features and location.

### Genuine Art-Deco Home In Santiago

This **timeles four bedroom** **home** was restored preserving its original desirable features and adapted to modern comfort with a **brand new kitchen, two bathrooms, air conditioning, splash pool and garage**. The lot starts at **12 mts wide** that opens to 14.5 mts and includes a large mature garden.

The **front porch and balcony**, colorful **pasta tiles** with varied patterns, elegant doors and windows made of **wood and glass**, **high ceilings** and **arches** give this home its unique character. Unlike most of the old colonial homes, the house has windows in three directions, which allows good airflow and natural light in every room.

The **ground floor** includes:

*   Front yard and porch with arches
*   Garage for one car
*   Spacious living room
*   Dining room
*   Fully equipped kitchen with cabinets and granite counters
*   Two bedrooms (one currently used as a TV room) and one bathroom
*   Storage
*   Splash pool
*   Garden with various plants and trees

The **second floor** includes:

*   Two bedrooms and one bathroom
*   Living room / office
*   Front balcony with panoramic NE views
*   Large terrace
*   Laundry room with washer and dryer

Located in a quiet street in **Santiago**, within walking distance from local and touristic places of interest and surrounded by restaurants, coffee shops and all required services:

*   **4** blocks from **Santiago** park and market
*   **9** blocks from **Santa Lucia**
*   **10** blocks from **Plaza Grande** (main square)

Chelem,

Yucatan

Location, Location, Location!

Adorable beach home one block from a quiet area of beach with a short, 5 minute walk to dining, shopping, and the center of town.

Air conditioning throughout for those warm Yucatan days and tastefully decorated. A truly turnkey option on the Emerald Coast. Bring your bathing suit, toothbrush, and leave all those worries behind.

Generous 428 square meter lot with 170 square meters of construction and private, off street parking.

Offered furnished with appliances included.

### Casa La Buena Fe – Ermita

A corner property with genuine historic character, thoughtful updates, and an easy indoor–outdoor flow — all set in one of Mérida’s most traditional neighborhoods.

Step into a home that still carries its original soul: soaring ceilings with exposed beams, restored woodwork, and patterned pasta tiles that ground every room with warmth. The layout is practical and comfortable, with generous living spaces connected through a wide central hall that lets the home breathe.

The kitchen sits at the center of the house, designed with hand-crafted finishes and natural textures that keep the colonial mood intact. The principal bedroom is spacious, offering a walk-in closet and a distinctive glass-covered well feature that adds a layer of heritage without sacrificing comfort. A second bedroom and multiple full bathrooms make the home functional for daily living or for hosting long-term guests.

Outdoors, mature trees — including an impressive ceiba — create rare natural shade and a sense of privacy. The filtered pool is surrounded by calm sitting areas designed for relaxing, reading, or entertaining. Because of the corner position, the property gets excellent airflow and convenient access from two streets.

Recent upgrades include air-conditioning throughout, an electric garage door, water pressure and filtration improvements, a biodigester in good working order, and a full security camera system. The home is offered fully equipped with appliances and ready to enjoy.

Casa La Buena Fe is ideal for buyers seeking authentic architecture with meaningful updates in a neighborhood that continues to appreciate.

This modernized beach home in San Benito offers a rare combination of **elevated coastal living, dual water views, and fully updated infrastructure** along one of the most desirable stretches of the Yucatán Gulf Coast.

Originally remodeled in 2019, the property has been upgraded with high-quality materials and systems throughout, creating a **move-in-ready residence designed for both personal use and rental potential**. The four-level layout provides multiple living spaces, outdoor terraces, and a rooftop deck that maximizes views of the Gulf of Mexico to the north and the flamingo lagoon ecosystem to the south.

Interior features include large sliding doors for open indoor-outdoor living, air conditioning, modern kitchen and appliances, quality lighting, and furnishings included. The home is being sold fully equipped, including furniture, appliances, and household items, allowing for immediate occupancy or rental use.

Outdoor living is a key highlight of the property, with multiple terraces, a first-level deck with barbecue area, and a **rooftop pool and entertainment space** that offers panoramic coastal views. The elevated design provides airflow, natural light, and separation between living areas, making it ideal for hosting guests or creating a multi-level rental experience.

A unique feature of this property is the inclusion of a **separate “state-of-the-art” water pump house located on its own 10m x 40m lot**, providing additional infrastructure, utility capacity, and long-term operational value that is uncommon in beach properties.

The location in San Benito is a major advantage. The property sits along a wide and desirable stretch of coastline, approximately 17 minutes from Telchac Puerto, 25 minutes from Progreso, and about one hour from Mérida International Airport, offering both accessibility and a more private beach environment.

From an investment perspective, this property stands out due to its **turnkey condition, rooftop pool, dual water views, and additional infrastructure lot**. Beach homes with this combination of features are limited and tend to attract strong demand from buyers seeking vacation homes or income-producing coastal properties.

This property may appeal to buyers looking for a **beachfront or near-beach residence, a vacation rental property, or a second home with minimal setup required**. Its combination of layout, location, and systems positions it as a high-value offering within the Yucatán beach real estate market.

### Colonial Inspiration Santiago

**Luxury colonial home for sale in Santiago, Mérida Centro with 4 bedrooms, designer finishes, and walkable access to Parque Santiago, Paseo de Montejo, and the city’s main restaurant corridor.**

This architecturally inspired home in Santiago offers a rare combination of **modern design, high-end finishes, and prime Centro walkability** in one of Mérida’s most desirable and active neighborhoods.

Set on a 315.75 m² lot with approximately 8.5 meters of frontage and 36 meters of depth, the property provides a balanced layout that supports both **comfortable residential living and premium resale value**. The home includes **4 bedrooms and 5 bathrooms**, with a design focused on space, light, and usability.

The location is a key advantage. The Santiago market is just a short 3-minute walk, offering daily access to fresh food, restaurants, cafés, and local services. Mérida’s emerging restaurant corridor and Paseo de Montejo are approximately an 11-minute bike ride, placing the property within easy reach of the city’s most active cultural and dining areas.

Interior spaces are designed to combine **colonial proportions with contemporary functionality**, allowing for open living areas, natural light, and seamless indoor-outdoor integration. The layout supports both full-time living and hosting, with multiple bedrooms and flexible use spaces that can accommodate guests, office use, or rental potential.

From an investment perspective, this property stands out due to its **location, scale, and positioning within the upper tier of the Centro market**. Homes in Santiago that offer walkability combined with modern design and multiple bedrooms are limited and tend to attract strong demand from international buyers and relocation clients.

The lot depth allows for the integration of outdoor living areas such as a courtyard, garden, or pool, which are key features in high-end Centro properties and contribute significantly to both lifestyle appeal and long-term value.

This property may appeal to buyers seeking a **luxury residence in Mérida Centro, a second home with strong walkability, or a high-quality property with rental or resale potential**. Its combination of location, layout, and architectural concept positions it as a premium offering within the Mérida real estate market.

This is a very big and beautiful beach property that includes an additional smaller house on the lot behind the big house that is perfect for rental or live-in servants, guest, (mother-in-law?).

The main house has been renovated in the past 2 months so it is like new. The main house is 20 meters from the water with an amazing view from the front porch and the second floor terrazzo or the rooftop patio.

A larger kitchen with plenty of counter space. There is even a fireplace for cooking inside or for simply enjoying on a beautiful December night.

There is a garage with the main house and plenty of off road parking at the smaller house. Plenty of space to add a pool or to keep a large boat.

The master bedroom is located on the second floor and has a beautiful patio. Each patio has a sink and/or a bathroom. There is also an outdoor shower to rinse off after enjoying a swim in the Gulf and an outdoor sink outside to clean up or maybe even clean fish!

If you have ever wanted a big beautiful beach house and have high quality rental property, this is the place for you.

Both houses are to be sold as one. The original owner built them with the idea of a live-in husband and wife servant but the present owner has been using it as rental property. ### BEACHFRONT. CHUBURNÁ. AMAZING VIEWS!

Chuburná,

Yucatan

**Exclusive Gulf-Front Residence with Panoramic Views – Chuburná, Yucatán**

Experience refined coastal living in this exceptional third-floor corner residence overlooking the pristine waters of the Gulf of Mexico. Designed to capture uninterrupted 270° views, this fully renovated beachfront condo offers a rare combination of privacy, elegance, and breathtaking natural beauty.

Positioned beside the newly constructed Chuburná fishing pier, the property delivers a unique blend of charm and convenience—just minutes from Progreso and within easy reach of the cultural and culinary sophistication of Mérida.

This impeccably maintained 2-bedroom, 1-bath residence features:

*   Expansive open-concept living with seamless flow to a private oceanfront terrace
*   Floor-to-ceiling views that transform every moment—from sunrise to unforgettable sunset panoramas
*   A versatile guest suite or executive home office, complete with a custom-built Murphy bed
*   A well-appointed kitchen designed for both functionality and scenic dining
*   Dedicated laundry and storage space
*   A striking, architecturally inviting entry

As a premium corner unit, the residence is bathed in natural light and cooled by coastal breezes, creating an atmosphere of effortless sophistication.

**Resort-Style Amenities Include:**

*   Secure, gated grounds with assigned parking
*   A spacious pool and lounge area just steps from the shoreline
*   An elegant palapa-covered entertainment space, ideal for hosting or relaxing in style

Offered fully furnished, this turnkey property represents a compelling opportunity for discerning buyers seeking a luxury retreat, seasonal residence, or high-performing rental investment in one of the Yucatán coast’s most desirable enclaves.

With exceptionally low HOA fees of approximately $1,000 MXN per month, ownership remains both accessible and efficient.

This is more than a property—it’s a lifestyle defined by ocean views, warm breezes, and world-class sunsets.

### Eclectic & Sophisticated Downtown Property

Merida,

Yucatan

Only three properties in Merida were built in this unique design, evoking the greatness and allure of the 1800’s haciendas. This particular home has been completely renovated from top to bottom, having now modern facilities with unique design elements in every corner.

The house has a neo-gothic style mixed witht the traditional colonial, beeing the pointed arch the common element of the design that can be found in most rooms of the house as well as in the facade, which also decorated with balustrades and amazing iron work. Three majestic arches decorate the front porche, which leads to the central living area as you enter the house. This area connects with the bedrooms, the terrace and the kitchen.

The house has very high ceilngs and stone walls which in some rooms have been exposed for decorative purposes.

The house features:  
– Two large living rooms  
– Four bedrooms, three of them with private bathrooms  
– Spectacular terrace with arches and views to the garden  
– Large and modern kitchen with cabinets, pantry and granite counters  
– Guest bathroom and one additional full bathroom  
– Antique floors, doors and windows  
– Plunge pool accesible from the main bedroom, terrace and living room  
– Huge backyard with trees  
– Access for vehicles from the street onto the backyard

The surprise element of the house is a full size apartment in the basement, which includes one bedroom, kitchen/dining room and living room. Adjacent to this apartment there is a machine room, where all the equippment of the house is located.

The property has endless potential for additions, either as a private home or investment project (hotel, apartments, horizontal condos, etc.)

**Solar-powered multi-unit colonial property for sale in Santiago, Mérida Centro with rental units, large layout, and turnkey income potential in a prime walkable location.**

This spacious property in Santiago, Mérida offers a rare opportunity to acquire a **fully functional residential compound with multiple rental units and income-generating potential** in one of Centro’s most desirable and walkable neighborhoods.

The property is configured to support **multi-unit living, short-term rentals, or long-term income strategies**, making it suitable for buyers seeking both a residence and an investment asset. Its layout allows for separation between private living areas and guest accommodations, providing flexibility for owner occupancy while generating rental income.

A key feature of the property is its **solar power system**, which significantly reduces electricity costs and improves long-term operating efficiency—an important advantage for rental properties in Mérida’s climate.

Interior spaces reflect traditional colonial design combined with functional updates, creating an environment that is both attractive to guests and practical for daily living. The overall scale of the property supports multiple use cases, including a boutique rental operation, co-living concept, or extended family compound.

Outdoor areas provide shared and private spaces for relaxation, enhancing the appeal for tenants or guests and supporting higher occupancy potential. The size and configuration of the property allow for continued optimization or repositioning depending on the buyer’s goals.

The location in Santiago is a major advantage. Known for its vibrant atmosphere, local markets, restaurants, and cultural activity, the neighborhood consistently attracts both visitors and long-term residents. The property is within walking distance to Parque Santiago and Centro’s main attractions, while Mérida International Airport is approximately 14 minutes away.

From an investment perspective, this property stands out due to its **multi-unit configuration, solar efficiency, and prime Centro location**. Income-producing properties in Santiago with established layouts and infrastructure are limited and tend to attract strong demand from both domestic and international buyers.

This property may appeal to buyers seeking a **rental business, boutique hospitality concept, multi-family residence, or hybrid live-and-earn property in Mérida Centro**. Its combination of layout, location, and operational efficiency positions it as a high-value asset within the market.

### Fabulous Deep Chuburna Beach Lot

**Deep oceanfront beach lot for sale in Chuburná Puerto, Yucatán with 1,864 m² of land, 196-meter depth, and rare development potential along a growing beachfront corridor.**

This exceptional beachfront lot in Chuburná Puerto offers a rare opportunity to acquire a **deep, buildable oceanfront parcel with both dune frontage and extended interior land**, providing flexibility for residential, investment, or development use.

With approximately 1,864 m² of total land and a depth of nearly 196 meters, the property stands out from typical coastal lots, offering significantly more usable space for designing a private residence, multi-structure compound, or boutique development project.

Located approximately 2 kilometers west of Chuburná Puerto, the lot sits within a quiet stretch of coastline while remaining accessible to local services, restaurants, and the fishing village community. The area continues to attract buyers seeking a balance of **privacy, natural surroundings, and proximity to Mérida and Progreso**.

The property features natural dune formations and a beachfront setting that is described as stable and growing rather than eroding, which is a key consideration for long-term coastal investment. Electric service is available nearby, and the lot is considered buildable subject to environmental guidelines designed to preserve the surrounding ecosystem.

The nearby lagoon and mangrove environment support a rich ecosystem of flamingos, pelicans, and other wildlife, creating a setting that may appeal to buyers interested in **eco-conscious development, nature-based living, or low-density coastal design**.

From an investment perspective, this property stands out due to its **unusual depth, oceanfront positioning, and relative scarcity of comparable parcels along the Yucatán coast**. Large, deep beachfront lots with infrastructure access are limited, and tend to attract interest from buyers looking to build custom homes, retreat-style properties, or long-term land holdings.

This property may appeal to buyers seeking a **private beachfront estate, a multi-structure residential compound, or a development opportunity** in an emerging coastal market. Its combination of scale, location, and natural features positions it as a distinctive offering within the Yucatán beach property segment.

Here at the marina, the lagoon is feed by an inlet to the sea which also serves as a cut for the fishing boats to navigate to the marina and the sea.

The Mangrove lagoon is home of thousands of Flamingo’s, Cranes, Pelicans & Gulls.  It is a treasure chest of fish & wildlife.

The lots are build-able, subject to environmental standards, designed to protect the fragile beauty of the barrier island.

There simply are no lots with the depth, dunes, a growing (not eroding) beach front and superior location with electric and easy accessibility anywhere on the peninsula!

By private appt only.  Contact Mitch – miguelsmexico@gmail.com – for more information or to view the property.
