### Xu Elemental Habitat — Beachfront Living with Purpose

Just 50 meters from the sea, Xu Elemental Habitat redefines coastal living with a limited collection of only 14 exclusive condos, each designed around privacy, sustainability, and long-term comfort.

#### Overview

Each residence is an independent unit — no shared walls — ensuring absolute tranquility. Interiors feature spacious open layouts, thermal-acoustic walls, and premium finishes that create a serene, energy-efficient environment all year round.

The project offers a thoughtful balance between modern design and eco-sensitive construction, incorporating prefabricated concrete elements for superior durability and reduced maintenance.

#### Features & Advantages

*   Privacy and Exclusivity: Only 14 units, independent floors with no shared walls.
    
*   Prime Location: Just steps from the beach, 10 minutes from Progreso’s top restaurants, and 30 minutes from Mérida.
    
*   Everyday Convenience: Gas station, Oxxo, pastry shop, and local services within 5 minutes’ walk.
    
*   Safety: 24/7 police presence and controlled surroundings.
    
*   Durable, Sustainable Build: Prefabricated concrete façade panels, thermal-acoustic interior walls, and wastewater treatment plant with advanced filtration systems.
    
*   Amenities:
    
    *   Swimming pool with filtration and hydromassage system
        
    *   Elevator (Schindler brand)
        
    *   Bar area and social terrace
        
    *   Showers and restrooms
        
    *   Cistern and water recycling system
        
    *   Surveillance cameras
        
    *   BBQs and loungers
        

#### Community & Investment

With only 14 owners, Xu Elemental Habitat offers an intimate community where decisions are agile and property value is protected. The condominium regime and homeowners’ association are fully constituted, ensuring transparent administration and long-term planning.

The development is also optimized for vacation rentals, targeting guests who value security, privacy, and comfort— making it an ideal investment with high rental potential.

#### Available Units & Pricing

*   Garden Suites (2 BD / 2 BA / 1 Parking) – from $5,725,000 MXN
    
*   Standard Suites (2 BD / 2 BA / 1 Parking) – from $6,074,000 MXN
    
*   Penthouses (3 BD / 3 BA / 2 Parking) – from $10,982,400 MXN
    

Down payment: 30%  
Payment options: Bank or direct funding  
Promotions: Select units include minisplits, closets, blinds, and aluminum baseboards.

#### Summary

Xu Elemental Habitat blends architectural integrity, comfort, and strategic location to create a lifestyle investment that’s as practical as it is inspiring — whether you’re seeking a personal retreat or a high-yield vacation property on Yucatán’s coast.

### Tranquil San Crisanto

Yucatan

San Crisanto Yucatan is the location of this beautiful and tranquil beach house, a small fishing village that feels a world away, but is just over an hour’s drive from the bustling city of Merida.  Located just 2 blocks from the town’s square, this would make a great home for year round living, or a great getaway home.

Recently renovated and updated, the house includes two bedrooms and two bathrooms.  The spacious living/dining/kitchen area is open and welcoming, and has a view over the swimming pool to the Gulf of Mexico beyond.  Solid stone and block construction gives a sense of permanence and the traditional palapa roof gives the beach vibe you’re looking for.  A pool bar is great for entertaining friends who will be happy to visit this tropical waterfront home.

Air conditioners and ceiling fans, along with the screened windows keeps everything fresh and cool, and the view over the Gulf is mesmerizing.  The house is being sold furnished.

### Elegant Garden Property on Iconic Avenida Colón

Situated along one of Mérida’s most iconic avenues, this distinguished residence on Avenida Colón offers a rare combination of historic character, generous land, and a lush private garden oasis in the heart of Centro / García Ginerés.

The property sits on an expansive lot surrounded by mature trees and established landscaping, creating a peaceful retreat just minutes from the city’s most important cultural and commercial corridors. Classic architectural elements and soft pastel tones reflect Mérida’s timeless aesthetic, while multiple terraces and outdoor seating areas invite relaxed living and entertaining.

At the center of the garden lies a large rectangular swimming pool, framed by greenery, flowering bougainvillea, and shaded lounging areas. The surrounding patio provides ample space for outdoor dining, sunbathing, and gatherings, while mature trees create natural shade throughout the day. The grounds feel private and tranquil—an uncommon luxury along one of the city’s grand avenues.

The residence itself offers generous interior spaces with traditional details and a layout that flows naturally toward the garden and pool area. Several rooms open directly onto terraces and outdoor living spaces, allowing natural light and garden views to fill the home.

With its large lot, mature landscaping, and prime Avenida Colón location, the property presents multiple possibilities:  
• A distinguished private residence  
• A boutique hospitality concept  
• Offices or gallery space  
• A restoration project that celebrates Mérida’s historic architecture

Properties of this scale and location are increasingly rare within the historic core of Mérida.

### Turnkey Coastal Villa in San Benito, Yucatán

**Property Highlights**

San Benito real estate blends relaxed coastal elegance with thoughtful design—this villa is a standout example.

*   Striking façade featuring latticework, veneer stone, and wattle-and-daub wood details
    
*   Open, airy kitchen and living area with porcelain tile floors
    
*   Sleek black 3” window and door frames with 6mm clear float glass and screens
    
*   Elevated on 60cm diameter foundation piles above average ground level
    
*   Interior and exterior walls finished in layered plaster with smooth Chukum throughout
    
*   Kitchen equipped with quartz countertops, wood cabinetry, stainless steel sink, refrigerator, hood vent, and six-burner cooktop
    
*   Warm LED lighting and custom drapery throughout
    
*   Chukum-finished plunge pool (2.7m x 2.3m x 1.5m deep) anchoring the outdoor space
    
*   Bathrooms with travertine-clad counters and 10mm clear tempered glass shower enclosures
    
*   Primary bedroom with en suite bath and closet
    
*   Guest bedrooms with closets sharing a full bath
    
*   Minisplit A/C units installed in every room
    
*   Rooftop terrace with full bath, Gulf breezes, and scenic views
    
*   Generous laundry room with washer and dryer
    
*   Biodigester with absorption well
    
*   5,000L cistern plus 2,500L Rotoplas backup tank
    
*   All furnishings included as photographed—fully turnkey
    
*   Just a **one-minute walk to the Gulf waters**
    

**About San Benito**

San Benito is a serene coastal community along the Gulf of Mexico, ideally positioned between Progreso and Telchac Puerto—just 15 minutes from Progreso and about 40 minutes from Mérida—offering peaceful beachfront living without giving up access to city amenities, culture, dining, and services. Life here moves at a relaxed pace, with crystalline waters, soft sandy beaches, cooling ocean breezes, and unforgettable sunsets setting the tone for daily life.

The real estate ranges from private beachfront homes and luxury villas to stylish residences steps from the sand, many designed with open-air layouts that embrace the tropical setting. Whether you’re seeking a vacation getaway, full-time home, or investment property, San Benito stands out as one of the Yucatán coast’s most desirable locations, enriched by nature, local culture, and a close-knit community that feels welcoming rather than touristic.

### BEAUTIFUL FULLY RESTORED HISTORIC HOME!

### FULLY FURNISHED!

### Spanish Colonial on Beach Road with 3,215 square feet of living area on a 6,725 square foot lot in one of the most desirable neighborhoods on the east side of Progreso, Yucatán.

### **Completely restored to reflect the home’s original historic charm with all the modern amenities required and expected by today’s guests.**

### **Additional 250-square-foot casita with private entrance and walled outdoor patio at the rear of the lot.**

### **Less than 100 steps from the beach and walking distance to bars, restaurants, downtown Progreso, the Malecón (boardwalk), and the pier.**

### **Specifically designed to function as a Bed & Breakfast or comfortably accommodate several guests specifically seeking accommodations for medical tourism, OR AN INCREDIBLE RETIREMENT BEACH HOUSE.**

### **Spacious formal living room with seating for seven and room to comfortably accommodate several more. Direct access to the lower balcony and street views. Office area with a large cedar desk for guests who need to work. Conveniently located to function as a guest check-in area or as a workspace for day and evening staff.**

Clean and bright with tasteful, neutral decor and reliable internet access throughout the home.The main floor is open and airy, with windows positioned to maximize the ocean breeze.

The spacious, fully equipped kitchen and pantry have seating for two on the peninsula. The peninsula is ideally sized and located to double as a coffee/breakfast bar or snack area.

The kitchen has direct access to the dining room and a separate door to the backyard.  
The formal dining area currently seats six; however, the area is large enough to comfortably accommodate a table that seats eight or two smaller tables for four. The dining area has a six-foot-wide patio door with a view and direct access to the backyard dining area.

A spacious main floor bedroom with a king-size bed, air conditioning, and an attached bathroom with a shower.  
Two spacious “hotel-sized” bedrooms upstairs with two beds (queen or double) per room.

The first floor rooms have key access, ceiling fans, and windows windows to capture the Gulf of Mexico breeze. The ocean waves can be clearly heard in every room.

Each second-floor room has private access to a shared upper balcony with capacity for six guests.  There is a spacious shared bathroom on the upper floor, and an additional powder room on the main floor for common use.

Well-maintained south-facing backyard with a large common area and numerous private areas offering sun and shade throughout the yard throughout the day. Mature landscaping includes a coconut grove that produces a bumper crop of coconuts every three months.

30′ x 15′ above-ground pool with a shallow seating area (6 inches deep) and an outdoor poolside shower.

Large lounging area with direct access to the kitchen/snack bar and powder room on the main floor.

Barbecue and patio dining area with seating for four.

Cactus garden with fountain and patio seating for up to six.

CASITA:  
Detached 250-square-foot casita at the rear of the lot with a separate enclosed patio area.

Fully self-contained, air-conditioned, studio-style unit complete with queen-size bed, kitchenette, dining area, living room, and bathroom with shower.

Amenities include a ceiling fan, television, Wi-Fi, and a telephone with free calls throughout North America.

Perfect location for guests seeking more privacy than the main house offers.

It could easily be transformed into a secure treatment area or clinic, with the potential to function as a private massage studio and/or an area offering spa services for guests.

### LUSSELA — Montecristo

High-Level Living in Mérida’s Most Exclusive Residential District

Lussela introduces a new standard of boutique vertical living in Montecristo, the most distinguished residential enclave in Mérida. Surrounded by elegant estates, quiet tree-lined streets, and immediate access to the best hospitals, restaurants, and shopping corridors in the north of the city, Lussela offers a life where serenity and sophistication meet effortlessly.

Designed as an 11-residence luxury tower, each home delivers the scale, comfort, and privacy of a standalone residence — elevated into a curated lifestyle experience supported by concierge service, world-class amenities, and exceptional architectural design.

The Residences
--------------

Lussela offers three signature layouts — Park View, Garden, and Penthouse — ranging from 309 m² to 504 m². Every residence includes:

*   3 bedrooms, each with an en-suite bathroom and walk-in closet or built-ins
*   Expansive living and dining areas with direct access to private terraces
*   Open, fully equipped kitchens
*   Laundry center with dedicated storage
*   Full service quarters with bathroom
*   2 to 4 private parking spaces, depending on unit type

Garden Residence – 416 m²  
Ground level with a generous private garden terrace and 3 parking spaces.

Park View Residences – 309 m²  
Located from Level 1 to 4, each with sweeping façade curves, natural light, and 2 parking spaces.

Penthouse – 504 m²  
A truly elevated home: double terraces, additional family room, and 4 parking spaces.

Lussela Club — Amenities Curated to Perfection
----------------------------------------------

Across the ground floor and rooftop, residents enjoy a complete collection of lifestyle amenities designed for comfort, wellness, and connection.

### Ground Level

*   Elegant lobby with full concierge
*   Business Center with private meeting rooms
*   Fitness & Wellness Center with cardio, machines, yoga and Pilates area
*   Club Room for gatherings and entertaining
*   Game Room with lounge spaces and recreational setups
*   Shaded outdoor terraces

### Rooftop Level

*   Infinity Pool — Located 24 meters above the city, the rooftop infinity pool becomes a private sky-level sanctuary for residents. Depending on the season and outside temperature, the pool is climatized to ensure comfortable use throughout the entire year
*   Whisky & Cigar Lounge
*   Panoramic rooftop terraces for sunset dining, events, or quiet contemplation

Concierge Service — A Life Designed to Flow
-------------------------------------------

Lussela includes an elevated hospitality program designed to simplify and enhance daily living:

Laundry & dry cleaning • Package handling • Florist service • Delivery coordination • Personal errands • Private chef arrangements • Spa treatments • Housekeeping • Maintenance • Guest reception • Shoe care • Pet spa coordination

----------------------

A rare opportunity to live in one of Mérida’s most established luxury communities, steps from the city’s best hospitals, shopping centers, schools, and lifestyle destinations. From Montecristo, you are minutes from the most desirable parts of the city.

### La Bocania – Boutique Beachfront Hotel & Private Owner’s Residence on the Malecón, Progreso

La Bocania is a one-of-a-kind beachfront property combining a boutique hotel and a private owner’s residence in the heart of Progreso’s Malecón. With sweeping views of the Gulf of Mexico, this property merges lifestyle and investment, offering luxury accommodations, commercial potential, and all the comforts of a seaside home just 30 minutes from Mérida.

### Boutique Hotel Experience

Guests are welcomed into a stylish reception area and boutique shop, setting the tone for a personalized stay. The hotel is designed with comfort and relaxation in mind: a shimmering pool, a jacuzzi, and landscaped gardens create an inviting atmosphere. Shaded terraces, lounge spaces, and even an ice bath elevate the guest experience.

Each guest suite is thoughtfully appointed with its own ensuite bathroom and tasteful finishes. The layout ensures privacy for guests while also creating a sense of community around the common areas.

### Owner’s Private Residence

The private residence offers a sanctuary within the property. With its own spacious living areas, a fully equipped kitchen, and a grand terrace overlooking the Gulf, it is perfectly suited for full-time living. The residence features a luxurious guest suite with a double shower and steambath, while additional bedrooms all include ensuite bathrooms for convenience.

The rooftop is a true highlight: a second pool, sun terraces, and open-air dining space combine panoramic views with effortless entertaining. Whether for private use or guest enjoyment, this area embodies coastal luxury.

### Features & Infrastructure

This property stands out not only for its design but also for its robust infrastructure and thoughtful amenities:

*   8 bedrooms and 8 ensuite bathrooms (hotel + owner’s residence)
*   3 additional separate bathrooms
*   2 fully equipped kitchens
*   2 pools, 1 jacuzzi, and an ice bath
*   Private water well
*   6 tinacos (6,000 liter capacity) for backup water supply
*   3 water heaters and a water pressure system
*   Water softener for consistent water quality
*   Freight elevator for moving heavy furniture
*   Potential kitesurf container/restaurant setup
*   2 separate laundry rooms with washer/dryer

### Location & Lifestyle

Located directly on Progreso’s vibrant Malecón, La Bocania is within walking distance of the pier, cafés, restaurants, and water sports. Guests enjoy easy access to Mérida’s cultural attractions, cenotes, and archaeological sites, while owners benefit from a thriving tourist hub that ensures consistent demand.

### Spacious 2-Level Home with Pool in Colonia México

This 2-story residence sits on a 390 m² lot with 346 m² of construction, offering generous indoor and outdoor living in one of Mérida’s most established neighborhoods — just minutes from Prolongación Montejo and Circuito Colonias.

### Ground Floor

*   Covered garage for 3 vehicles with electric gate
*   Welcoming front garden and service alley with independent access
*   Bright living and dining areas with large windows
*   Functional kitchen with adjoining breakfast area
*   Service room with full bathroom, laundry, and patio for drying
*   Covered terrace with bar, perfect for entertaining
*   Swimming pool with waterfall feature

### Upper Floor

*   Primary suite with walk-in closet, en-suite bathroom, and private terrace
*   Second bedroom with en-suite bath and closet
*   Third bedroom with closet and half bath

### Key Features

*   Solid 1980’s contemporary construction
*   Ample covered and uncovered outdoor space
*   Convenient location in Colonia México, a desirable residential area close to schools, shops, and services

### Sensational Residence In Yucatan Country Club

This luxurious property was designed to bring comfortness and wellbeing to its inhabitants, with a modern and innovative design. The house is brand new with 3 bedrooms, 4½ bathrooms, garage, pool, equipped kitchen, spa (sauna and steam room, hot and cold tubs); all in an inviting environment surrounded by nature.

The house includes on the first floor:

*   _Covered garage for three cars_
*   _Open concept living/dining room with stained glass_
*   _Kitchen with full cabinetry and marble counter tops, two pantries and space for appliances_
*   _Covered terrace with garden views and space for grilling_
*   _Lap pool with polished concrete finish_
*   _Deck for yoga or sun baths_
*   _Steam room for four people_
*   _Sauna for four people_
*   _Cold tub (as low as 10°C)_
*   _Jacuzzi_
*   _One half bathroom inside the house and one outside_ 
*   _3 meter celings for a better sensation and temperature control_
*   _Great indoor-outdoor and nature integration_
*   _Storage room_
*   _Gas powered emergency plant (18 Kw)_
*   _Service quarters_ 

The second floor includes:

*   _Large family room with balcony and pool view_
*   _Master bedroom with walk-in closet, balcony and pool view_
*   _Master bathroom with large shower and double sink_
*   _Interior garden with open-air wall shower and body massage in master bathroom_
*   _Second bedroom designed for two people with bathroom and closet_
*   _Third bedroom designed for one person with bathroom and closet_
*   _Laundry room_

The house has great quality materials and equipment:

*   _Travertine marble flooring_
*   _Wood decorative elements on facades and decks_
*   _Tempered glass in bathrooms, staircase and balcony railings_
*   _Spanish aluminum doors and windows (line 3)_
*   _Bathrooms with marble floors_
*   _Planters and showers with porcelain tiles_
*   _Helvex brand bathroom accessories_
*   _Ghroe brand showers and bathroom faucets_
*   _Mahogany kitchen cabinets_
*   _Tekaway brand stainless steel sink in kitchen_
*   _Galarza stone wall finishes_
*   _Walls with Cemex Multiplast and Kimicolor paste finish_
*   _5-year roof waterproofing_
*   _Cedar wood sauna_
*   _Steam room with Venetian mosaic_
*   _Electric system prepared for a smart home_
*   _Chandeliers in social areas and hanging lights in kitchen_
*   _Supra brand full stove and oven_
*   _LG Insta View refrigerator_
*   _Fully air conditioned_
*   _Interior light fixtures_
*   _Emergency gas plant for entire house_

Yucatan Country Club is one of the finest communities in Latinamerica with a world class golf course, a beautiful club house with lake views and amazing ammenities, amazing green areas, offering a relaxed and private lifestyle

The house is located in Privada Kutz, which has a park with playgrounds and a padel court.

### Amazing Northside Home and Location!

Merida,

Yucatan

Beautiful House in Merida, Col. San Ramon Norte!

MORE PHOTOS AND A VIDEO COMING SOON!

Located just one block from García Lavín Avenue, this property offers a privileged location near the main shopping centers in the north of the city, such as City Center, La Isla, Vía Montejo, Galerías, and Gran Plaza.  Its proximity to schools, universities, hospitals, and the “loop” makes it an unbeatable option for those seeking convenience and accessibility. This is, without question, one of the very best of locations on the Northside of Merida. It is easy to get to the Centro, shopping AND the beach.

The property sits on a 342m2 (3681.26 square foot) lot, with a spacious 295.22m2 (3220.77 square foot) two story house.

The first floor features a welcoming foyer, living room, dining room, kitchen, a covered terrace with a bar, service hallway, pool shower, a study with a bathroom, a 4×4 meter swimming pool, automatic irrigation system, front and back gardens with fruit trees, a storage room, and a two-car garage with an electric gate.

The second floor has 3 bedrooms, a TV room, 3 full bathrooms, and a room with a large terrace.  Two of the bedrooms have a large walk-in closet.

There is a small first floor casita with private entrance, outside of the house, with a full bath that would make a very nice guest room or rental property.

The house is being sold fully furnished and equipped with air conditioning, ceiling fans, and two water wells. Other than paint and standard maintenance, this house is ready to move into and enjoy life in Merida!

To see this beautiful home, contact Dr. Leroy Osmon 999-125-6196 or email: leroy.osmon@gmail.com

### Stunning Colonial Palace

Stunning Colonial Estate Mérida Centro – Luxury Residence with Solar Power
--------------------------------------------------------------------------

* * *

📍 Overview
-----------

This exceptional colonial estate in Mérida offers a rare combination of **historic architectural character, modern infrastructure, and luxury-scale living** in one of the most desirable areas of the city.

Located just blocks from Santa Ana, Paseo de Montejo, and Mérida’s emerging culinary corridor, the property is fully walkable while maintaining the privacy, scale, and amenities typically associated with estate-level homes.

With over 1,000 m² of construction on a substantial lot, this residence represents a **top-tier Centro property** suited for lifestyle buyers, luxury second-home owners, or those seeking a signature property in Yucatán.

* * *

📊 Property Snapshot
--------------------

*   **Location:** Mérida Centro, Yucatán
*   **Property Type:** Luxury Colonial Estate
*   **Bedrooms:** 4
*   **Bathrooms:** 4
*   **Construction:** ~1,065 m²
*   **Lot Size:** ~825 m²
*   **Parking:** Garage (1 vehicle)
*   **Energy:** Solar-powered systems
*   **Key Feature:** Fully restored and upgraded colonial residence

* * *

💰 Investment Summary
---------------------

From an investment standpoint, this property stands apart due to:

*   **Scale** — unusually large construction for Centro
*   **Location** — within walking distance to Mérida’s most desirable zones
*   **Architectural uniqueness** — irreplaceable colonial design elements
*   **Turnkey condition** — fully restored with modern systems

Properties at this level are not commodity listings — they are **trophy assets**.

This residence may appeal to buyers seeking:

*   A legacy or flagship property
*   A luxury second home with strong resale appeal
*   A high-end rental or boutique hospitality conversion
*   Long-term appreciation in Mérida’s historic core

* * *

👤 Who This Property May Suit
-----------------------------

This property is best suited for:

*   High-net-worth buyers seeking a **signature home in Mérida Centro**
*   Buyers relocating part-time or full-time to Yucatán
*   Investors interested in **boutique hospitality or luxury rental use**
*   Buyers who value architecture, scale, and location over standard inventory

* * *

📍 Why This Location Matters
----------------------------

The property is positioned on Calle 66, placing it within walking distance of:

*   Parque Santa Ana
*   Paseo de Montejo
*   Calle 47 (Mérida’s “foodie corridor”)
*   Restaurants, cafés, and cultural landmarks

Centro Mérida continues to attract international buyers due to:

*   Historic charm and walkability
*   Limited supply of large, restored properties
*   Strong global interest in colonial homes

👉 Location is a primary driver of this property’s long-term value.

* * *

🏡 Architectural & Lifestyle Features
-------------------------------------

This residence blends **authentic colonial elements** with high-end upgrades:

*   Beamed colonial ceilings
*   Decorative pasta tile floors
*   Restored hardwood doors and ironwork
*   Central courtyard with filtered pool
*   Koi pond and landscaped gardens
*   Library, gym, and multiple entertaining areas
*   Rooftop and second-floor terraces
*   Solar power systems
*   Modern electrical and plumbing
*   Water filtration and pressurization systems
*   Automated irrigation

👉 The result is a **fully modernized historic residence**, which is rare in Centro.

----------------------------

Yes, the home has been extensively restored and upgraded with modern systems while preserving its historic character.

Given its scale, layout, and location, it may be adaptable for hospitality or commercial use, subject to local regulations.

Large, fully restored colonial estates of this scale are increasingly limited in Mérida Centro.

Yes, the property is within walking distance of major landmarks, restaurants, and cultural areas.

### Elegant Estate in the Heart of Cholul

This exceptional residence is nestled on a quiet street in the charming town of Cholul, just 10 minutes from Mérida’s top shopping malls and 25 minutes from the beautiful Gulf beaches. It offers the perfect blend of serene small-town living and quick access to city conveniences — ideal for large families or anyone seeking a truly grand home.

### Key Features

Step inside and be greeted by a striking Macedonian stone spiral staircase, setting the tone for the home’s refined character. The property boasts five generously sized bedrooms, each with its own private bathroom and closet, ensuring comfort and privacy for all.

The home’s design embraces indoor–outdoor living, with three expansive terraces and a sparkling filtered pool which is perfect for cooling off on warm Yucatán days. The open kitchen and spacious entertaining areas make hosting family and friends a delight.

### Cholul 3-in-1 Home

### 3-in-1 Property in Central Cholul with Loft Income Potential

Set on a spacious 990 m² corner lot just two blocks from Cholul’s main square, this versatile property offers three fully independent living spaces. The main house features two bedrooms, two bathrooms, and a home office with its own entrance—ideal for remote work or guest use. Above, two self-contained lofts each include a private kitchen, full bath, and separate access, making them perfect for rental income, multigenerational living, or boutique stays.

Outside, you’ll find mature fruit trees, two shaded terraces, and a quiet pool area for relaxing or entertaining. Whether you’re looking to live and earn, host and rent, or simply spread out—this layout gives you options.

**Property Highlights**

*   Lot: 990 m² (20 m x 49 m) | Construction: 294 m²
*   Main house with 2 bedrooms and 2 full bathrooms
*   Independent office/guest room with private entrance and full bath
*   Two upper-level loft apartments (each ~60 m²) with kitchen, bath, and A/C
*   Parking for 4+ vehicles with electric gate
*   Pool with overflow moat and tropical landscaping
*   Two covered terraces, tamarind, mango, and plum trees
*   Laundry area, storage, and recent updates (2021–2022)

### Affordable Property In La Ermita

Merida,

Yucatan

Located just a few blocks from La Ermita park, on a quiet street, this property offers a solid structure and lots of usable space. The lot starts at 2.8 meters but opens up to 4.4 meters and even more at the back, where there is a spacious terrace and garden measuring 10 x 10 meters.

The property currently has a long entry way, followed by a substantial living room, dining room, kitchen and guest bathroom. In the last section there are three bedrooms, of which one has its own bathroom and one is oversized.

At the back of the property there is a large terrace with a tin roof that could be easily removed. This area would be ideal for a pool and garden space.

### Merida Fixer Upper Calle 28

**Large 887 m² development lot for sale in Mérida, Yucatán with flexible frontage expansion, no historical restrictions, and ideal conditions for new construction or investment project.**

This property offers a rare opportunity to acquire a **deep, buildable lot with unique width expansion** in a growing residential area of Mérida. With approximately 887 m² of land, the lot begins at 7.05 meters wide and expands significantly toward the rear, reaching approximately 16.3 meters, creating a highly functional layout for modern construction.

The existing structure is suitable for demolition, allowing a buyer to **design and build a custom home or development project from the ground up without structural limitations**. Unlike many Centro properties, this lot is not subject to historical preservation restrictions, providing full flexibility in architectural design, materials, and construction approach.

Located in Jardines de Miraflores, the property benefits from proximity to essential services, including a nearby hardware store less than half a block away, making construction logistics simple and efficient. Mérida Centro is approximately a 10-minute drive, providing access to restaurants, cultural attractions, and commercial areas.

The depth and widening configuration of the lot create multiple development possibilities, including:

*   A custom-designed single-family residence with garden and pool
*   A multi-unit residential project
*   A rental-focused property or long-term investment
*   A modern home with expanded rear living spaces

The lot also offers sufficient space for outdoor features such as a **pool, landscaped garden, and additional structures**, which are key value drivers in the Mérida real estate market.

From an investment perspective, this property stands out due to its **lot size, flexible geometry, and low entry price for a build-ready parcel**. Properties that allow new construction without restrictions are increasingly limited, particularly those with usable depth and widening dimensions that improve architectural design options.

This property may appeal to buyers seeking a **development opportunity, custom home project, or land investment in Mérida**. Its combination of size, location, and design flexibility positions it as a strong value-add opportunity within the Yucatán real estate market.

### Three-Unit Condo Complex in García Ginerés

Income • Central • Practical • Scalable • Investment

Located on Calle 15 in the heart of García Ginerés, this three-unit condo complex offers excellent rental potential in one of Mérida’s most established and walkable central neighborhoods. The setting is quiet, tree-lined, and close to everything — making it ideal for investors seeking stable occupancy and long-term value.

The property consists of three identical condos, each designed with a practical two-bedroom, one-bathroom layout. One of the units is currently vacant and shown unfurnished. A second unit is tenant-occupied, and the furnishings visible in the photos belong to the renter. The third unit is not pictured, but it has the same dimensions, finishes, and layout as the other two.

The interiors feature bright living spaces, simple kitchens, and efficient floor plans that appeal to both long-term and short-term renters. With low-maintenance construction and straightforward common areas, the complex functions well as an income-producing asset.

Each condo includes one assigned parking space within a shared gated parking area — three total.

This is a rare chance to acquire an entire three-unit building in García Ginerés at a competitive price point, with flexibility to rent as-is or further upgrade to increase returns.

### 1191 Acre Farm/ranch In San Pedro, Tekax, Yucatan

Tekax,

Yucatan

A huge beautiful property…. waiting for the right person! This part of Yucatan is one of the most beautiful the state has to offer. The ranch is surrounded by the Puuc Mountains and offers a scenic valley and amazing views!

The ranch is in San Pedro (Tekax), Yucatan near Becanchen with 482 hectares (1191 acres). It is locate 5.8 kilometers from the main paved road to Becanchen. Because of the location, this property does not need a bank trust (Fideicomiso).

The ranch has 482 hectares (1191 acres) of which 200 are flat, 200 hectares are cleared and 30 hectares are ready to plant crops or fruit trees.

It has a large watering hole with a pumping system. This lake is 3.5 to 4 meters deep (10 to 12.5 feet deep).

There is a 2 story house with two bedrooms and two full bathrooms.

This is the richest soil in Yucatan and can be used for growing anything from corn/sorghum (animal feed) to vegetables to fruit trees. The valley (protected by the Puuc mountain range) is located next to the water supply and has a pump and holding tank installed for irrigation.

It has many types of natural wildlife, including wild turkeys, quail, dove, dear …and much more.

Live totally off grid! Grow your food, raise live stock, fish in the lake, enjoy the beauty of nature (and the mountains that are part of the ranch/farm) …and enjoy life. Just add solar panels and you are totally independent!

Google Maps: https://maps.app.goo.gl/HufT5uVHWTd2Mhkg7?g\_st=ipc

Tekax Municipality, Yucatan (close to the small village of Becanchen)

### Two-in-One Country Retreat Overlooking the Polo Club

Country Living \* Modern Comfort \* Solar Powered \* Spacious \* Versatile

Escape to wide-open living just minutes from Mérida and the coast. This single-story, 4-bedroom, 4.5-bath home blends country tranquility with modern efficiency and smart design.

The property is essentially two complete homes under one roof. Each unit has its own kitchen, living room, dining area, bedrooms, and bathrooms. Perfect for multi-generational families, long-term guests, or as an investment — live in one and rent out the other.

Set on more than 2,100 m², the home was completed in 2022 and offers generous indoor and outdoor spaces. A 17-meter pool, covered BBQ kitchen, and gardens overlooking the Polo Club fields create a true resort-style setting for entertaining or relaxation.

A state-of-the-art solar system with panels, batteries, inverter, and surge protection keeps energy reliable and costs low. Water softener, pressurized water, irrigation system, and full air-conditioning add comfort and convenience.

Additional features include a large cistern, terrace, storage, and covered parking. Furnished and move-in ready.

### Big And Comfortable In Brisas

Merida,

Yucatan

In the last few years the number of families relocating to Merida have increased.  
The historic area houses, have increased in price every year, do to the high demand and less properties available.

This big property, located in the neighborhood of Brisas, is ready to move in and it gives you the flexibility to be in an area where you can be in Centro in 15 min. or the north side of town in about the same time.

The house has a 4 car garage in front due to its wide front space of 16 meters.  Entering the front door you walk into a receiving area, followed by a living room.  
Once you pass the front rooms you see the kitchen and to the right you find the 4 bedrooms, two in each side of the hallway. At the end of the hallway there is a complete bathroom.  
Next to the kitchen is the dining room followed by a small t.v. room, leading to the back yard.

There is space in the backyard to build a small pool.  
The laundry room is also in the back yard. Thre are some fruit trees and a small hallway that leads to the house.  
Brisas is located next to Colonia Aleman. You can find anything you want very close to this house; restaurants, schools, stores, malls, you will be in a great location.

Outdoor features include a patio and small pool area, creating usable outdoor living space that can be further enhanced with landscaping or shade structures. The layout supports a balance of indoor and outdoor living, which is a key value driver in Centro Mérida properties.

The location places the home in a residential area just south of the main historic districts, providing access to downtown Mérida while offering a quieter and more local environment. This part of Centro continues to attract buyers seeking **better value relative to Santiago, Santa Ana, and other central neighborhoods**.

From an investment perspective, this property stands out due to its **corner lot, restored condition, and accessible price point within Centro Mérida**. Homes that combine original character with functional upgrades are increasingly desirable for buyers who want to avoid full renovation projects.

### 2 Investment Lots Phula Residencial

\*  Gated Community   \*  Build Your Home   \*  Spacious   \*  Tranquil   \*    Investment   \*

Exceptional Lots in Residencial Phula – Your Gateway to Elevated Living

Indulge in the epitome of sophisticated living with these two extraordinary lots now available in Residencial Phula. Whether you’re envisioning a lavish retreat or a statement residence, these perfectly sized parcels of land offer an exceptional canvas for your aspirations.

Generous Space: Choose from two distinct options, each boasting its own unique charm. The first lot spans an impressive 1436.94 square meters, while the second is an expansive 2718.22 square meters. Embrace the freedom to design and construct your dream home to match your personal style and desires.

Unparalleled Amenities: Residencial Phula redefines opulent living by providing an array of exclusive amenities for you to relish. Dive into relaxation at the beautiful common pool or host memorable events and gatherings in the luxurious club house. Sharpen your golf skills on the minigolf and putting green, engage in friendly matches on the tennis and padel courts, or relish in active moments on the soccer field and 5km biking or walking trail. The on-site nursery offers a touch of greenery to complement your lavish lifestyle.

Round-the-Clock Security: Your safety and tranquility are paramount. With 24-hour security, you can rest assured that your investment and your loved ones are protected day and night.

Premier Location: Situated just 15 minutes from the picturesque shores of Progreso and a mere 30 minutes from the vibrant centro, Residencial Phula boasts the perfect balance between tranquility and accessibility. The presence of established gated communities nearby adds to the exclusivity of this sought-after address.

Prime Investment: Priced at an enticing $1000 pesos per square meter, these lots present an unparalleled investment opportunity in a premium residential enclave. Craft your ultimate haven in an environment designed for luxury and comfort.

Craft Your Dream Lifestyle: With these remarkable lots as your starting point, bring your dream home to life in Residencial Phula. Design a dwelling that embodies your aspirations, where every corner exudes elegance and sophistication.

Elevate your living experience and secure your place in Residencial Phula today. Reach out to us to schedule a viewing and seize the opportunity to claim your piece of this prestigious community.

### San Cristobal Fixer Upper

Merida,

Yucatan

This property has great potential as a home or business, given its large construction and long lot. The existent construction could host at least 3 bedrooms, garage, balcony and with some demolitions, there would be plenty of space for a pool and garden.

The property was recently used as an office and storage for a business and it’s in very good shape.

The ground floor is fully built, starting with the garage and followed by 5 more spacious rooms. Some of these rooms could be easily opened up to create a sectional construction with different courtyards, which has proven to be a functional layout for long and narrow properties.

The second floor includes 3 rooms with great potential for bedrooms and one bathroom.

Located at only 6 blocks from San Cristobal park and at short distance from other interesting landmarks.

Travel times by car:

*   7 minutes from Mejorada and La Plancha parks
*   10 minutes from Plaza Grande (main square)
*   12 minutes from Santa Lucia and Santa Ana parks

### Boutique Hotel Viva Merida — Fully Operational

1.  Boutique   \*  Colonial   \*  Sustainable   \*    Central   \*  Luxury

Welcome to Hotel Viva Merida: A Boutique Gem in the Heart of Calle 59

Discover the charm and elegance of Hotel Viva Merida, a boutique hotel nestled in the vibrant Santiago district of Merida. Boasting a prime location, this meticulously crafted property offers the perfect blend of modern comfort and colonial allure.

Exquisite Accommodations:  
Step into one of the 12 beautifully appointed bedrooms, each adorned with tasteful decor and equipped with its own AC unit and spacious private bathroom. Guests are treated to a serene retreat after a day of exploring the city.

Exceptional Amenities:

Indulge in relaxation by the shimmering pool, bask in the sun on our sunbathing roof, or unwind in the inviting ambiance of our fully equipped kitchen and bar. With thoughtful amenities such as an office, storage room, and laundry room complete with machines, every aspect of guest comfort is carefully considered.

Modern Conveniences:

Stay connected with WiFi throughout the property, and rest assured with a 50,000-liter cistern, 80 solar panels, water softener, and water pressurizers ensuring uninterrupted comfort and sustainability for guests.

Unparalleled Location:

Situated on the bustling Calle 59, Hotel Viva Merida offers easy access to the city’s vibrant attractions, historic landmarks, and culinary delights. Guests can immerse themselves in the rich culture and heritage of Merida, with the hotel serving as their perfect home base for exploration.

Investment Opportunity:

With its prime location, exceptional amenities, and attention to detail, Hotel Viva Merida presents a unique investment opportunity in the thriving hospitality market of Merida. Figures detailing the property’s performance and potential are available upon request, providing valuable insight for investors.

Experience the Magic of Merida:

Don’t miss the chance to own a piece of Merida’s hospitality scene with Hotel Viva Merida. Whether you’re a seasoned investor or a hospitality enthusiast, this charming boutique hotel invites you to become a part of its story.

### Historic Urban Canvas — 1,369 m² in Mérida Centro

A rare land assembly in the heart of Centro Histórico — three legally independent, adjoining properties previously used as offices and service parking. Combined, they form a deep, highly versatile platform with wide street presence, existing infrastructure, and off-street parking, positioned within Mérida’s historic tourism corridor.

The terrain measures approximately 1,369 m² in total, an exceptional footprint for Centro. Existing structures total ~778 m², offering solid utility and adaptable built space for staging, office, service, or renovation. The site is zoned Urbano / Estacionamiento, providing a strategic baseline for hospitality, mixed-use residential, cultural, or commercial development.

This is a prime canvas for a boutique hotel, serviced apartments, branded living, wellness retreat, creative compound, educational/cultural center, or a multi-residence private estate with secure parking. Depth, width, and configuration allow for thoughtful massing, green courtyards, and multiple access points — attributes seldom available at this scale in Centro.

Moments from Plaza Grande, San Juan, new cultural projects, and major restoration activity, the location benefits from both high visitation flow and quiet historical character. With rising demand from hospitality groups and international investors, this portfolio is a strategic opportunity to secure scale, presence, and legacy in Mérida’s historic core.

*   Three contiguous Centro lots — sold as one portfolio

### The Perfect Hotel Location

This is THE perfect location in Merida Centro for a hotel. It has all of the infrastructure in place. It has a huge parking area (more than 40 cars), built structurally to support a pool on the second floor and for a third floor to be expanded. It has an elevator, offices, bathrooms and a corner location/view second to none.

This property also comes with the option to be torn completely down if the new owners wanted. This is a unique option in Merida Centro. The property is next to (and overlooks) the Santiago Park/Church and market.

With 4104 square meters (44,175 square feet) of construction and 2,861 square meters (30,795 square feet) a full-sized hotel could be built. It is located 3 blocks from the Zocalo!

The property also has a beautiful Colonial home that has been totally renovated that would be a perfect meeting room.  This is an amazing investment opportunity.

To see this property, contact Robert Slaats (999.246.6555 Email: slaatsrobert@gmail.com) or Dr. Leroy Osmon (999.125.6196 Email: leroy.osmon@gmail.com).

\*\*Quinta Los Cheles: Your Perfect Peaceful Retreat Near Mérida\*\*

Escape to the tranquil charm of \*\*Quinta Los Cheles\*\*, a picturesque ranchette located in the peaceful San Lorenzo neighborhood of Uman, just a short drive from the vibrant city of Mérida. This well maintained home sits on a spacious double lot, offering abundant room for privacy, growth, and creativity.

Whether you’re dreaming of building a custom home, cultivating a thriving garden, creating an event venue, or starting a sustainable (stingless) beekeeping project, this property offers endless opportunities to bring your vision to life. Surrounded by lush, mature trees and fresh country air, you’ll enjoy the serenity of rural living, all while being close to everything you need—Mérida’s shopping, medical facilities, and airport are just minutes away.

\*\*Key Features:\*\*  
– Expansive double lot providing ample space for expansion  
– Ideal for gardening, farming, or building your dream home  
– Tranquil setting with mature trees and natural beauty  
– Close proximity to Mérida’s amenities: shopping, medical services, and more  
– Perfect for those seeking privacy, peace, and a connection with nature

Experience the best of both worlds: the calm of country living with the convenience of city access. \*\*Bring your offer and make Quinta Los Cheles your next adventure!\*\*

### Remodeled Centro Property

**Price Reduced – Boutique-Style Living Opportunity in Mérida Centro**

Discover the potential to create a sophisticated residence in one of Mérida’s most desirable and culturally rich neighborhoods, just south of Centro near Santa Rosa. This newly renovated home offers a rare blend of modern upgrades and future upside, featuring a brand-new second level that is approximately 90% complete—an ideal canvas to finish to your personal taste.

The main level is designed for relaxed indoor-outdoor living, with a well-appointed kitchen, full bathroom, and a flexible studio space that can easily serve as a guest bedroom or private office. Step into your own intimate courtyard oasis, complete with a plunge pool—perfect for enjoying Mérida’s warm, tropical lifestyle. A detached studio in the patio adds versatility, whether for guests, creative use, or additional rental potential.

Upstairs, the home transitions into a more elevated living experience. The second floor features a spacious primary suite highlighted by a large picture window that fills the space with natural light. This level also includes the main living area, private bath, generous closet space, laundry room, terrace, and balcony—offering multiple areas to relax, entertain, and enjoy the indoor-outdoor flow that defines Yucatán living.

This property is ideal for buyers seeking a personalized home, winter retreat, or investment opportunity in a high-demand expat market.

### EXCLUSIVE | CASA VÉRTICE | GARCÍA GINERES

Merida,

Yucatan

**OFFERED EXCLUSIVELY ON MEXICO INTERNATIONAL REAL ESTATE**

Casa Vértice presents a striking architectural presence defined by vertical scale, natural stone textures, and clean modern geometry. A dramatic double-height entry anchored by an exposed stone wall and floating wood staircase sets the tone immediately, introducing a home designed with intention, proportion, and visual impact rarely found in García Gineres. Lighted fountains at the front entrance create a refined arrival experience, reinforcing the home’s architectural identity from the moment you approach.

Inside, layered ceiling details, warm wood accents, and expansive sliding glass panels create a seamless transition between interior living spaces and the landscaped garden beyond. The layout feels open yet controlled, allowing natural light to travel through the home while maintaining a strong sense of structure and privacy. A full-height natural stone wall anchors the interior composition, while recessed lighting and wood beam detailing elevate the main living and kitchen areas. A large pantry and extensive storage areas support the home’s functionality without compromising its clean aesthetic.

Designed across two levels, the residence offers four bedrooms and five and a half bathrooms. The two downstairs bedrooms each feature en suite bathrooms, creating ideal accommodations for guests or multi-generational living. Upstairs, the primary suite functions as a private retreat, complete with a soaking bathtub, its own kitchenette with refrigerator, and direct access to an expansive terrace ideal for evening lounging and stargazing. A balcony off the yellow guest bedroom adds an additional outdoor moment, enhancing light and airflow on the upper level. The suite is further defined by statement designer countertops, selected as a focal architectural element, complemented by a primary bathroom that incorporates a private open-air shower garden blending natural light, greenery, and architectural privacy. Premium countertop upgrades continue into the powder room and master bath, adding a refined and tactile finish that speaks to the level of investment throughout the home.

The kitchen pairs quartz and granite surfaces with integrated appliances, a generous island, and exceptional storage capacity, flowing directly into the main living areas. Full-height glazing reinforces the indoor–outdoor connection, allowing the garden and pool to become a natural extension of daily living.

Outdoors, a sculptural geometric water feature wall frames the filtered swimming pool, transforming the landscaped garden into a private resort-style setting surrounded by mature royal and foxtail palms, illuminated pathways, and curated lounging zones featuring Ledge Loungers, umbrellas and furniture. The outdoor kitchen is fully equipped with a grill, burner, refrigerator, sink, and ample built-in storage, creating a true entertainer’s environment. A dedicated pool bathroom provides convenience for guests, while the pool mechanical room offers additional storage space rarely found in comparable homes. Two side breezeways allow discreet service access to the backyard and promote natural cross-ventilation throughout the property.

Built with entertaining and comfort in mind, the residence includes integrated exterior speakers, a full surround sound system throughout the house supported by three subwoofers and an 86-inch television, along with an automated irrigation system that maintains the mature landscaping year-round.

Additional infrastructure includes two garages with electric doors, ten air-conditioning units, solar panels, two water heaters, a private well, backup generator, and a comprehensive security system with cameras and app-controlled front gate access. A large washer and dryer are included, and a curated furniture inventory is available upon request.

Located just one block from the Slow Food Market and close to hospitals, supermarkets, and daily conveniences, Casa Vértice sits within one of García Gineres’ most established and peaceful residential pockets — offering tranquility without sacrificing proximity to Centro.

This is a residence for buyers who value architecture, privacy, and the freedom to host beautifully within a home that feels both bold and refined.

### Art Deco Stunner In Santiago — Solar Powered

Timeless     \*  Elegant   \*  Versatile   \*    Luxurious   \*  Modern

Welcome to a timeless treasure in the heart of Santiago – a stunning 1920’s Art Deco style house, nestled just 2 blocks away from the tranquil park. This meticulously crafted home offers a harmonious blend of classic elegance and modern convenience.

Comprising 3 bedrooms and 2.5 bathrooms, this residence boasts an array of desirable features. Step into luxury with a refreshing pool, ideal for unwinding on warm summer days. The expansive bedroom upstairs provides versatility, whether for remote work or having guests stay over.

Every detail has been carefully considered, from the high-quality fixtures to the thoughtfully curated furnishings. The chef’s kitchen, complete with stainless steel countertops, dishwasher, and garbage disposal, is a culinary haven. Indulge in comfort with A/C throughout, a water softener, and a reverse osmosis filtration system ensuring pure water at every turn.

Entertainment is effortless with three smart TVs strategically placed for your viewing pleasure. Stay comfortable year-round with high-powered ceiling fans and an electric garage door for seamless access.

Luxuriate in the spa-like ambiance of the bathtub, complemented by a large water heater for uninterrupted relaxation. With sustainability in mind, this home features 15 solar panels, promising energy efficiency and cost savings.

Additionally, a washer and dryer unit and a spacious walk-in closet add to the convenience of daily living. This fully furnished and equipped residence presents an exceptional opportunity – whether as a primary residence, an income-generating rental, or a versatile retreat.

Don’t miss your chance to experience the epitome of Santiago living. Seize this opportunity to make this exquisite property your own – schedule a viewing today and let your imagination soar.

### Casa Kinder

Urban   \*  Tranquility   \*  Elegance   \*    Modern   \*  Oasis

Indulge in the epitome of urban living with this beautiful house just a stone’s throw away from Parque de San Sebastian.

This spectacularly remodeled residence boasts three bedrooms, each accompanied by its own bathroom, ensuring unparalleled comfort and privacy. With the addition of a guest bathroom, pool, and terrace, every aspect of modern living is meticulously catered to.

Step inside and be greeted by a welcoming lobby, leading you to the first bedroom complete with an ensuite bathroom. On the opposite side, discover a versatile space encompassing a living room, TV room, and study, ideal for both relaxation and productivity.

A stunning stone wall elegantly separates the bedroom area from the kitchen, creating distinct yet cohesive spaces. Journey through the hallway to unveil the second bedroom, also featuring its own full bathroom, before arriving at the spacious kitchen and dining area, perfect for culinary pursuits and casual dining alike.

Venture outside to the inviting patio, where the refreshing pool beckons for leisurely dips and outdoor gatherings. At the rear of the property lies the main bedroom, offering tranquility and seclusion with its own full bathroom and charming private garden complete with a shower or outdoor-shower.

The allure doesn’t end there – immerse yourself in the ambiance of the pool terrace, where a bar awaits to elevate your evenings with the warmth of Merida’s nights.

The bedrooms have A/C and the back section of the house has a new roof. The doors are original and magnificent. Aside for some TLC, the house is move-in-ready!

### Stunning Beachfront Home!

Chuburna,

Yucatan

SOLD!!!!!!!!!!!!!

This stunning beachfront home located between Chuburna Puerto and Chelem, on a very large corner lot, is without question, one of the most beautiful properties on the market and the most accurately priced beachfront property currently on the market!

757m2 (8148.28 sq. ft.) lot with 276.12m2 construction (2972.13 sq. ft.)

Designed and built by an American contractor to US standards. The interior was done by a professional interior designer, for both beauty and practicality. Details, details and more details! This was designed for luxury!

As you enter the property, you walk into a beautiful garden with a very large pool that is surrounded by a beautiful mural. There is a very nice patio with a bar and outdoor kitchen.  There is a 2 car garage that has ample storage and a half bath; the double doors for the garage are automatic.

As you enter the house you have a beautiful view of the beach. The house has a very large, open floor plan for the kitchen, dining and living rooms. The windows on the ocean side are heavy-duty hurricane glass, spanning the full length of the front porch. Both of the first-floor bedrooms are large with ample closet space and full bath.

The second floor is totally self-contained. The second floor has an outside entrance staircase that makes it perfect for rental. The view of the beach is exceptional.

This property comes fully furnished!

A large double pantry, beautiful woodwork throughout the house, very spacious rooms and a well-kept garden add to the inviting and welcoming feeling from the moment you walk into this property.

The newly built bulkhead is exceptional in size and design to divert wave action.

In addition, the sale includes 24 solar panels, an 11kw automatic generator and a 2017 Nissan X-Trail. YES, this sale includes an auto! See photos.

This is an exceptional property at an exceptional price!

To view this property, contact Dr. Leroy Osmon, 999-125-6196 or email: leroy.osmon@gmail.com

\* A practical half guest bathroom for added convenience.  
\* A designated laundry room for everyday needs.

### Casa Tulpán Pre-sale

Merida,

Yucatan

Casa Tulpán is a Merida Centro Renovation Pre-Sale.

Casa Tulipán has 4 bedrooms and 4.5 bathrooms. There is a large kitchen-Living/Dining room area for full entertainment. There is a very nice pool on the terrace that is built for privacy and relaxation.  The house will include parking space for two cars.

The property is 5 minutes from the La Ermita Park and San Sebastián neighborhood. There is easy access to a large supermarket, local markets, historic Merida Centro and the Centenario Zoo.

Casa Tulipán will be a two-level residence distinguished by a functional design and spacious patio. The house is designed for comfort and efficiency. The builder is preserving the historic charm with beautiful pasta tile floors and a design that pays homage to the region’s traditional architecture.

To see this Pre-Sale property, contact Dr. Leroy Osmon, 999-125-6196 or email: leroy.osmon@gmail.com

### EXCLUSIVE | CASA VÉRTICE | GARCÍA GINERES

**OFFERED EXCLUSIVELY ON MEXICO INTERNATIONAL REAL ESTATE**

Casa Vértice presents a striking architectural presence defined by vertical scale, natural stone textures, and clean modern geometry. A dramatic double-height entry anchored by an exposed stone wall and floating wood staircase sets the tone immediately, introducing a home designed with intention, proportion, and visual impact rarely found in García Gineres. Lighted fountains at the front entrance create a refined arrival experience, reinforcing the home’s architectural identity from the moment you approach.

Inside, layered ceiling details, warm wood accents, and expansive sliding glass panels create a seamless transition between interior living spaces and the landscaped garden beyond. The layout feels open yet controlled, allowing natural light to travel through the home while maintaining a strong sense of structure and privacy. A full-height natural stone wall anchors the interior composition, while recessed lighting and wood beam detailing elevate the main living and kitchen areas. A large pantry and extensive storage areas support the home’s functionality without compromising its clean aesthetic.

Designed across two levels, the residence offers four bedrooms and five and a half bathrooms. The two downstairs bedrooms each feature en suite bathrooms, creating ideal accommodations for guests or multi-generational living. Upstairs, the primary suite functions as a private retreat, complete with a soaking bathtub, its own kitchenette with refrigerator, and direct access to an expansive terrace ideal for evening lounging and stargazing. A balcony off the yellow guest bedroom adds an additional outdoor moment, enhancing light and airflow on the upper level. The suite is further defined by statement designer countertops, selected as a focal architectural element, complemented by a primary bathroom that incorporates a private open-air shower garden blending natural light, greenery, and architectural privacy. Premium countertop upgrades continue into the powder room and master bath, adding a refined and tactile finish that speaks to the level of investment throughout the home.

The kitchen pairs quartz and granite surfaces with integrated appliances, a generous island, and exceptional storage capacity, flowing directly into the main living areas. Full-height glazing reinforces the indoor–outdoor connection, allowing the garden and pool to become a natural extension of daily living.

Outdoors, a sculptural geometric water feature wall frames the filtered swimming pool, transforming the landscaped garden into a private resort-style setting surrounded by mature royal and foxtail palms, illuminated pathways, and curated lounging zones featuring Ledge Loungers, umbrellas and furniture. The outdoor kitchen is fully equipped with a grill, burner, refrigerator, sink, and ample built-in storage, creating a true entertainer’s environment. A dedicated pool bathroom provides convenience for guests, while the pool mechanical room offers additional storage space rarely found in comparable homes. Two side breezeways allow discreet service access to the backyard and promote natural cross-ventilation throughout the property.

Built with entertaining and comfort in mind, the residence includes integrated exterior speakers, a full surround sound system throughout the house supported by three subwoofers and an 86-inch television, along with an automated irrigation system that maintains the mature landscaping year-round.

Additional infrastructure includes two garages with electric doors, ten air-conditioning units, solar panels, two water heaters, a private well, backup generator, and a comprehensive security system with cameras and app-controlled front gate access. A large washer and dryer are included, and a curated furniture inventory is available upon request.

Located just one block from the Slow Food Market and close to hospitals, supermarkets, and daily conveniences, Casa Vértice sits within one of García Gineres’ most established and peaceful residential pockets — offering tranquility without sacrificing proximity to Centro.

This is a residence for buyers who value architecture, privacy, and the freedom to host beautifully within a home that feels both bold and refined.

### Bright Beautiful Quiet Colonial

Mérida,

Yucatan

Location     \*     Cheerful     \*     Open     \*     Clean     \*     Remodeled

**Fully remodeled colonial home for sale in Mérida Centro near Santiago with heated pool, garage, and turnkey finishes in a quiet, walkable Centro location.**

This bright, fully renovated colonial home in Mérida Centro offers a combination of **modern upgrades, indoor-outdoor living, and a quiet residential setting** within walking distance of some of the city’s most desirable neighborhoods.

Remodeled in 2022, the home has been updated with new systems and finishes while preserving the charm of traditional Yucatán architecture. Located on a quiet street between Santiago and Santa Ana, the property is positioned for both **lifestyle living and long-term value**, with easy access to parks, restaurants, and central Mérida.

Set on a 286.8 m² lot with approximately 218 m² of construction, the home features an open floor plan designed for comfort and usability. Interior highlights include a spacious kitchen with crema Maya countertops, exposed stonework, skylights for natural light, and air conditioning throughout. Updated electrical, plumbing, and pressurized water systems provide modern reliability, while appliances and most furnishings are included for immediate use.

Outdoor spaces are designed for both relaxation and entertaining, with a **heated and filtered swimming pool, landscaped patio, and sunroom** that extends the living area. The inclusion of a garage or carport is a valuable feature in this part of Centro, where off-street parking is limited.

The location is a key advantage. The property is approximately five blocks from Parque Santiago, six blocks from Santa Ana and Paseo de Montejo, and seven blocks from Calle 47’s dining corridor, placing it within walking distance of Mérida’s most active cultural and culinary areas. Major shopping centers and the airport are within a 20-minute drive.

From an investment perspective, this property benefits from its **turnkey condition, walkable location, and desirable mid-market price point**. Fully remodeled homes in this area with a heated pool and parking are relatively limited and tend to attract consistent interest from both international buyers and renters.

This property may appeal to buyers seeking a **full-time residence in Mérida Centro, a second home, or a rental-ready property** with strong usability and resale potential. Its combination of quiet location, modern upgrades, and proximity to key landmarks positions it as a well-balanced option within the Mérida real estate market.

### Completely New House in Merida Centro!

Merida,

Yucatan

This is a totally new house built on an empty lot. It is not a restoration, everything is new!

It is in a very quiet area in Merida Centro, located on a cult de sac street. No bus traffic, no noise!

The first floor offers 1 bedroom (or office?) and 1 bathroom, kitchen and a large living room that completely opens to the garden/pool area.

The house is set up for A/C installation (110 and 220 wiring). The floors are polished cement. The doors and windows are made from cedar. There is a lot of natural light throughout the house and the staircase has skylights and a very big handrail. The kitchen stovetop is gas.

The second floor offers a suite with a very nice closet area and bath. There are 3 bedrooms upstairs and 2 bathrooms. Like the first floor, there is a lot of natural light.

There are three very nice additional “touches” with this totally new construction. The house has a water well, an advanced septic system and a special insulated material used on the roof.

For a 3 bedroom room (possible 4th bedroom on the first floor), off street parking, larger than normal pool (for Merida Centro), water well, quiet location AND ALL ELECTRIC AND PLUMBING NEW, this is a great price!

Note: The price of this property is $3,000,000.00 MXN pesos. At the time of posting, the USD price is $166,649. Please check the daily exchange rate for the current USD price.

To view this property, contact Dr. Leroy Osmon: 999-125-6196 or email: leroy.osmon@gmail.com

### All New – Crisp Clean & Super Cool

**Fully remodeled 2-bedroom home for sale in García Ginerés, Mérida with pool, modern systems, and turnkey design in a quiet, walkable location near Parque Las Américas.**

This completely renovated home in García Ginerés offers a combination of **modern construction quality, low-maintenance living, and convenient location** in one of Mérida’s most established residential neighborhoods.

Set on a corner lot of approximately 206.9 m², the property includes around 118 m² of construction with a functional open floor plan designed for comfortable daily living and easy upkeep. The home has been fully rebuilt with **all new electrical, plumbing, flooring, windows, doors, lighting, and high-efficiency inverter air conditioning**, providing a turnkey solution without renovation concerns.

Interior spaces include a bright living and dining area, modern kitchen with granite countertops and appliances, and two bedrooms with air conditioning. The layout also allows for the future addition of an upstairs primary suite, offering flexibility for expansion and added value over time.

Outdoor features include a **filtered swimming pool, private patio, landscaped areas, and off-street parking**, with a fully walled property providing privacy and security. Additional infrastructure includes a water well, pressurized water system, LED lighting, and modern filtration systems, supporting efficient long-term operation.

The location is a key advantage. The property is within walking distance to Parque Ibérica and Parque Las Américas, and approximately 10 minutes from Paseo de Montejo, with easy access to restaurants, grocery stores, hospitals, and the airport within 15 minutes.

From an investment perspective, this property stands out due to its **complete renovation, manageable size, and desirable neighborhood**. Homes in García Ginerés with new systems and pool features are increasingly sought after by buyers looking for a move-in-ready property without the complexity of Centro restoration projects.

This property may appeal to buyers seeking a **full-time residence, a lock-and-leave second home, or a rental-friendly property** in Mérida. Its combination of modern upgrades, quiet location, and accessibility positions it as a practical and well-balanced option in the local market.

### Merida Centro

Merida,

Yucatan

GREAT PRICE IN MERIDA CENTRO!

This Merida Centro property is located between Santiago and San Sebastian. It has easy access around Centro and easy access to the Airport.

There are 2 full bedrooms on the second floor and 1 bath. The “master” bedroom is located on the first floor. The first floor has 1.5 baths.

There is an exceptionally large and deep pool. Also, there is a workshop on street side (currently a bike repair shop) that would make a nice office or small retail business.

With some TLC this would make a very nice retirement home or rental property in a really good location.

### North of Centro – GREAT PRICE!!!

Merida,

Yucatan

This modern home is located North of Centro in Col. Franc. Montejo, a quiet residential area just 5 minutes from Costco and several major shopping malls and supermarkets. It is a great location to get in and around the city of Merida and ONLY 25 minutes to the beach!

The design is set up for 3 bedrooms, however, there is a potential for 5 bedrooms. A first floor area is currently being used as an office and a second floor area is being used as a TV room. The master bedroom is huge and has a large walk-in closet and bathroom with a jacuzzi!

The backyard has room for a small pool.

There is an exceptionally large second floor patio! The house is well built, on a quiet street and very safe area, and it has a carport!

When you view the photos, you will see a modern home built in the 1990’s that needs some paint and basic home maintenance. At the price of $3,150,000.00 MXN pesos ($177,500.00 USD at the time of this posting), it is a really great buy! PLEASE check the daily USD and MXN peso exchange rate for the most current USD price.

To see this property, contact Dr. Leroy Osmon 999-125-6196 or email: leroy.osmon@gmail.com OR contact Jina Bautista (Spanish) 999-175-4813.

### Centro Project With Expansive Garden Near Santiago

Located on Calle 65, just a short walk from Santiago Park, this traditional Centro property offers original character and one of the most valuable features in today’s market — a deep, buildable lot.

The existing home features original pasta tile floors, two bedrooms, one bathroom, and a garage. The layout is straightforward and functional, making it ideal for renovation, reconfiguration, or extension toward the rear.

The true highlight is the garden.

The lot extends generously behind the house, offering ample space for a substantial swimming pool, guest casita, additional bedrooms, or even a full secondary structure. Mature trees provide natural shade and privacy, creating the framework for a beautiful private compound.

Whether you restore the existing structure or incorporate it into a larger redevelopment plan, the size and depth of the lot give you flexibility that is increasingly rare this close to Santiago.

### Property Features

• 2 Bedrooms  
• 1 Bathroom  
• Garage  
• Original pasta tile floors  
• Large rear garden  
• Deep, buildable lot  
• Walkable location

### The Opportunity

Properties with this kind of depth near Santiago Park are becoming harder to find. The front structure provides a base, while the rear portion of the lot allows you to design the outdoor living space most buyers are seeking — pool, terrace, guest suite, or income-producing casita.

This is a land-value play with an existing structure already in place.

### Location, Location, Location!

Merida,

Spacious and bright Colonial Home in Prime Location – Perfect for Full-Time Living, a Vacation Home, or Investment

Discover the ideal blend of comfort, colonial style, and convenience in this beautifully restored Art Deco colonial home, nestled in one of the most sought-after locations for walking, dining, shopping, and sightseeing. Just steps from the newly renovated Calle 60 corridor and only four blocks from Plaza Grande, the Peon Contreras Theater, galleries, and historical landmarks, this property offers the ultimate in city living.

– \*\*Spacious & Bright\*\*: This home features 3 large, light-filled bedrooms, each with air conditioning and ceiling fans for year-round comfort. Enjoy the added bonus of private outdoor terraces attached to each upstairs bedroom, perfect for morning coffee or evening relaxation.

– \*\*Functional & Versatile\*\*: With 2 bathrooms, an office space, a dining room, a spacious living room, and a laundry room, the home’s layout accommodates both family living and remote work with ease.

– \*\*Outdoor Oasis\*\*: Step outside to a peaceful garden retreat with a private pool, outdoor shower, and an inviting sitting area surrounded by lush, shade-giving trees. It’s an ideal space for unwinding or entertaining guests.

– \*\*Excellent Investment Opportunity\*\*: Due to its prime location, this home has a strong rental history and is move-in ready, whether you’re seeking a full-time residence, a vacation getaway, or a great investment property.

This home offers unparalleled access to some of Merida’s most iconic sights, all within walking distance, while still providing a serene retreat to call your own. Whether you’re looking to settle in or capitalize on a fantastic investment opportunity, this property has it all.

### Unique Compound Steps From La Plancha

Merida,

Yucatan

This interesting property offers both a great investment return with currently four one-bedroom apartments, a large garden and pool, and great potential if adapted as a five-bedroom private home. Located in one of the hottest areas of downtown, just steps from the thriving Parque de la Plancha, the nicest and biggest public park in Merida.

It has three independent apartments sharing a main entrance and one separate apartment with access from the street. All of them have access to the garden through a common area in the front and each one has a private bathroom and kitchen. The structure is in very good shape, preserving stone walls and some of the original features.

Other great features are:  
– Large pool (4.5 x 7.5 meters) with filling and draining wells  
– 220V electric installation  
– Air conditioners in all bedrooms (4)  
– Ceiling fans  
– Quiet street

The location is great, given its proximity to attractions and quiet surroundings:  
– 6 blocks from Paseo de Montejo  
– 8 blocks from Santa Ana and Mejorada parks  
– 5 blocks from Chen Bech market

### Well Located Fixer Upper With Big Lot

Merida,

Yucatan

This property offers great possibilities given its central location in San Cristobal (Merida Centro) and large dimensions, with 444 mt² (4,780 ft²) of total area.

Once used as a business, the original structure with stone walls was used to host the offices and restrooms, with a total living space of 110 mt². The backyard was completely adapted and covered with a tin roof that served as a workshop.

The current category of the property is residential, which would easily allow permits to restore the property back to its original purpose and create a completely new living space.

Located within walking distance from important landmarks:

*   4 blocks from San Cristobal
*   6 blocks from Merida’s main market
*   9 blocks from Mejorada
*   10 blocks from La Plancha

\* Price in US dollars is informative. The price is set at **$4,200,000 Mexican pesos** or its equivalent in US dollars at the day of closing.
