### “LA CASA DEL SARAMULLO”: RECENTLY FULLY RENOVATED TWO BEDROOM HOUSE IN AN EXCELLENT LOCATION

Yucatan

This is your unique opportunity to get hold of a very nice, recently fully renovated two-bedroom house, in an excellent location, just off one of the main avenues in Mérida, Circuito Colonias, a wide communication channel which connects the main areas of the city.

The house has been completely renovated a couple of months ago and enjoys electric fans and minisplit A/C units in both bedrooms. It has two bathrooms and a nice kitchen area, besides the open dining room and a living room. It features a good-sized  back yard, that could easily accommodate a splash pool and barbeque area. It has a full off-street parking space for one car.

There is a storage area for washing/drying equipment. Electric water heater and water deposit.

Just take a look and you’ll fall in love with it. For additional information please contact Fernando Berdichevsky at my cell phone +(52)(999)9478386 or make use of WhatsApp. You could also leave me a message at Mexico International’s office phone: +(52)(999)9206856 or send me an email to: fberdich@usa.net

**“LA CASA DEL SARAMULLO”: CASA CON DOS DORMITORIOS TOTALMENTE RENOVADA Y EN UNA EXCELENTE LOCALIZACIÓN**  

Esta es su oportunidad única de adquirir una agradable propiedad que fue completamente remodelada hace un par de meses y que se encuentra localizada a pocos metros del Circuito Colonias, que constituye un amplio canal de comunicación entre las diferentes áreas de la ciudad.

La casa renovada con gran gusto en los detalles y tiene ventiladores eléctricos y unidades de aire acondicionado tipo mini Split en ambos dormitorios. Tiene, también, dos baños y una agradable área de cocina que conecta con un comedor abierto y una sala de estar. Posee, también, un patio trasero de bien tamaño que puede acomodar fácilmente una pequeña piscina y área para asados. Posee un garage para un auto.

Hay, también, un cuarto de almacenamiento para colocar una lavadora/secadora de ropa, así como un calentador de agua eléctrico

### Huge Home In The East Of Merida

Real estate in Merida has changed a lot in the last 5 years. The historic district’s prices keep on going up due to the great demand for colonial homes. It is harder now to find a great colonial at a bargain price. Many people are discovering areas that are 20 minutes away from Paseo Montejo.

This house is located in the east side of Merida. Close to Brisas and Col. Aleman.  
A 10-minute drive takes you to Macro Plaza, where you find many stores, including Wall mart and also local Supermarkets.

The house is very comfortable for a big family. The size of the lot made it possible to have a big front garden with a cover port for the car.  There is also a small porch that over looks the garden.

The back part of the house has a big patio with many fruit trees and a big pool on the side. The back-patio wall has a door that lead to the other street in case you want to make a covered garage there. This two-story home has several places that can be used to relax or be together as a family.

The Bottom side has a big living room, all the wood in the house is cedar. Doors, windows, stairs and kitchen drawers. The dinning room and kitchen share the same open space one level down. You use a two-step ladder to descend to the dinning room. The kitchen has plenty of drawer space.

There are also three rooms in this level One room has its own bathroom and the other two shared a bathroom, that could also be used by visitors. The stairs that leads to the second level are located between the living room and dinning room. As you enter the second level you find a big area used as a family room that has a door that leads to the upper terrace.  
In this level there are 4 bedrooms and one bathroom share by all the rooms.

The upper terrace, wraps around the rooms giving access from the room to the terrace.  
You get a huge house for a fair price, a 10-minute drive to Paseo Montejo, close to all the stores and with public transportation close and available.

If you want to know more about this house please contact me at arturo@mexintl.com or call me at +52999 9991271481. I will gladly show this house or any other in our page.

### Practical Home One Block From La Plancha

Merida,

Yucatan

This a nice and functional home in very good condition, located only one block from Parque de la Plancha and the gastronomy corridor. The property is 47 meters (154 feet) long, leaving a lot of room for additions and improvements.

The house includes:  
– Spacious front living room  
– Two bedrooms  
– One bathroom  
– Dining room  
– Kitchen  
– Central courtyard  
– Clean and large backyard

The location is ideal for a vacation rental home, given its proximity to all the attractions in the area:  
\* 4 blocks from Paseo de Montejo  
\* 5 blocks from Santa Ana  
\* 6 blocks from Mejorada

\*\* Price in US dollars is informative. The price is set at $5,500,000 Mexican pesos or its equivalent in US dollars at the day of closing.

For more information contact Joel R De Leon at 9999 20 68 56, cell 9991 29 38 15 or by email to jrdeleon76@gmail.com.

### Casa De Piedra En García Ginerés

This is solid functional home, situated in the middle of an iconic area of Merida, at very short distance from Parque de las Americas and Colon Avenue. Filled with natural light, with spacious rooms, high beamed ceilings and a generous front area.

The property includes:  
– Huge living room  
– Open kitchen and dining room that could be easy redesigned  
– Powder room  
– Three bedrooms  
– One full bathroom  
– Front and back terraces

Most of the structure is made of stone walls and the ceiling has thick concrete beams that could easily support a second floor. The floor has a mix of pasta and ceramic tiles.

The property has potential as a private home or business in an area under transformation with many new restaurants, coffee shops and stores. The streets are wide and easy to walk, surrounded by trees and gardens.

\* Price in US dollars is informative. The price is set at $5,900,000 Mexican pesos or its equivalent in US dollars at the day of closing.

### Unique Centro Opportunity

\*\*Charming Income Property in Merida Centro – Three Fully Rented Units!\*\*

This exceptional property offers a rare investment opportunity with three rental units on one lot, all generating consistent income. Located in the heart of Merida Centro, this well-maintained property includes two spacious one-bedroom apartments and a charming casita, each with a proven rental history and currently leased.

\*\*Key Features:\*\*

– \*\*Two One-Bedroom Apartments\*\*: Each apartment is fully equipped with everything tenants need for a comfortable living experience, including fully stocked kitchens with stoves, refrigerators, and ample storage. Both units offer air conditioning, a full bathroom with a shower, and cozy, modern furnishings.

– \*\*Casita\*\*: A private and inviting casita that offers the perfect blend of comfort and charm.

– \*\*Renovation\*\*: The property underwent thoughtfully renovation/additions about 8 years ago, ensuring modern finishes while maintaining its character.

– \*\*Outdoor Amenities\*\*: Tenants can enjoy a refreshing swim in the shared pool or unwind in the peaceful patio area.

– \*\*Convenient Storage\*\*: A separate bodega provides additional storage space, and a washer is available for tenants’ convenience.

This property is ideal for anyone looking to own an income-generating investment in the vibrant and desirable Merida Centro. With all three units currently rented and offering all the essential amenities, it’s the perfect turn-key solution for a savvy investor.  (Possibility to acquire additional property next door if expansion is desired.)

Price is shown in USD, tied to a MXP of $5,950,000.  Price could vary slightly due to currency fluctuations.

For additional information or to schedule a private tour, please contact Shawn via email at shawnke01@gmail.com or call/WhatsApp at +1 530 306 0085. If you have any questions about other properties you’ve viewed, I’d be happy to assist with those as well. Thank you for considering this home!

### Casa Xamaica: Modern Comfort With Mexican Flair In Santiago

Discover Casa Xamaica, a stunning 3-bedroom, 3.5-bathroom modern home located in the charming Santiago neighborhood of Mérida. Just a short stroll from Santiago Market, this home perfectly blends contemporary design with traditional Mexican touches, such as vibrant pasta tile walls, polished concrete, and mampostería finishes.

Built only six years ago, this 197 m² property offers airy common areas, a tranquil pool with a cascading waterfall, and a high iron-gated garage for privacy and security. The thoughtfully designed layout, with ensuite bathrooms for all bedrooms, makes it ideal for families or groups seeking both connection and privacy.

Whether you’re relaxing by the pool or exploring the vibrant local area, this home caters to various lifestyles:

Families: Spacious bedrooms and well-equipped common areas.  
Investors: A prime location with an established Airbnb rental history.  
Remote Workers: High-speed internet and serene surroundings.

Don’t miss this rare opportunity to own a unique property in one of Mérida’s most historic neighborhoods!

### Casa De Leon — Sought After Property To Renovate

Prime Downtown Mérida Property with Architectural Plans Included

Situated in the heart of Mérida’s historic center, this renowned property boasts a unique L-shaped design spanning Calle 63 and Calle 68. Its central location, just a few blocks from Plaza Grande, makes it a sought-after gem, ideal for restoration or luxury development.

– Lot Size: 599.82 m²  
– Construction Size: 381.54 m²  
– Direct Parking Access: Conveniently located on Calle 68  
\-This property, with renderings designed by Arkham Projects, offers an incredible opportunity to create a masterpiece in one of Mérida’s most desirable areas. The sale includes architectural plans that envision a luxurious home with a bar, pool, rooftop terrace, and lush green spaces, all tailored to immerse you in the region’s rich traditions and modern comforts.

Proximity to Key Landmarks:

– Plaza Grande: 5 minutes by foot  
– Paseo de Montejo: 7 minutes by car  
– Mérida International Airport: 15 minutes by car  
– Progreso Beach: 40 minutes by car  
– La Isla Mérida Mall: 25 minutes by car

This is your chance to own a piece of Mérida’s history while creating your future. Contact us today to learn more!

\*Linked to a MXN Peso listing price starting at $7,500,000 MXN\*

Price is based on currency rates of exchange in effect at the time of uploading. Price is subject to change without prior notice due to currency fluctuation.

### Restored Home In Mérida Centro – Colonia Lourdes

This beautifully remodeled home in the heart of Mérida’s historic Centro offers a perfect balance of history and modern comforts. With generous living spaces, a private patio, and the advantage of being close to the city’s main attractions, this home provides everything you need for comfortable living in Mérida.

Property Features  
This spacious home includes three bedrooms, each with its own private bathroom. The master bedroom is equipped with a closet, a full bathroom, and a bathtub, while the two secondary bedrooms each have closets and full bathrooms. The open-plan living and dining area provides ample space for entertaining, while the kitchen features elegant terrazzo countertops and a convenient bar for casual dining. A laundry room adds to the home’s practicality, and outside, you’ll find a large private pool and a shaded terrace with a BBQ bar, ideal for gatherings. The property also includes ample interior and outdoor space and a garage for one vehicle.

Interior Features  
The home is equipped with air conditioning in all bedrooms and ceiling fans throughout the living areas and bedrooms to keep you cool. The pool includes a fill/drain well and a filtration system for easy maintenance, while custom carpentry enhances the closets and kitchen cabinetry.

### 2 Story Pre-sale 7 Blocks From La Plancha

Garage   \*  Luxury   \*  Spacious   \*    Modern   \*  Garden

Charming Two-Story Home in the Heart of Merida

Property Details:

The property sits on a land area of 8.9 x 29 meters (257 m²) with a construction size of 239 m² spread over two floors.

This thoughtfully designed home offers 3 spacious bedrooms—1 downstairs and 2 upstairs—all equipped with closets and individual air conditioning units (5 total). There are 3 full bathrooms plus a convenient guest bathroom.

The fully equipped kitchen includes all appliances: refrigerator with freezer, dishwasher, microwave, stove, and oven. A dedicated countertop with abundant electrical outlets provides extra space for small appliances or prep. LED lighting is installed throughout the home for energy efficiency and modern ambiance.

Living spaces include a reception area, dining room, and a comfortable lounge, along with an upstairs office space ideal for remote work.

Step outside to enjoy the 2 x 5 meter pool with a smart overflow runoff system that allows excess rainwater into a stone-lined channel around the perimeter. The covered patio features a built-in bar area—perfect for entertaining.

Additional highlights include:

*   Covered parking for 2 vehicles with an electric gate
    
*   Illuminated garden with automatic irrigation system
    
*   Laundry room and separate pool equipment room
    
*   Private service entrance for gardeners or pool maintenance staff

### The Pineapple House

Merida,

Yucatan

PRICE REDUCED!!!

Beautiful showcase Colonial home in Santiago (Merida Centro). The location makes this perfect for your dream retirement home or rental property.

Exceptional home in the heart of Merida, unique in design and it is just a couple of blocks from the Santiago Market. Easy walk to EVERYTHING in Centro! Restaurants, entertainment, shopping, parks, theaters, super-market, transportation, medical, the Zoo… and so much more.

This is a stunning 3 bedroom with a magnificent library that could serve as a 4th bedroom and 3 full baths (2 with Jacuzzi!). A large chef’s kitchen with ample prep space and dining area. Marble countertop island with stovetop, with everything within reach!

There is a very tranquil feeling about this beauty that includes a center courtyard/garden with fountain. The interior is painted with soothing earth tones and has soft lighting that give the home a very warm and inviting atmosphere.

Huge pool of exceptional depth that is surrounded with sculptures with adjustable lighting that make the pool area an amazing area for night parties.

The antique furnishings in the house are exceptional and can be purchased separately – MAKE AN OFFER!

To see this beautiful home, contact Dr. Leroy Osmon 999-125-6196 or email: leroy.osmon@gmail.com

### Casa de las Brisas – Rooftop Terrace with Ocean Breezes in Progreso

  
_2 Bed | 2.5 Bath | Rooftop Terrace | $6,800,000 MXN_

### Property Overview

Located in the Ismael García neighborhood of Progreso, Casa de las Brisas offers clean lines, functional design, and a breezy rooftop terrace. Ideal for full-time living or as a beach getaway, just a short walk from the ocean.

### Layout & Features

*   Two-story layout plus rooftop
*   Two bedrooms, each with private bath
*   Guest powder room on ground level
*   Open-concept kitchen, dining, and living space
*   Rooftop terrace with partial shade and coastal breeze
*   Off-street gated parking (compact car)
*   Low-maintenance outdoor areas
*   Fully walled property with privacy

### Additional Details

*   Sold furnished
*   Mini-split A/C in both bedrooms
*   Pressurized water system (no filtration)
*   Construction: 241 m²
*   Lot: 180 m²
*   Located on a lively street near shops and local services, a few blocks from the beach

### Casa San Sebastián | Modern Restoration in Mérida Centro

Located in the historic Barrio de San Sebastián, this thoughtfully designed residence blends contemporary architecture with restored character, creating a calm and functional retreat just minutes from Mérida’s vibrant historic core. Set on a 221 m² lot with 151 m² of construction, the home is designed around natural light, interior gardens, and seamless indoor-outdoor living.

The main living area features an open-concept sala and comedor that flows effortlessly into an integral kitchen with bar seating and direct views toward the terrace and filtered swimming pool. High ceilings, cross ventilation, and carefully placed interior patios create a comfortable atmosphere throughout the day, while warm finishes and clean architectural lines give the home a refined yet relaxed presence.

Two bedrooms provide privacy and comfort, including a primary suite with a full bathroom, complemented by an additional full bath and a convenient half bath serving the terrace and pool area. A separate service room enhances functionality, making the property equally suited as a full-time residence or a high-performing investment in Mérida’s growing centro market.

Interior gardens, LED lighting, smart lock access, and sustainable infrastructure such as a biodigestor system highlight the home’s modern approach to living while maintaining the charm of its historic surroundings.

**Property Highlights**  
• 221 m² land | 151 m² construction  
• 2 bedrooms with carpentry closets  
• 2 full bathrooms + 1 half bath for terrace/pool  
• Open-concept living and dining area  
• Integral kitchen with bar and pool views  
• Terrace with filtered swimming pool  
• Independent service room  
• Interior gardens bringing natural light and airflow  
• High ceilings with excellent cross ventilation  
• Biodigestor water treatment system  
• LED lighting throughout  
• Smart lock entry system  
• Hydroneumatic pressure system and irrigation

**Investment & Lifestyle**  
Situated in one of Mérida Centro’s most authentic neighborhoods, Casa San Sebastián offers a balanced combination of design, practicality, and location. Its layout and amenities make it ideal as a stylish private residence, a seasonal getaway, or a boutique rental opportunity within walking distance of parks, local markets, and cultural landmarks.

### Gg19 Casa Cero Dos: 2 Bedroom / 2.5 Bathroom Stunner

Refined   \*  Tranquil   \*  Inviting   \*    Tailored   \*  Spacious

Modern Luxe Living

Welcome to a home that effortlessly blends modern luxury with contemporary comfort in the exclusive GG19 Gated Community. This two-bedroom, two-and-a-half-bath residence offers a refined living experience, balancing sleek design with serene, tranquil spaces.

Seamless Indoor-Outdoor Living

The living room sets the stage for relaxation and elegance, with large windows that provide sweeping views of the surrounding greenery. Step through the sliding glass doors to your private outdoor retreat, where a plunge pool invites you to unwind and recharge. The seamless connection between indoor and outdoor spaces enhances the home’s airy, open atmosphere.

Versatile Loft Space

Upstairs, the loft offers a flexible space that adds personality and charm to the home. Whether used as a cozy reading nook, a home office, or an extra guest room, this space adapts to your lifestyle while maintaining the home’s stylish aesthetic.

Private Retreats

The two bedrooms serve as peaceful sanctuaries, each with ample closet space and elegant en-suite bathrooms. Indulge in the walk-in showers or enjoy a relaxing soak in the deep tubs, creating the ultimate private escape at the end of the day.

Open-Concept Living

At the heart of the home is an open-concept living area that flows effortlessly between spaces. High ceilings and polished concrete floors give the home a sleek, sophisticated feel, while the clean lines and natural light create a welcoming, airy ambiance throughout.

Chef’s Dream Kitchen

The kitchen is a true centerpiece of the home, designed with both style and function in mind. Featuring premium appliances and minimalist cabinetry, it’s a space that encourages culinary creativity and easy entertaining, making it perfect for everything from casual meals to gourmet dinners.

### Casa Encantada, Superior Modern Home In Centro

This is amazing modern property in Centro, with a unique design and efficient spaces.

The ground floor has an open floor plan including all the social areas of the house, with nice finishes and functional areas:  
– Garage built on the original colonial front  
– Large living area  
– Great kitchen with breakfast bar and cabinets  
– Dining area  
– Guest bathroom  
– Covered terrace  
– Filtered pool  
– Garden

The second floor includes:  
– Huge master bedroom with bathroom and walk-in closet  
– Two large bedrooms with closets and one shared bathroom  
– Laundry room

The house is located 10 blocks South of the main square, with easy access to the city’s landmarks and traditional parks.

### Colonial Oasis Steps From La Plancha

This versatile colonial home is **move-in-ready** and offers a **private and tranquil** atmosphere. The house features **2 bedrooms,** **2 bathrooms**, high ceilings, a **large covered terrace**, lush landscaping, **pool** and a great layout. Located only steps from **La Plancha park** and the gastronomic corridor.

The house has been completely remodeled and designed for a **pleasant living experience**. The **colonial living room** with beamed **soaring ceilings** is stunning and leads to the kitchen, which has beautiful decorative tiles, **cabinets** and **large countertops**. From here, the house flows nicely into the courtyard, which brings great **natural light** and **ventilation** to both bedrooms. The master bedroom is detached and accessed easily through the terrace.

#### _Features that make it special_

*   Completely **furnished and decorated**
*   **Detached master bedroom** with en-suite bathroom, closet and great views
*   **Secondary bedroom** with closet and garden views
*   **Private** and **fully enjoyable courtyard** with pool, gardens and terrace made of French tiles (tejas)
*   **Fully tiled** floors with traditional **pasta** tiles
*   Beautiful **hard wood** doors and windows
*   **Closets** and **storage** space

#### _Unbeatable location_

*   **Quiet street** half a block from the beautiful **La Plancha** park
*   **Two blocks** from the vibrant **gastronomic corridor** on calle 47
*   **Five blocks** from **Santa Ana** and **Paseo de Montejo**
*   **Walking distance** to the main square, Santa Lucía and all the main attractions of downtown

#### _Investment highlights_ 

*   **Great condition** and maintenance
*   **Professionally managed** for years
*   Desirable **location** and **surroundings**

### Modern & Comfortable Home In Downtown

With a **unique design** and built with high standards by **construction professionals**, this home is a great opportunity to buy a unique and functional home in the North end of **Centro**.  Different textures, beautiful designs and thoughtful solutions can be found in every space of this beautiful home.

**Natural air flow** **and light** were an important consideration for the design so there are several sources strategically distributed throughout the property. Accents of colored **polished concrete walls** can be found in different parts of the house and pasta tiles decorate the kitchen wall nicely.

The first floor includes:  
– Modern facade  
– **Garage** for one car  
– Low maintenance **pool area** with plants and decorative wall  
– **Large living room** with double height and pool views  
– **Decorative wall** in living area with colored polished concrete  
– Kitchen with **breakfast bar, cabinets and granite countertops**  
– Cozy **dining room**  
– Full **guest bathroom**  
– **Third bedroom** / study  
– **Laundry room** with storage space

The second floor includes:  
– **Spacious master bedroom**  
– Master bathroom with **closet and granite countertops**  
– **Guest bedroom** with full bathroom and closet

Equippment included:  
– Ceiling fans in all rooms  
– Air conditioning in upstairs bedrooms, dining room and living room (4 total)  
– Water pressurizer and softener  
– Pool filter with timer  
– Automatic irrigation system  
– Electric water heater  
– Tempered glass in bathroom showers  
– Screens  
– Countertop stove

\* The house will be fully equipped after signing a sales contract, please ask for more details.

The **location is excellent**, at short distance from the downtown attractions and with easy access to the North areas. Located right in **between Centro and Garcia Gineres**.  
– 2 blocks from Parque de la Iberica  
– 7 blocks from Parque de las Americas  
– 10 blocks from Paseo de Montejo  
– 11 blocks from Santa Ana  
– 11 blocks from Santiago

\* Price in US dollars is informative. The price is set at **$6,650,000 Mexican pesos** or its equivalent in US dollars at the day of closing.

Luminous   \*  Sanctuary   \*  Ingenious   \*    Haven   \*  Sophistication

Ascend the beautifully designed staircase to discover a flexible loft area, ideal for a home office, reading nook, or guest accommodation. This space not only enhances the home’s functionality but also adds an extra layer of charm and character.

Gourmet Kitchen for Inspired Cooking

At the center of this stylish residence is a modern kitchen, fully equipped with high-end appliances and sleek cabinetry. Whether you’re an avid cook or love entertaining, this space is designed to spark creativity and deliver culinary delight.

Light-Filled, Spacious Interiors

From the moment you step inside, you’ll be welcomed by a bright, open space with high ceilings and large windows that bathe the home in natural light. The minimalist design and polished finishes enhance the sense of calm and spaciousness throughout.

Serene Bedrooms & Lavish Bathrooms

The bedrooms serve as private retreats, each featuring ample closet space and en-suite bathrooms. Unwind in the luxurious soaking tubs or rejuvenate in the walk-in showers, designed for ultimate relaxation and comfort.

Elegant Indoor-Outdoor Flow

The living area connects seamlessly to the outdoors, with large windows and sliding doors that open up to a private patio and plunge pool. Enjoy the natural beauty of the surroundings while embracing the peaceful atmosphere of your personal outdoor oasis.

### Quintas Baspul Villa — Spacious Living In Chicxulub Pueblo

Charming Hacienda-Style Retreat in Baspul

Discover tranquility in this hacienda-style sanctuary nestled within the Baspul residential enclave, just moments from Chicxulub Pueblo.

Prime Location:

Conveniently positioned 17 km from the captivating Yucatecan coastline and a mere 12 km north of vibrant Mérida.

Exceptional Features:

Covered parking for two vehicles, with additional space for four cars within the property.  
An inviting antique wooden door leads to a cozy space encompassing breakfast, living, and main dining areas, all seamlessly connected to the verdant garden.  
A well-appointed kitchen with granite countertops, adjacent laundry area, and direct outdoor access to the roof.  
Three delightful bedrooms, two of which share a generously sized bathroom, alongside a luxurious master suite featuring a spacious walk-in closet and en-suite bathroom.  
Secondary bedrooms boasting garden vistas and an outdoor terrace ideal for unwinding.  
A sprawling terrace adorned with hacienda-style arches, leading gracefully to a 12×5 meter pool.  
Two half bathrooms for guests, complemented by a versatile fourth room adaptable to various needs.  
A semi-covered outdoor terrace characterized by wooden logs and an expanse of lush garden space.  
Noteworthy features include pool illumination, custom cabinetry in closets, well-appointed kitchen drawers, bedroom air conditioning, and a host of other thoughtful details.

### Casa Reforma | 3 Bedroom 2 Bathroom Art Deco

Merida,

Yucatan

Casa Reforma is a restored Art Deco home in Mérida Centro, distinguished by its unusual width, strong natural light, and well preserved original details. High ceilings, original pasta tile floors, stained glass, and wrought iron doors and windows define the home’s architectural character, while all core infrastructure has been fully updated.

The property offers three spacious bedrooms and two bathrooms finished in Crema Maya stone. One bathroom features a glass brick shower inspired by classic Art Deco design. The kitchen was completely rebuilt with locally crafted cedar cabinetry, cement finishes, and granite countertops. All plumbing and electrical systems were replaced, which is a significant upgrade for a historic Centro home, and every room is prepared for air conditioning.

The living and dining areas are wide and open, separated by custom wrought iron doors that enhance airflow and bring additional light into the space. Ceiling fans are installed throughout, keeping the home comfortable year round.

The backyard is private and green, with mature plantings and a large filtered swimming pool with wide steps and built in seating. A tiled outdoor shower, tall privacy walls, and garden lighting make the space functional both day and evening. At the rear of the property is a separate casita currently used as an office, already plumbed for a future bathroom, along with a rooftop terrace suited for relaxing at sunset.

With an eleven meter frontage, this single level home feels notably bright and open and sits on a lot that allows for a future second story if desired. The front garden is framed by bougainvillea and includes a secure iron gate, rare off street parking, and a conveniently located septic system that simplifies long term maintenance.

The home is within walking distance of Paseo de Montejo, Santa Ana, Santiago, and Santa Lucía, offering immediate access to cafés, markets, and cultural venues while remaining removed from nightlife noise. A nearby police station provides an added sense of security and limits future construction next door.

### Casa Bello — Solar Powered & Turn Key

### Modern Solar-Powered Home with Pool Steps from La Plancha

### Overview

This contemporary 3-bedroom, 3.5-bathroom residence blends indoor/outdoor living with energy efficiency, just two blocks from La Plancha Park and four blocks from Paseo de Montejo. Featuring 22 solar panels, a water softener, and premium finishes throughout, the home offers low-maintenance luxury in one of Mérida’s most walkable locations.

### Layout & Features

The open-concept great room flows seamlessly to the outdoor living space through large sliding glass doors, creating a bright, airy atmosphere ideal for entertaining. A large island with quartz countertops and a marble backsplash anchors the chef’s kitchen, which is equipped with ample storage and top-quality appliances.

The ground floor includes a spacious bedroom with en-suite bath — perfect for guests or those seeking single-level living — along with a pantry, laundry area, and two bodegas for storage. Upstairs, two additional bedrooms each feature en-suite bathrooms. The primary suite boasts a walk-in closet, double shower, and space for a private seating area, while a second-floor balcony overlooks the pool and patio. Additionally there is a spacious office to work to comfortably work from home.

### Outdoor Spaces

The pool area is designed for year-round enjoyment, with easy access from the great room and a sunny terrace for lounging. Parking accommodates up to three cars, including one covered space. The home’s thoughtful orientation and solar system help keep energy costs minimal, even during Mérida’s warmest months.

### Itzimna 100b: Stylish Properties Excellently Done

Refined   \*  Idyllic   \*  Artful   \*    Serene   \*  Inviting

Exclusive Itzimná Residences – Casas 01, 03, and Duplex (04 + 05)

Nestled in the charming and historic neighborhood of Itzimná, this exclusive project offers modern living with a touch of timeless elegance. Conveniently located just minutes away from Prolongación de Montejo, Paseo de Montejo, and the Monumento a la Bandera, these residences provide both tranquil surroundings and quick access to the vibrant heart of Mérida.

Designed by renowned local architect Omar Fuentes, these homes feature high-quality finishes, beautifully landscaped gardens, and unique architectural details such as curved corners—a nod to the traditional building styles of Itzimná and Mérida’s Centro. Each unit comes with designated parking and includes all the comforts of contemporary living while honoring the neighborhood’s rich history and style.

Completion of the project is expected by March/April 2024, giving buyers the opportunity to secure their future home in one of Mérida’s most sought-after areas.

Casa 01: **!! SOLD!!**  
3 Bedrooms | 3.5 Bathrooms | Pool | 1 Covered Parking Spot  
Total Area: 262.06 m²  
Lot Size: 287 m²  
Price: MXN $11,445,000

Spacious and elegantly designed, Casa 01 offers a perfect blend of luxury and functionality. With three bedrooms and a modern, open-floor concept, this home is ideal for families or those who love to entertain. The private pool and carefully curated garden make for a peaceful retreat, while the high-quality finishes ensure every corner of this home exudes sophistication.

Casa 03: **!!AVAILABLE!!**  
2 Bedrooms | 2 Bathrooms | Pool | 1 Parking Spot  
Total Area: 152.22 m²  
Lot Size: 194 m²  
Price: MXN $8,610,000

Casa 03 is a cozy yet stylish two-bedroom home designed for comfort and convenience. The open living spaces seamlessly integrate with the outdoors, with access to a private pool and garden area. Perfect for smaller families or as a serene second home, this property offers a unique opportunity to enjoy Itzimná’s charm in a compact yet beautifully designed space.

Duplex: Casa 04 + Casa 05 **!!AVAILABLE!!**  
Casa 04: 1 Bedroom | 1.5 Bathrooms | Pool  
Casa 05: 2 Bedrooms | 2.5 Bathrooms | Pool  
Total Area: 380.3 m²  
Combined Lot Size: 305 m²  
Price for Duplex: MXN $10,867,500

This stunning duplex offers versatility and space, ideal for families or those looking for a dual-purpose property. Casa 04, with its single-bedroom layout and cozy pool, pairs perfectly with the larger Casa 05, offering two bedrooms and a more expansive living area. This duplex is an excellent option for buyers seeking to live in one unit and rent out the other, providing both a beautiful home and an opportunity for passive income. With private pools in both homes, a lush shared garden, and attention to architectural detail, this duplex truly offers the best of Itzimná living.

Why Itzimná?

Itzimná is a neighborhood known for its historic architecture, tree-lined streets, and peaceful ambiance, yet it remains just a stone’s throw from Mérida’s most popular avenues and cultural landmarks. Whether you’re walking through the tranquil streets or enjoying a short drive to the city’s best restaurants and shopping areas, Itzimná provides the perfect balance of old-world charm and modern conveniences.

### Huge Santiago Lot & Colonial

Huge classic colonial on a VERY large property (3 lots).

This is a very unique Santiago property. It is on a quiet street, within a few blocks of the Santiago market and it is huge!  The 3 combined lots (in 1 escritura – deed) equal 930.66 m2 (10,017.54 square feet) and the construction is 407.28 m2 (4383.92 square feet).

The colonial house needs some renovation, however, it is NOT a complete renovation. There is an extremely large back yard that is bordered by a old stone wall. The original pool is above ground (common for the day) and is about 12 feet deep.

The main house has very tall ceilings and old tile floors. All of the doors are original and are cedar! The second “house” was a doctors office complete with exam room, office, reception, 2 workrooms where the doctor designed and made artificial legs for his patients! In the back of the “medical practice” building was a salon where the owner would relax and listen to 1940-50 popular music from Yucatan. The old LPs – both 78 and 33 – remain and can be seen in the photos.

There are numerous storage rooms (bodegas) throughout the property and room to build  
more, including several casitas (guest houses).

Beautiful trees, including a very large peppercorn tree, fig, tamarind and several orange trees. The house is set back from the sidewalk to keep unwanted visitors from your front door!

The photos show the beautiful old colonial and all its history.

VIDEO: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=lLMD1-vq7\_4

A property this size in Santiago is rare and will allow the new owner to do just about anything they want – live in a beautiful mansion, create a small hotel, create a very beautiful multi-use rental property.

This property is tied to a price of $8,480,000.00 MXN pesos and the US Dollar price will fluctuate as the daily exchange rate goes up and down. The price on this webpage is the price at the time of posting.

### Casa Santiago Apóstol

Casa Santiago Apóstol is a newly remodeled masterpiece blending timeless colonial proportions with elegant contemporary design. The home has undergone a complete transformation including major new construction, resulting in a serene, light-filled residence with dramatic 16-foot ceilings, polished pasta tile and cement floors, and custom 10-foot hardwood doors throughout.

Inside, the layout flows effortlessly through a sequence of soaring spaces — living room, dining area, and a stylish chef’s kitchen framed by handcrafted cabinetry, marble countertops, and large steel-framed windows overlooking the courtyard. The home offers three bedrooms and three full bathrooms, each finished with refined minimalism, sculpted walls, and artisan details.

Outdoors, a covered terrace opens to an L-shaped pool and private garden surrounded by mature greenery — the perfect sanctuary for afternoon shade or evening entertaining.

Located in the vibrant Santiago neighborhood, one of Mérida’s most desirable historic districts, Casa Santiago Apóstol is within walking distance to local restaurants, cafés, markets, shops, and museums.

This elegant home is ideal for both year-round living and as an investment home in Centro Histórico.

### Colonial Dream

This old colonial,  one of the last of its kind to be found in this untouched state in merida and is just waiting to be bought back to life. The detailed facade is incredibly ornate and well preserved.

With over 1000 walled in square meters to build your dream home or business, this has the dimensions to fit any dream the prospective buyer could have.  It is difficult to capture the scale of the property in the photos and the abundance of trees also add to the charm.  The first row of rooms could easily be restored and allows the imagination to run wild as what to do with the rest.

Viewing is highly recommended as properties of this size in a perfect scale with ideal orientation do not come on the market often.

### Spotless Casa Citlalli – Recently Built

Merida,

Yucatan

Located in a very quiet section between Centro and Garcia Gineres, this beautiful contemporary home offers a unique and modern design with all the conveniences: 3 bedroooms, 2 full and 2 half bathrooms, well equipped kitchen, garage, pool and much more.

The ground floor has an open concept with a spacious social area, with views of the pool and garden. The kitchen has granite counter tops, pantry, nice cabinetry and includes all the appliances. There are also two half bathrooms, one inside the house and another one near the pool. The pool is surrounded by tropical plants and it’s filtered. Finally, there is a laundry room (appliances not included) and large a one-car garage with direct access to the house.

The master bedroom is located on the ground and includes a beautiful master bathroom with a double sink and an oversized walk-in closet. The other two bedrooms are located on the second floor, they both have closets and share a full bathroom, which also has a double sink and a nice design. Air conditioning is available in all bedrooms.

The house is located only a few blocks from Parque de las Americas and 2 blocks from Parque Iberica, great for enjoying walks surrounded by nature. The location has also easy access to important landmarks. Restaurants, coffee shops and services within walking distance.

Travel times by car:

*   _3 minutes to Paseo 60 (restaurants and bus station)_
*   _7 minutes to Santa Ana and Paseo de Montejo_
*   _8 minutes to Santa Lucia_
*   _12 minutes to Plaza Grande (main square)_
*   _20 minutes to_ _Merida’s international airport_

### Elegant Colonial Gem with Pool Just Steps from Santa Lucía Park

Colonial – Location – Turnkey – Sophistication – Sanctuary

**Historic Elegance in the Heart of Mérida Centro**  
Just one block from the iconic Santa Lucía Park, this beautifully restored 2-bedroom colonial home offers timeless charm in an unbeatable location. Built in 1903 and meticulously renovated in 2012, the property blends original details—such as soaring ceilings and colorful pasta tile floors—with the comfort of modern living.

**Refined Interior Spaces**  
The home features a light-filled layout centered around indoor-outdoor living. The open-concept living and dining areas flow seamlessly into the custom kitchen, complete with built-in cabinetry, natural stone finishes, and views of the pool. One of the bedrooms has a private ensuite bathroom, while the second bedroom has access to a full bathroom just outside the room. Both bedrooms enjoy excellent natural light and access to outdoor areas.

**Private Outdoor Retreat**  
Through a wall of glass doors, the living space opens onto a lush tropical garden with a swimming pool, patio, and covered terrace—ideal for relaxing or entertaining. Mature palms and ambient lighting add a resort-like atmosphere to this urban oasis.

**Prime Location**  
Santa Lucía is one of the most desirable neighborhoods in Mérida Centro, known for its weekend concerts, boutique restaurants, and art galleries. From this home, you can walk to Paseo de Montejo in minutes and enjoy easy access to the city’s best cultural and dining experiences.

### Casa 55 – Modern Luxury and Convenience in Santa Lucía

Step into **Casa 55**, a perfect blend of modern luxury and colonial charm—with a premium location in Mérida’s Historic Centre. Designed by award-winning architect **Henry Ponce**, this stunning two-bedroom home blends timeless elegance with clean, contemporary design to create a sanctuary that’s both stylish and serene.

The preserved front room greets you with its high beamed ceiling which opens to a large living space with an ambience of calm sophistication. Every detail, from the custom furnishings to the curated artwork, was chosen to inspire comfort, beauty and balance.

The seamless flow between indoor and outdoor living makes Casa 55 ideal for both relaxation and entertaining. Lounge by the **sunny pool**, unwind on the **covered terrace**, or host unforgettable evenings on the **furnished rooftop and bar** under Mérida’s starry skies.

#### _**Features You’ll Love**_

*   **Good sized garage** with ample storage
*   **Detached master suite** with full closet and spa-like bathroom
*   **Elegant second bedroom**, with en-suite bathroom
*   **Open-concept living and dining area** featuring an antique table for six
*   **Fully equipped kitchen** with breakfast bar and modern appliances
*   **Spacious covered terrace** with comfortable outdoor seating
*   **Inviting swimming pool** with full sun exposure
*   **Private and furnished rooftop terrace**

#### _**Location That Defines Convenience**_

Casa 55 is ideally situated just steps from Mérida’s most sought-after neighborhoods:

### Santa Ana Art Deco

This fully remodeled Art Deco home for sale in Santa Ana, Mérida offers a rare combination of **architectural character, modern infrastructure, and walkable Centro location** in one of the city’s most desirable neighborhoods.

Originally restored in 2017, the property has been upgraded with new electrical, plumbing, pumps, pool systems, air conditioning, and finishes throughout, creating a **turnkey residence that balances historic design with modern functionality**.

Set on a wide lot measuring approximately 15.8 meters in frontage, the home provides more interior volume and layout flexibility than many traditional Centro properties. This width allows for a more open and livable floor plan, with strong indoor-outdoor integration and natural light enhanced by skylights.

Interior features include decorative pasta tile floors, original hardwood doors, a fully equipped kitchen with granite countertops and pantry, and modern systems such as inverter air conditioning, pressurized and purified water, and LED lighting. The property is being sold fully furnished with appliances included, making it ready for immediate occupancy or rental use.

Outdoor spaces are designed for both comfort and entertaining, featuring a heated and filtered swimming pool, covered patios, landscaped areas, and a private walled setting. A carport provides off-street parking, which is a valuable feature in this part of Mérida Centro.

The location in Santa Ana is a key advantage. The home is approximately two blocks from Parque Ibérica, about four to five blocks from Parque Santa Ana, and within a short walk to Paseo de Montejo, Paseo 60, restaurants, shops, and cultural attractions. Major shopping areas in north Mérida are within a 20-minute drive, and the international airport is approximately 15–20 minutes away.

From an investment perspective, this property stands out due to its combination of **design, location, and turnkey condition**. Fully renovated homes in Santa Ana with architectural distinction and wider lot dimensions are relatively limited and tend to attract consistent interest from both international buyers and renters.

This property may appeal to buyers seeking a **full-time residence in Mérida Centro**, a second home, or a rental-ready property with strong resale potential. Its blend of Art Deco style, modern upgrades, and prime location positions it as a high-quality offering within the Centro real estate market.

### “CASA TRES MARÍAS”, NEWLY BUILT COLONIAL STYLE HOME IN A VERY DESIRABLE CENTRO LOCATION

Mérida,

Yucatan

This is your unique opportunity to get hold of a newly built, two stories colonial style home, in a very desirable Centro location, just a few blocks away from the beautiful Reforma Avenue, the Cultural Center la Ibérica, in the García Ginerés neighborhood and the Paseo Montejo landmark avenue. The builders have succeeded, as in previous projects, in recreating a beautiful architectural style which has resulted in a very modern two-bedroom house, with lots of fine architectural details, pasta floors and  beautiful carpentry.

Casa Tres Marías is more than a home: it’s a contemporary design concept in which every single space invites  to enjoy life. Its design is based on clean spaces and building materials, combining functionality with warmth, creating an inspirational home. It’s a shelter, in which architecture is art and a daily invitation to celebrate design.

**Architectural details:**

Noble and durable building materials were used, such as local hardwood, stone, tinted glass and the maya inherited chukum finishing. The living spaces are full of natural light and crossover ventilation. A swimming pool with a very special illumination for your celebrations. LED and indirect illumination are foremost details in every space

Lower floor:

Double height welcome area, which features panoramic windows, a dining room area which faces the garden, gourmet style kitchen with premium finishings, guest’s bathroom, laundry room, two car garage, storage room  and a garden with a relaxing pool.

Upper floor:

Reception area with natural illumination, main bedroom with a dressing room and a complete bathroom. Secondary bedroom, TV room and an additional space which might be converted into a studio area or a third bedroom with a complete bathroom.

The owner’s sales price is in MXP and therefore, the listing sales price in USD is subject to change without prior notice, due to currency rates of exchange fluctuations. The final sales price in USD will be based on the exchange rate at the closing date.

We suggest you schedule a visit to the property, and you’ll fall in love with it. For additional information please contact Fernando Berdichevsky by sending a Whatsapp message to my cell phone number +(52)(999)9478386. You could also leave me a message at Mexico International’s office phone: +(52)(999)9206856 or send me an email to: [fberdich@usa.net](mailto:fberdich@usa.net)

**“CASA TRES MARÍAS” CASA NUEVA ESTILO COLONIAL EN UNA LOCALIZACIÓN MUY DESEABLE DEL CENTRO**

Esta es su oportunidad única de adquirir una casa estilo colonial de dos pisos recién construida, en una ubicación privilegiada en el Centro, a solo unas cuadras de la hermosa Avenida Reforma, el Centro Cultural la Ibérica, en la colonia García Ginerés y el emblemático Paseo Montejo. Los constructores han logrado, como en proyectos anteriores, recrear un hermoso estilo arquitectónico que ha dado como resultado una casa muy moderna de dos recámaras, con finos detalles arquitectónicos, pisos de pasta y una hermosa carpintería.

Casa Tres Marías es más que una residencia: es un manifiesto de diseño contemporáneo, donde cada espacio invita a disfrutar la vida. Basada en líneas limpias y materiales atemporales, combina funcionalidad con calidez, creando un hogar que inspira. Un refugio donde la arquitectura se convierte en arte, y cada día es una celebración al diseño.

Detalles arquitectónicos:

Materiales nobles y resistentes como madera de la región, piedra, cristal entintado, acabados de chukum**.** Espacios llenos de luz natural y ventilación cruzada. Piscina con iluminación ambiental para noches especiales. Además, la iluminación LED juega un papel esencial, no solo cuidamos que cada espacio esté perfectamente iluminado, sino que integramos juegos de luz e iluminación indirecta que realzan los detalles arquitectónicos y crean atmósferas cálidas y sofisticadas.

Planta Baja:

Recibidor de doble altura, sala con ventanales panorámicos, comedor con vista al jardín, cocina gourmet con acabados PREMIUM, baño de visitas, lavandería, garage para 2 autos, almacén y un jardín con piscina diseñada para relajarse.

Planta Alta:

Vestíbulo con iluminación natural. Una habitación principal con vestidor y baño completo. Una habitación secundaria con baño completo. Sala de TV. Un espacio adicional, con la posibilidad de convertirse en un estudio o una tercera recámara con baño completo.

El precio de venta del propietario está en pesos mexicanos (MXP) y, por lo tanto, el precio solicitado en USD está sujeto a cambios sin previo aviso, debido a las fluctuaciones cambiarias. El precio final de venta en USD se basará en el tipo de cambio vigente a la fecha de cierre.

### Casa Naranja – Turnkey In Santa Ana

### Timeless Design Meets Tropical Ease

**A fresh take on Centro luxury**  
Casa Naranja strikes a rare balance between soft minimalism and rich local texture. Behind its modest street façade lies a fully reimagined 3-bedroom, 3.5-bath home that seamlessly connects light, space, and comfort. Think Venetian-inspired pool, chukum textures, rose gold finishes, and a towering double-height living room — all just blocks from some of Mérida’s most coveted spots. Best of all, this property is being offered fully turnkey!

### Layout & Atmosphere

Enter through iron-framed double doors into a serene, curated space:

*   A soaring living room with triple-height linen curtains, curated furniture by Verati Mobilia, and warm natural light filtering from above
*   A central dining area with a custom travertine table and Danish Wishbone chairs
*   Modern kitchen with terrazzo island, smart fridge, 5-burner stove, dishwasher, and rose gold fixtures
*   Three generous bedrooms — each with en-suite bath, walk-in closet, and Italian-designed beds
*   Guest half-bath, dedicated laundry zone with side sink, and custom carpentry throughout

### Outdoor Living

The backyard is a private sanctuary sculpted for Mérida’s climate:

*   Venetian canal-style pool with automatic chlorination, filtration, and remote-controlled LED lighting
*   Built-in sunken lounge with water feature
*   Native greenery, stone wall accents, and polished concrete pavers
*   Ideal flow from indoor to outdoor entertaining spaces

### Comfort & Infrastructure

*   Mini-split A/C units and ceiling fans throughout (WiFi control)
*   Pressurized water system with cistern + dual Rotoplas tanks
*   Day/night blinds, mosquito screens, and aluminum windows
*   Comex waterproofing and KIMICOLOR coatings
*   110L stationary gas tank with street-side refill access
*   Lot size: 216.29 m² | Construction: 244 m²

### Landmark Travel Times

*   La Plancha Park – 5 min
*   Paseo de Montejo – 3 min
*   Plaza Principal & Mérida Cathedral – 7 min
*   Mérida International Airport – 20 min
*   La Isla Mall – 30 min
*   Harbor Mall – 25 min

\*  Renovated   \*  Garage   \*  Rentability   \*    A+ Location   \*    Investment

A Stunning New Residence in the Popular Santa Ana Neighborhood

Nestled in the heart of Santa Ana, this brand-new home boasts a prime location that perfectly balances urban convenience and contemporary luxury.

Open-Concept Living for Unforgettable Gatherings

Step inside and discover a vast, light-filled living space designed for hosting memorable moments with loved ones. With soaring ceilings, abundant natural light, and a north/south orientation, this residence embodies a fresh start, with every element being entirely new.

Explore the Surrounding Gems on Foot

Convenience is key, as this home places you within a leisurely stroll of Santa Ana’s renowned destinations such as Paseo de Montejo, Santa Lucía, vibrant restaurants, charming cafes, inspiring art galleries, and captivating museums. This is an A+ location for those seeking a full-time residence in the center of it all or considering lucrative vacation rentals.

A Masterful Design with Modern Comforts

This impeccable home offers three generously sized bedrooms, each with its own en-suite bathroom, a welcoming foyer, an open floor plan that seamlessly connects the spaces, a well-appointed kitchen with a pantry, and an inviting covered terrace overlooking the large, sparkling pool. There’s even off-street parking for your convenience, along with spacious walk-in closets and an outdoor bathtub for indulgent relaxation.

Modern Amenities for Your Everyday Pleasure

For your everyday comfort, the property is equipped with pressurized water, a meticulously filtered pool for pristine swims, a hot water tank, and ceiling fans to keep you cool on warm Yucatán days.

This meticulously crafted residence harmoniously blends timeless elegance with contemporary convenience, offering you a lifestyle that’s as inspiring as the vibrant surroundings. Welcome home to Santa Ana’s finest.

### Casa Brisa Colonial

Colonial   \*  Elegant   \*  Turnkey   \*    Spacious   \*  Inviting

Casa Brisa Colonial – A Thoughtful Blend of History, Comfort & Elegance

Tucked away in the charming San Cristóbal neighborhood, Casa Brisa Colonial is a recently renovated, fully furnished home that seamlessly merges historic charm with modern convenience. Every corner of this 3-bedroom, 3.5-bathroom stunner has been thoughtfully designed, creating a space that is as practical as it is inviting.

Property Highlights:

\* Spacious Bedrooms & Luxurious Bathrooms – Each bedroom features its own ensuite bathroom and closet. One of the upstairs bathrooms is exceptionally large, offering ample space to add a relaxing bathtub if desired.

\* Bright Yet Perfectly Tempered Interiors – With high ceilings, ample natural light, and well-thought-out insulation, the home remains cool and comfortable year-round—never too warm, never too cold.

\* Elegant Historic Touches – The carriage wheel chandelier at the entrance, pasta tile details, and an exposed mampostería wall in the living room reflect the home’s colonial character.

\*Entertainment-Ready Spaces – A breakfast bar/countertop, plus a dining room table, provide multiple options for meals and gatherings. All bedrooms come equipped with flatscreen TVs for added comfort.

\* Gorgeous & Spacious Outdoor Area – The lushly landscaped garden, complete with mature trees, creates a serene oasis. There is plenty of space to expand or add new features if desired.

\* Inviting Pool & Unique Features – The irregularly shaped pool is perfect for relaxation, while the original above-ground cistern has been preserved and converted into a machine room.

\* Distinct Architectural Elements – A wrought iron staircase leads to two upstairs bedrooms, while the primary suite on the ground floor enjoys peaceful views of the garden.

### Restored Colonial In Prime Location

Located between the vibrant Santa Lucia and Santa Ana parks, in one of the most desirable areas of downtown, this beautiful colonial property has been preserved and well maintained through the years, offering a charming oasis in the heart of Merida.

The rooms are spacious, with high ceilings, pasta tiles and wooden doors. The house currently has: living room, dining room, kitchen, two bedrooms and one bathroom. It has great potential to add more rooms and a pool, as there is a substantial backyard.

The house’s recent history goes back to 1905 and the street it’s on, is one of the most beautiful in downtown, surrounded by historical mansions and amazing colonial architecture.

For more information contact Joel R De Leon at 9999 20 68 56, cell 9991 29 38 15 or by email to jrdeleon76@gmail.com.

### THE BEST OF THE VERY BEST HOMES IN MERIDA

Mérida,

Yucatan

Take advantage of a lovely property that combines old world charm with modern conveniences, that has been completely renovated with new and modern upgrades to the latest standards. It is located in one of Merida’s most desirable traditional neighborhoods. This home is fully furnished and ready to move in. It is a 10-minute drive from downtown. The home is located on quiet tree-lined street.

The one-story layout is fully equipped and has ample living areas, including a spacious living/dining room and kitchen, three bathrooms and two and a half bathrooms, a pool located in a lush garden, a laundry room, a covered terrace, screened windows and a two-car garage.

### Casa Reforma | 3 Bedroom 2 Bathroom Art Deco

Casa Reforma is a restored Art Deco home in Mérida Centro, distinguished by its unusual width, strong natural light, and well preserved original details. High ceilings, original pasta tile floors, stained glass, and wrought iron doors and windows define the home’s architectural character, while all core infrastructure has been fully updated.

The property offers three spacious bedrooms and two bathrooms finished in Crema Maya stone. One bathroom features a glass brick shower inspired by classic Art Deco design. The kitchen was completely rebuilt with locally crafted cedar cabinetry, cement finishes, and granite countertops. All plumbing and electrical systems were replaced, which is a significant upgrade for a historic Centro home, and every room is prepared for air conditioning.

The living and dining areas are wide and open, separated by custom wrought iron doors that enhance airflow and bring additional light into the space. Ceiling fans are installed throughout, keeping the home comfortable year round.

The backyard is private and green, with mature plantings and a large filtered swimming pool with wide steps and built in seating. A tiled outdoor shower, tall privacy walls, and garden lighting make the space functional both day and evening. At the rear of the property is a separate casita currently used as an office, already plumbed for a future bathroom, along with a rooftop terrace suited for relaxing at sunset.

With an eleven meter frontage, this single level home feels notably bright and open and sits on a lot that allows for a future second story if desired. The front garden is framed by bougainvillea and includes a secure iron gate, rare off street parking, and a conveniently located septic system that simplifies long term maintenance.

The home is within walking distance of Paseo de Montejo, Santa Ana, Santiago, and Santa Lucía, offering immediate access to cafés, markets, and cultural venues while remaining removed from nightlife noise. A nearby police station provides an added sense of security and limits future construction next door.

### Santa Ana – Colonial Rooms with Huge Land Size

Merida,

Yucatan

**Exceptional Investment Opportunity in Santa Ana — Merida’s Most Coveted Historic Neighborhood**

An extraordinary rare offering in the heart of **Santa Ana**, just steps from the celebrated **Calle 47 gastronomic corridor**, charming cafés, art galleries, boutique shops, and within easy walking distance to the iconic **Paseo de Montejo** — one of Mérida’s most beautiful boulevards lined with grand mansions and cultural landmarks.

**Size, Scale & Potential**

This _uncommonly large_ 1,100 m² property boasts a remarkable **17-meter frontage**, an unheard-of width in Centro Merida, presenting unparalleled potential for restoration, reimagination, and redevelopment — whether as a private **Colonial residence**, **luxury boutique hotel**, or **B&B compound**.

**Historic Charm Meets Urban Convenience**

Strategically positioned near **Parque Santa Ana**, this property is enveloped by the vibrant rhythm of historic Mérida living. Its configuration includes original colonial rooms with **soaring ceilings** and authentic architectural elements — a canvas rich with historic character, ready for thoughtful preservation or creative transformation.

A particularly _rare feature_ in the historic center is the existing **garage entrance** — a practical asset that enhances the property’s functionality and appeal for both residential and commercial uses.

**Walkable Lifestyle & Premier Location**  
From this address, virtually everything — world-class dining, cultural hotspots, parks, museums, and the dynamic Paseo de Montejo — is within walking distance. This unique combination of scale, historic charm, strategic location, and development flexibility makes this property one of the most compelling offerings currently available in Mérida’s historic core

Whether you are dreaming of creating your own **colonial mansion**, developing a **signature hotel**, or designing a bespoke mixed-use project, this property’s size and storied bones provide a truly exceptional foundation for virtually any vision.

### EXCLUSIVE Turnkey La Ermita Turnkey – 2 Bed | 2.5 Bath

**OFFERED EXCLUSIVELY ON MEXICO INTERNATIONAL REAL ESTATE**

A thoughtfully restored Centro home that blends original character with modern comfort, set on one of the most walkable streets in the historic core.

This residence, features original pasta tile floors, high ceilings with exposed beams, and a warm, cohesive layout that flows naturally from interior living spaces into the garden and pool area. The custom-made kitchen and bar serve as the heart of the home—ideal for both everyday living and entertaining.

Outdoors, the filtered swimming pool, landscaped garden with foundation, integrated lighting, and irrigation system create a low-maintenance yet atmospheric setting. Upstairs, a rooftop terrace adds valuable outdoor living space—perfect for evening gatherings or quiet mornings.

The home is offered fully furnished (artwork excluded), making it a turnkey option for full-time living, a second home, or an income-producing property in Mérida Centro.

### Property Highlights

• 2 bedrooms  
• 2.5 bathrooms with Crema Maya tile finishes  
• Original pasta tile floors  
• High ceilings with exposed beams  
• Custom kitchen and built-in bar  
• Filtered swimming pool  
• Landscaped garden with lighting & irrigation  
• Rooftop terrace  
• Furniture included (excluding artwork)

### Location

Located near parks, markets, and the main bus station, with excellent walkability and easy access to Centro amenities.

### Santiago Solar Colonial Artist B&b

**Turnkey 6-suite colonial B&B for sale in Santiago, Mérida Centro with pool, solar panels, and walkable location steps from Parque Santiago and downtown.**

This income-producing colonial property in Santiago, Mérida offers a rare opportunity to acquire a **fully configured boutique hotel or bed and breakfast in one of Centro’s most active and walkable neighborhoods**.

Set on a 413.85 m² lot with approximately 176 m² of construction, the property includes **6 private guest suites, each with its own bathroom and kitchenette**, making it immediately suitable for hospitality use, short-term rentals, or multi-unit living.

The home features traditional colonial elements including **beamed ceilings, decorative pasta tile floors, and original hardwood doors and windows**, combined with modern systems such as air conditioning, ceiling fans, and solar panels for improved energy efficiency and reduced operating costs.

Interior spaces include a spacious commercial-style kitchen, common areas for guests, and a loft space that can be used for additional accommodation, office, or storage. The layout is designed to support both owner occupancy and guest operations.

Outdoor areas include a **central courtyard and filtered swimming pool**, creating a comfortable environment for guests and enhancing the property’s appeal for vacation rentals or boutique hospitality use.

The location is a key advantage. The property is located just around the corner from Parque Santiago, one of Mérida Centro’s most vibrant areas, known for its restaurants, markets, live music, and cultural activity. Downtown Centro, Paseo de Montejo, and major attractions are all within walking distance, making it highly attractive for visitors and renters.

From an investment perspective, this property stands out due to its **existing income-ready configuration, prime location, and scalability**. Properties already set up with multiple guest suites in Santiago are limited and offer the ability to operate immediately or reposition as a boutique hotel, co-living space, or long-term rental property.

This property may appeal to buyers seeking a **hospitality business in Mérida, a multi-unit rental property, or a large residence with income potential**. Its combination of layout, location, and infrastructure positions it as a high-value opportunity within the Mérida Centro real estate market.

### Loaded Home In Garcia Gineres

“Solar-powered 4-bedroom home with guest casita for sale in García Ginerés, Mérida, featuring pool, security systems, and turnkey infrastructure.”

This spacious, solar-powered home for sale in García Ginerés, Mérida offers a rare combination of **large-scale living, modern infrastructure, and private compound-style design** in one of the city’s most established residential neighborhoods.

Set on a 420 m² lot with approximately 315 m² of construction, the property includes **4 bedrooms, 4.5 bathrooms, multiple living areas, and a separate guest casita**, making it well suited for full-time living, multigenerational use, or rental flexibility.

Designed for comfort and security, the home features high perimeter walls, controlled access gates, surveillance systems, and smart-lock technology, allowing owners to travel or rent the property with confidence. Interior spaces include a large open living area, formal dining for eight, a TV room, office with built-ins, and a fully equipped kitchen with granite countertops and modern appliances.

The property is engineered for long-term efficiency and reliability, with **14 solar panels and a backup battery system**, resulting in extremely low electricity costs, along with a pressurized water system, water softener, purified drinking water, and multiple high-capacity water heaters. These systems significantly reduce operating costs and improve daily comfort.

Outdoor areas are designed for both relaxation and entertaining, featuring a landscaped garden with mature palms, an in-ground swimming pool with filtration system, and multiple patio and terrace spaces. A screened-in porch with bar and fridge adds additional functional living space, while upstairs suites include private terraces overlooking the property.

A separate one-bedroom casita with its own kitchen and bathroom provides flexibility for guests, staff, or rental use, further enhancing the property’s versatility as both a residence and income-producing asset.

The location in García Ginerés is a major advantage. The home is minutes from Parque de Las Américas, Clínica de Mérida, restaurants, shopping, and Centro, offering a balance of residential privacy and urban accessibility. This neighborhood is known for its wide streets, established infrastructure, and proximity to both historic Centro and north Mérida.

From an investment perspective, this property stands out due to its **size, energy efficiency, security features, and multi-use layout**. Homes with guest casitas, solar systems, and full infrastructure in García Ginerés are limited and tend to attract consistent demand from both local and international buyers.

This property may appeal to buyers seeking a **large primary residence in Mérida**, a compound-style home with guest accommodations, or a property that can support both personal use and rental income. Its combination of scale, systems, and location positions it as a high-quality offering within the Mérida real estate market.

### Secluded Home With Privileged Land In Santiago

Merida,

Yucatan

This unique property offers a **1,751 meters² of total area**, a solid and functional **5-bedroom home** and a quiet location, only a few blocks from Parque de **Santiago**.

The property is located on a corner with a **access from two streets** and it’s delimited by thick stone walls. It currently has a carport in the front but the side entry allows **unlimited parking spaces**. The house is surrounded by gardens and fruit trees on three sides, offering a peaceful environment. Most of the construction is approximately from the 1970’s but two of the bedrooms have tall ceilings and stone walls from a previous stage.

The house currently _has:_  
_– Large front garden and porch_  
_– Formal living and dining rooms_  
_– Large eat-in kitchen_  
_– Office_  
_– Five bedrooms with views to the gardens_  
_– Private living room_  
_– Service quarters_  
_– Two full bathrooms_  
_– Large covered terrace and barbecue area_  
_– Large concrete playground_  
_– Wheel chair access at the back_

Located only 6 blocks from Santiago park and 10 blocks from the main square.

An office and entertainment room onto a dining room and kitchen. The first bedroom has two rooms so perfect for a child, an en-suite or unexpected guest. The second bedroom has an enviable access to the beautiful pool with a fully equipped summer kitchen and lounge. Rare find so close to the main square and perfect for an Airbnb rental or home.

### EXCLUSIVE | Turn-Key Solar Home | Quiet García Ginerés Cul-de-Sac

**OFFERED EXCLUSIVELY ON MEXICO INTERNATIONAL REAL ESTATE**

Turnkey • Solar • Quiet • Efficient • Refined

Set on a private dead-end block in García Ginerés, this turn-key home offers the perfect blend of modern efficiency and Mérida charm. The location is one of the area’s best-kept secrets — a quiet, low-traffic cul-de-sac pocket surrounded by mature trees, close to everything yet wonderfully peaceful. It’s an ideal setting for homeowners who value privacy, calm, and quick access to the city’s key districts.

Built in 2018 and beautifully maintained, the property delivers a warm, contemporary feel throughout. Rich pasta tile floors, crema maya bathrooms, and granite countertops give every room a sense of comfort and quality. The open social spaces connect naturally to the outdoors, with large windows inviting in soft light and green views.

A true standout is the professional-grade kitchen — spacious, functional, and ready for cooks who love to entertain. All furniture and appliances are included (artwork excluded), making this a genuine turn-key opportunity.

The outdoor area centers around a filtered pool framed by greenery, perfect for quiet afternoons or weekend gatherings. With 20 solar panels, a water softener, excellent water pressure, washer/dryer, and an electronic carport, the home is fully equipped for efficient, low-maintenance living.

All three bedrooms are private and comfortable, each with a full crema maya bathroom. An additional half bath on the ground floor serves guests with ease.

This is a complete package: move-in ready, thoughtfully designed, and located on a rare cul-de-sac block that offers true urban tranquility.

### Casa Romina Santiago

Merida,

Casa Romina Santiago

This beautiful renovated house, located in Barrio de Santiago, is a captivating blend of history and modernity in the heart of downtown Merida.

As you step inside, the pasta tile floors greet you, reminiscent of the city’s rich architectural heritage. The dining room, bathed in natural light, sets the stage for delightful gatherings. The living room is warm and comfortable.

Adjacent, the well-appointed kitchen shines with its modern amenities. Discover ultimate luxury in four master suites, each with its own bathroom.

Outside, the filtered swimming pool offers a refreshing retreat, while solar panels and inverter AC in every room ensure sustainability and comfort.

A beautiful restoration by one of Merida foremost builders, located in Santiago – Merida Centro.

Everything about this property screams elegance!

\*4 large bedrooms (2 in the main house and 2 in the casita) with full bath. The main house also has an additional 1/2 bath.

\*Beautifully designed kitchen and dining area.

\*Huge patio with pool and accent garden.

\*Several beautiful natural stone walls.

\*Terraza

\*Filtered pool

\*Solar panels

\*Garage

\*Laundry room

\*Walk-in closets

### Casa Del Mundo

Restoration · Scale · Garden · Colonial · Investment

### Expansive Colonial Home with Garden Oasis in La Ermita

Located just steps from La Ermita Park, this rare colonial property stretches deep into the block, offering a unique opportunity for transformation. With a stately facade, sprawling gardens, and a versatile layout, the home holds immense potential for a large family residence, boutique hotel, or creative restoration project.

### Outdoor Living

A long garden path flanked by lush greenery leads from the front of the property to a shaded rear terrace covered in climbing vines. The expansive back garden is dotted with mature trees and offers plenty of room to add a pool, guest casitas, or even more outdoor living areas. The tranquil setting feels worlds away while being right in Centro.

### Layout and Potential

Currently distributed across various sections, the home includes a mix of finished and unfinished spaces. In its present state, there are 3 bathrooms and enough existing structure to accommodate up to 7 **bedrooms**. The central area features soaring ceilings, pasta tiles, and wooden doors, while the rear additions open directly onto the gardens and terrace.  
This flexible layout makes it ideal for a multi-unit conversion, a B&B, or a large private residence with independent guest quarters.

### Kitchen and Interior Details

The kitchen overlooks the garden and is finished with artisanal tilework and wooden cabinetry. Throughout the main living spaces, period details like ironwork, beams, and antique doors remain intact, offering a strong architectural foundation to build upon.

### Location

Tucked into one of Mérida Centro’s most iconic and walkable neighborhoods, La Ermita is known for its village-like charm, historic church, and leafy park. It offers a peaceful atmosphere with close proximity to downtown dining, galleries, and shopping.

### Casa Lucia Centro Merida Colonial

Merida,

Yucatan

Casa Lucia Centro Merida Colonial Restoration Is Ready To Move Into!

Casa Lucía is a beautiful restored residence with an impeccable design, located in the heart of the city, in the Ermita area. Its location is strategic, just a few steps from the Ermita Park, the San Juan Park and the San Sebastián Market. A few blocks away, you will discover the busiest social centers, such as Parque de Santiago, Santa Lucía and Plaza Grande, where you can enjoy various gastronomic options and outdoor activities.

The façade of the house stands out for its masonry finish, typical of Yucatecan architecture, with chukum edges on the base, doors and windows, and Tzalam carpentry. Upon entering, you are greeted by a spacious and bright space, with a double-height ceiling that houses the living room and dining room in a cozy environment. The handmade decoration, in neutral tones, complements the elegant pasta floors.

A single hallway connects the different areas of the house, offering a smooth transition with a mix of materials that enhances the decorative proposal. The fully equipped kitchen has a large granite island, perfect for sharing moments.

This beautifully restored home in La Ermita seamlessly blends the city’s rich heritage with modern amenities.

Upon entering, you’re greeted by pasta tile floors, a nod to Merida’s architectural past. The sun-drenched dining room is perfect for entertaining guests, while the warm  
and inviting living room is ideal for relaxing.

The adjacent, well-equipped kitchen boasts state-of-the-art appliances and ample workspace.

Four master suites, each with its own private bathroom, offer the ultimate  
in luxury and comfort.

Step outside to the lush backyard, where a sparkling filtered pool awaits. Solar panels and inverter AC in every room ensure sustainability and energy efficiency.

### Casa Isabel – Santiago

Merida,

Yucatan

Centro Merida Colonial Restoration Is Ready To Move Into!

This house is a total gem from 1950 that is nestled in El Barrio de Santiago. It is fully renovated with 4 bedrooms and 4.5 bathrooms all with full baths and beautiful details.

The moment you step inside, you’ll be greeted by a super bright and airy living room… natural light and high ceilings!

There will be a huge dining area perfect for throwing parties and having all your friends over.  The kitchen will be fully loaded with all the latest appliances. Off the kitchen there is a terrace where you can sip your morning coffee and watch the world go by.

There will be four master suites, each with its own bathroom and walk-in closet. The windows and skylights let in tons of natural light, making the whole house feel fresh and inviting.

The backyard will be your own private oasis, complete with a massive filtered pool that’s perfect for cooling off on those hot Merida days. The garden will be a place to escape the world in your own private paradise, lush and green.
