### Santa Ana Fully Loaded Colonial – Solar Powered

This fully renovated colonial home for sale in Santa Ana, Mérida offers a rare combination of **prime walkable location, modern infrastructure, and energy-efficient design** in one of Centro’s most desirable areas.

Located just one block from Paseo de Montejo and within a short walk to Parque Santa Ana, Calle 47’s dining corridor, and La Plancha Park, the property provides immediate access to Mérida’s top cultural, dining, and lifestyle destinations while maintaining a quiet residential setting.

Originally rebuilt and upgraded in 2020, the home features new electrical, plumbing, and construction systems throughout, creating a **turnkey residence that blends historic character with modern functionality**. Interior details include decorative pasta tile floors, beamed ceilings, skylights, original hardwood doors, and high-end finishes that reflect the architectural style of Mérida Centro homes.

The property is designed for both comfort and efficiency, with **14 solar panels, inverter air conditioning, pressurized and purified water systems, LED lighting, and modern appliances included**. These features significantly reduce operating costs while improving long-term livability.

Interior spaces include a spacious open-concept living and dining area, a large chef’s kitchen with granite countertops, a dedicated library or office, and multiple bedrooms with walk-in closets. The layout supports both full-time living and rental use, with a focus on usability and flow.

Outdoor areas are designed for relaxation and entertaining, featuring a filtered swimming pool with water feature, covered patio, landscaped areas, and easy access to the rooftop for additional outdoor living potential. The inclusion of an attached garage with automatic access is a significant advantage in this part of Centro, where off-street parking is limited.

From an investment perspective, this property stands out due to its **location, solar efficiency, full renovation, and high-quality finishes**. Homes within one block of Paseo de Montejo with modern systems and garage parking are relatively rare and tend to attract strong interest from both international buyers and renters.

This property may appeal to buyers seeking a **luxury Centro residence, a second home in Mérida, or a high-quality rental property** with strong long-term value. Its combination of walkability, infrastructure, and architectural character positions it as a premium offering within the Mérida real estate market.

### Classic 1 Story in Exclusive Neighborhood

Merida,

Yucatan

This classically designed 1 story home is located in the exclusive neighborhood Col. Campestre, 3 blocks from the Campestre Country Club.

With 990 square meters (10,656.3 square feet) of land and 534.37 square meters (5751.91 square feet) of construction, there will be ample space for indoor entertainment or large garden/swimming parties.

Beautifully maintained, the home offers an abundance of comforts.

4 bedrooms

4 bathrooms and 2 half-baths

Large entrance with wide double doors

Huge living room area

Formal dinning room

Large kitchen with lots of counter space and breakfast area

Library/TV room with built-in bookcases and 1/2 bath

Pool with child protective fence

Game/entertainment room pool-side (could be a guest house)

Guest house (or additional entertainment room) with shower

Huge covered patio

Outdoor cooking area

Laundry area

Servants room with full bath

Separate servants entrance

All wooden doors and shutters are cedar!

Laundry area, closets in bedrooms, fans, A/C, marble floors, classic wooden window shutters, 3 to 4 car garage, big garden with old-growth fruit trees, covered front porch, beautiful high quality iron work… and much more!

This property is close to restaurants, shopping, coffee shops, Costco, Sam’s Club, the Grand Plaza, The Harbor and Galleria malls, and of course, Club Campestre!

### Gorgeous Villa Rosa Santa Ana

Located in the desirable area of Santa Ana, just a block from beautiful Paseo de Montejo, you’ll be right where you want to be, close to restaurants, museums, the cathedral, art galleries, shopping, banks, and leisurely strolls.

The architect-designed house, by Estilo Arquitectos, includes a spacious living/dining room, center atrium with tropical plants and fountain, three bedrooms and three baths.  Custom cabinetry is in each room, and the principal bedroom has a gorgeous tropical bathroom that is one-of-a-kind and even has its own private patio.  This is all on one level making it super easy and accessible, the open kitchen is great for entertaining, there is even a rare wine cellar off the kitchen and laundry room.

There’s a one car garage which is also rare, and solar panels to keep the A/C bills almost nonexistent.  The pool entertaining area with outdoor kitchen area is stunning and so welcoming year round.  Above that is a sun terrace overlooking the pool and property.  The asking price includes all the furniture you see in the photos.

### Turnkey Casa Boho 72

Located in the desirable Santa Ana neighborhood in Mérida Centro, this fully restored residence (2018) combines original architectural character with modern infrastructure and comfortable indoor–outdoor living. With generous ceiling heights, multiple terraces, a garden pool area, and a rare garage, the property is well suited for full-time living, a second home, or a high-end rental property.

The home welcomes you with expansive interior volumes, highlighted by original pasta tile floors, restored antique doors, and smooth chukum-finished walls. Ceiling heights of approximately 4.40 meters create a sense of openness and natural ventilation throughout the main living spaces.

The Italian-designed kitchen connects seamlessly with the dining and living areas, which open directly onto a covered terrace and landscaped garden with swimming pool. Multiple terraces throughout the property provide shaded outdoor living areas, creating several private spaces for relaxing or entertaining.

Upstairs, the bedrooms feature warm wood finishes, natural light, and terrace access with views over the garden and pool. The home also includes modern systems rarely found in historic Centro homes, including solar panels, inverter air conditioning, water softener, irrigation system, biodigester, and pressurized water system.

This is a well-executed restoration that preserves the character of a historic Centro home while offering the comfort and efficiency expected in a modern residence.

### Amazing Private Resort Style Beachfront

Chelem,

Yucatan

Private resort style beachfront living with income potential in Chelem!

This is a large lot 15 x 73 meter enclosed with plenty of room for additional development. It is located on one of the premier areas in Chelem in an area with several full time ex-pat residences. The properties are well maintained in this area providing a stable community and support structure. It is an easy 5 block walk to the conveniences that downtown Chelem has to offer, while maintaining the privacy and serenity of beach life.

This is an amazing property that offers everything!

\*Custom hand tiled mosaic entrance with automated gate and large covered private parking area.

\*A spacious master bedroom with spectacular beachfront view and bathroom with soaking tub as well as generous sized closet.

\*A living room with full beach view and retractable sliding glass doors to the ocean and beach allowing for refreshing cross ventilation from the Yucatan ocean breeze.

\*A spacious screened beachfront terrace/dining area with direct beach access.

\*A large screened poolside terrace/dining area.

\*A beautiful modern kitchen with ample cabinets and spacious counters for entertaining guest.

\*Large utility room with pantry and full sized washer and dryer (included)

\*This is a fully functioning Airbnb with 100% five star ratings!

\*5 bedrooms, each with a private en suite bath.

\*All bedrooms include king size beds (included)

\*All 4 of the first floor bedrooms have a personal safes for valuables.

\*One bedroom has the option of separating the king size bed into twin beds.

\*3 of the bedrooms are in an area separate from the main house.

\*There is a rooftop suite with floor to ceiling retractable screened sliding glass doors and rooftop terrace including a jacuzzi/cocktail pool with a panoramic ocean view.

\*The rooftop suite includes a large lounge area with a sink and refrigerator. It is a spacious bedroom with ocean and pool views, full bath and large closet.

\*Easy option to create a separate entrance from the main house to create a fully private rental option.

\*This area also includes a private, fully stocked, kitchenette/dining area with full size refrigerator, hot plate, microwave, toaster and coffee pot to service Airbnb guest.

\*The very large private pool is filtered with a tanning area and passive solar heating system with a large waterfall feature.

\*Outdoor shower.

\*There is city water AND a private water well.

\*Filtered pressurized water system with softener and infrared filters throughout the house.

\*Generac whole home automatic generator.

\*There is a very low electric bill due to the 18-350W and 20-550W solar panels.

\*Hurricane shutters on all downstairs beach-side doors and windows.

### Stunning Villa Montecristo

**Luxury estate for sale in Montecristo, Mérida with 6 bedrooms, 2,000 m² of land, resort-style amenities, and secure compound design in a prime North Mérida location.**

This expansive villa in Montecristo offers a rare opportunity to acquire a **large-scale, fully built estate with high-end construction, extensive infrastructure, and private compound-style living** in one of Mérida’s most established and upscale residential neighborhoods.

Set on approximately 2,000 m² of land, the property provides significant space for both residential living and long-term flexibility. The home includes **6 bedrooms, 9 bathrooms, multiple living areas, service quarters, and covered parking for multiple vehicles**, making it suitable for large families, multigenerational use, or a hospitality-style residence.

Built in 2009 with durable materials and traditional architectural elements, the home features carved stone columns and arches, beamed ceilings, marble and stone flooring, granite surfaces, and handcrafted wood details. These elements combine to create a property that emphasizes **structural quality, longevity, and architectural presence**.

The property is designed for both comfort and functionality, with a large chef’s kitchen including commercial-grade equipment, multiple pantry areas, interior and exterior lighting systems, air conditioning throughout, and integrated communication and entry systems. Infrastructure features include **an electric substation, water wells, pressurized and purified water systems, and advanced security with perimeter protection and controlled access**, supporting reliable long-term use.

Outdoor areas are designed as a private residential compound, with landscaped gardens, mature vegetation, fountains, covered patios, outdoor bar, and a swimming pool. Multiple terraces and private bedroom patios provide additional living space, while the overall layout allows for separation between primary living areas, guest accommodations, and service quarters.

The location in Montecristo is a key advantage. This neighborhood is one of North Mérida’s most desirable residential zones, known for its wide streets, proximity to hospitals, shopping centers, restaurants, and top services, while maintaining a quiet and secure environment.

From an investment perspective, this property stands out due to its **scale, infrastructure, and replacement cost value**. Properties with this level of construction, land size, and built systems are increasingly difficult to replicate at current prices. The combination of lot size, security features, and multi-use layout positions it as a long-term hold or legacy asset.

This property may appeal to buyers seeking a **luxury primary residence in Mérida, a multigenerational family compound, or a private estate with hospitality or executive-use potential**. Its combination of size, build quality, and location places it among the more substantial residential offerings in the Mérida market.

### Fabulous San Crisanto Beachfront Lots

Beachfront   \*  Tranquil   \*  Versatile   \*    Investment   \*  Scenic

Tropical Paradise Awaits: Two Beachfront Lots in San Crisanto

Discover the epitome of seaside living with these two stunning beachfront lots, totaling just over 6756 square meters, nestled in the picturesque village of San Crisanto. Located along the pristine shores of the Gulf of Mexico, this is a rare opportunity to own a slice of paradise in one of Yucatan’s most coveted beach destinations.

Property Highlights:

Prime Location: Situated directly on the powdery white sands of San Crisanto, these lots offer breathtaking panoramic views of the turquoise waters and endless horizon.

Versatile Potential: With ample space, these lots are perfect for realizing your dream tropical getaway or for developing beachfront apartments or villas, catering to those seeking the ultimate coastal lifestyle or savvy investors alike.

Convenient Access: While offering a tranquil escape, the lots are conveniently accessible. A scenic 1 hour 30-minute drive connects you to the vibrant city of Merida, while local amenities such as stores in San Crisanto and nearby Telchac ensure everyday necessities are within reach. Additionally, the bustling port town of Progreso is a mere 50-minute drive away, offering an array of dining, entertainment, and cultural experiences.

Irresistible Offer: Priced at $750,000 MXN per linear meter, these beachfront lots present an unparalleled investment opportunity in one of Mexico’s most sought-after coastal communities.

San Crisanto: Where Tranquility Meets Authenticity

Nestled along the Yucatan coast, San Crisanto enchants visitors with its laid-back charm and unspoiled natural beauty. Here, time slows down, allowing you to immerse yourself in the rhythms of coastal living. Known for its pristine beaches, lush mangroves, and crystal-clear cenotes, San Crisanto offers a sanctuary for nature lovers and adventurers alike. Indulge in local delicacies, explore the vibrant marine life, or simply unwind under swaying palms—San Crisanto invites you to experience the true essence of tropical living.

### Stunning Beachfront Home!

Chuburna,

Yucatan

SOLD!!!!!!!!!!!!!

This stunning beachfront home located between Chuburna Puerto and Chelem, on a very large corner lot, is without question, one of the most beautiful properties on the market and the most accurately priced beachfront property currently on the market!

757m2 (8148.28 sq. ft.) lot with 276.12m2 construction (2972.13 sq. ft.)

Designed and built by an American contractor to US standards. The interior was done by a professional interior designer, for both beauty and practicality. Details, details and more details! This was designed for luxury!

As you enter the property, you walk into a beautiful garden with a very large pool that is surrounded by a beautiful mural. There is a very nice patio with a bar and outdoor kitchen.  There is a 2 car garage that has ample storage and a half bath; the double doors for the garage are automatic.

As you enter the house you have a beautiful view of the beach. The house has a very large, open floor plan for the kitchen, dining and living rooms. The windows on the ocean side are heavy-duty hurricane glass, spanning the full length of the front porch. Both of the first-floor bedrooms are large with ample closet space and full bath.

The second floor is totally self-contained. The second floor has an outside entrance staircase that makes it perfect for rental. The view of the beach is exceptional.

This property comes fully furnished!

A large double pantry, beautiful woodwork throughout the house, very spacious rooms and a well-kept garden add to the inviting and welcoming feeling from the moment you walk into this property.

The newly built bulkhead is exceptional in size and design to divert wave action.

In addition, the sale includes 24 solar panels, an 11kw automatic generator and a 2017 Nissan X-Trail. YES, this sale includes an auto! See photos.

This is an exceptional property at an exceptional price!

To view this property, contact Dr. Leroy Osmon, 999-125-6196 or email: leroy.osmon@gmail.com

### Breathtaking Beach Compound – Telchac Puerto – San Crisanto

Offered at $35,000,000.00 Mexican Pesos

Paradise   \*    Tropical   \*    Beach   \*    Secluded   \*    Spacious   \*    Relaxation

Escape to your private paradise with this breathtaking beach compound nestled along 40 meters of pristine coastline between the well-known Telchac Puerto and the peaceful fishing village of San Crisanto. Embrace the essence of luxury living amidst lush tropical surroundings, where every day feels like a getaway.

Immerse yourself in the tranquility of this expansive property spanning five lots, featuring mature coconut palm trees that provide shade and a serene ambiance. Enjoy the ultimate privacy with three 20-meter lots on the south side, bordered by the beach road, and two additional beachfront lots. And every evening you can lose yourself with the flocks of birds flying into the enchanting sunsets.

Step into a world of elegance and comfort with the main house boasting four bedrooms and four bathrooms, exuding timeless charm and modern convenience. The caretaker’s casita offers two bedrooms, a bathroom, and a kitchen, ensuring ample space for guests or staff. Plus, indulge in leisurely moments in the bungalow, which opens to a filtered pool and vast patio, currently utilized as a gym with a large bathroom.

Impeccable Design & Amenities

This newly constructed compound has been meticulously maintained and boasts quality finishes throughout, including granite countertops, air conditioning, and ceiling fans for year-round comfort. Revel in the stunning views from the open kitchen with a pantry and wrap-around windows, or unwind on the second and third-floor terraces. Additional features such as pressurized water, bathtubs, and LED illumination add to the allure of this coastal oasis.

Ideally situated on Yucatan’s most desirable beach, you’re just minutes away from Telchac Puerto’s excellent dining options, convenient shops and health clinic. Just 45 minutes away is Progreso’s Malecón, supermarket, and doctors, dentists, hospitals, and clinics. It’s an hour to Costco and fabulous shopping on Merida’s north side, and an hour and 15 minutes to the airport.

Your Beachfront Escape Awaits

Experience effortless beach living that embodies the epitome of luxury and relaxation. This compound is offered at MX$35,000,000 by Mexico International. And if you want to move right in, the custom-selected furniture and furnishings are negotiable.

### EXCELLENT INVESTMENT OPPORTUNITY: LAND AT KM 20 OF THE MÉRIDA-PROGRESO HIGHWAY

Tamanché,

Yucatan

This land represents an excellent investment opportunity for real estate developers, in one of the areas with the highest added value in the northern part of the state of Yucatán.

The land is located at the foot of the Mérida-Progreso Highway, near the town of Tamanché, making it one of the best locations in the area thanks to its easy connectivity to the cities of Mérida and Progreso. It is just a few minutes from the Mérida ring road and the Port of Progreso and also has access to all services. It is surrounded by premium residential and commercial developments, making it a very attractive option for real estate investors and developers. It is close to schools, parks, and a church, offering a high quality of life for potential future residents.

The Mérida-Progreso Highway connects the city of Mérida with Progreso, the most important port in Yucatán. A massive investment of approximately 29 billion pesos has been made in its port infrastructure, with the goal of expanding and modernizing it and transforming it into one of the country’s main ports. This investment benefits local and international companies by boosting foreign trade, creating new jobs, attracting more investors, and increasing regional development, which brings significant benefits not only to Progreso and Mérida, but also to the entire Yucatán Peninsula and other neighboring states such as Tabasco and Chiapas. This significant development in the area, coupled with the enormous growth north of the city of Mérida, naturally makes the Mérida-Progreso Highway a prime focus for investors due to the significant increase in real estate value, as it is the only route connecting the Port of Progreso with the beautiful city of Mérida. Investment in this area ensures an important place in the current wave of growth.

We encourage you to schedule a viewing of the property, after which we assure you that you will fall in love with it.

**OPORTUNIDAD DE EXCELENTE INVERSION: TERRENO KM 20 CARRETERA MÉRIDA – PROGRESO**

Este terreno constituye una excelente oportunidad de inversión para desarrolladores inmobiliarios, en una de las áreas con mayor plusvalía en el norte del Estado de Yucatán.

El terreno está ubicado al pie de la carretera Mérida-Progreso, en las cercanías del poblado de Tamanché, lo que ha hecho que su ubicación sea una de las mejores de la zona gracias a su fácil conectividad con las ciudades de Mérida y Progreso, ya que se encuentra a solo pocos minutos del anillo periférico de Mérida y del Puerto de Progreso y, además, tiene acceso a todos los servicios. Está rodeado de desarrollos residenciales premium y comerciales, lo que lo convierte en una opción muy atractiva para inversionistas y promotores inmobiliarios. Se encuentra próximo a escuelas, parques y una iglesia, ofreciendo alta calidad de vida para los posibles futuros residentes.

La carretera Mérida-Progreso conecta la ciudad de Mérida con el puerto más importante de Yucatán, Progreso, en cuya infraestructura portuaria de ha hecho una enorme inversión, de alrededor de 29 mil millones de pesos, con el objetivo de ampliarlo, modernizarlo y convertirlo en unos de los principales puertos del país. Esta inversión beneficia a empresas locales e internacionales impulsando el comercio exterior, generando nuevos empleos, atrayendo más inversionistas e incrementando el desarrollo regional, lo que conlleva beneficios importantes no solo a Progreso y a Mérida, sino a toda la península de Yucatán y otros Estados vecinos, como Tabasco y Chiapas. Este gran desarrollo de la zona, sumado al enorme crecimiento al norte de la ciudad de Mérida, provoca que, naturalmente, la carretera Mérida-Progreso sea el principal foco de atención para inversionistas debido al gran incremento de la plusvalía inmobiliaria, puesto que es la única vía que conecta el Puerto de Progreso con la bella ciudad de Mérida. ### Unique Development Opportunity On 50 Hectares Of Established Hacienda Land

This truly stunning land, nestled in the quiet countryside just outside of the picturesque town of Baca, is an amazing opportunity for a developer looking for the ideal situation to build their project. The land surrounds a former Hacienda which sits atop a well with access to water throughout the plot and all areas. The water comes from the underlying cenotes on the plot, which can easily be opened up to create breath-taking features within the land.

The property is already set up with access to electricity as well as accessible by road. 5 minutes from Baca town, 15 mins from Motul, 25 mins from the Merida Periferico and with an equal distance of approximately 40km from both Progresso beach and Telchac beach, the location of this 50 hectare plot could not be more ideal.

The plot is available for sale as a whole and is ideally suited for subdivision with an access road that leads straight down the middle of the plot towards the existing Hacienda building.

Open to negotiations for selling part of the plot or subdividing etc, please contact for further details and secure a viewing.

This is one opportunity you do not want to miss, and a perfect setting to build the development project of the year. The location is outstanding and needs to be seen to be believed!

CASA EL TURIX
